specification.sql:
WITH remaining AS (
 SELECT r.* FROM recovery_decisions r WHERE NOT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM recovery_decisions s WHERE s.supersedes=r.id)
), ranked AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY lower(body_sha256),original_url
 ORDER BY cast(decided_at AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) DESC,id DESC) AS selected FROM remaining
)
-- corpus_recovery.reconcile writes this note into immutable raw receipts; it only restates
-- evidence_sha256 and does not explain how the recovery relates to the original.
SELECT * EXCLUDE(identity_note),
 CASE WHEN identity_note='Reconciled from pinned accepted mappings '||evidence_sha256||'; receipt categories preserved'
 THEN NULL ELSE identity_note END AS identity_note
FROM ranked WHERE selected=1

specification.name: recovery_candidates
specification.sql:
-- Capture identity is never replaced by a provenance decision's identity.
SELECT c.receipt_key,c.receipt_line,c.capture_index,
 encode(sha256(json_array(c.receipt_key,c.receipt_line,c.capture_index)),'hex') AS recovery_id,
 coalesce(d.id,'row:'||encode(sha256(json_array(c.receipt_key,c.receipt_line,c.capture_index)),'hex')) AS id,
 d.id AS decision_id,c.original_url,encode(c.sha256,'hex') AS body_sha,c.bytes,c.imported_at,
 coalesce(c.recovered_url,d.recovered_url) AS recovered_url,d.recovered_filename,d.identity_note,
 CASE WHEN d.kind='rejected' THEN 'rejected'
 WHEN c.recovery_category IS NOT NULL THEN category.kind ELSE coalesce(d.kind,basis.kind) END AS kind

-- Positive writer metadata is admission evidence, never a fabricated byte sniff.
-- Either verdict needs every row of a body to qualify, so a body with no qualifying row

WITH candidate_admission_shas AS (

(bool_and(coalesce(c.fidelity='saved-text',false)) AND count(c.media_type)=count(*) AND count(DISTINCT c.media_type)=1

-- Physical sizes come from creating lines or verification, never a guessed ratio.
WITH stored AS (
 SELECT encode(sha256,'hex') AS body_sha,max(bytes) AS original_size,
 bool_or(stored_suffix='') AS bare,
 max(CASE WHEN stored_suffix='' THEN stored_bytes END) AS bare_size,
 max(CASE WHEN stored_suffix='.gz' THEN stored_bytes END) AS gzip_size
 FROM captures WHERE sha256 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sha256
), keys AS (
 SELECT *,'bodies/sha256/'||substr(body_sha,1,2)||'/'||body_sha AS body_key FROM stored
)
SELECT b.body_sha,b.original_size,coalesce(s.format,a.format) AS format,coalesce(v.intact,s.intact) AS intact,
 CASE WHEN v.intact IS NOT NULL THEN 'copy' WHEN s.intact IS NOT NULL THEN s.intact_basis ELSE 'unchecked' END AS intact_basis,
 s.error_type,CASE WHEN v.body_sha IS NOT NULL AND s.format='pdf' THEN '.pdf'
 WHEN b.bare THEN '' ELSE '.gz' END AS suffix,
 CASE WHEN v.body_sha IS NOT NULL AND s.format='pdf' THEN pdf.size
 WHEN b.bare THEN coalesce(b.bare_size,bare.size) ELSE coalesce(b.gzip_size,gz.size) END AS stored_size
-- Keep corpus-sized body rows on the streamed side of every evidence join.
FROM storage_verifications gz RIGHT JOIN (
 storage_verifications bare RIGHT JOIN (
  storage_verifications pdf RIGHT JOIN (
   copy_verifications v RIGHT JOIN (
    body_admissions a RIGHT JOIN (
     sniff_facts s RIGHT JOIN (
      verification_conflicts c RIGHT ANTI JOIN keys b ON c.body_sha=b.body_sha
     ) ON b.body_sha=encode(s.body_sha,'hex')
    ) ON b.body_sha=encode(a.body_sha,'hex')
   ) ON b.body_sha=v.body_sha
  ) ON pdf.key=b.body_key||'.pdf'
 ) ON bare.key=b.body_key
) ON gz.key=b.body_key||'.gz'

specification.name: body_signals
specification.sql:
-- DM 7.3. page_facts contains the pinned HTML/XML/JSON reading per body.
-- Content patterns run once per body, independently of capture addresses.
WITH thresholds AS (
    SELECT
        max(CASE WHEN id = 'near_empty' THEN number END) AS near_empty,
        max(CASE WHEN id = 'listing_links' THEN number END) AS listing_links,
        max(CASE WHEN id = 'listing_percent' THEN number END) AS listing_percent
    FROM page_signals
), rules AS (
    SELECT kind, pattern FROM page_signals
    WHERE kind IN ('source_record_root', 'error_word', 'body_marker', 'wrapper_marker', 'feed_root')
      AND pattern IS NOT NULL
), facts AS (
    SELECT body_sha,status,xml_root,title,heading,text_head,text_bytes,link_count,link_text_bytes
    FROM page_facts
)
SELECT f.body_sha, max(f.status) AS status,
    bool_or(CASE WHEN r.kind = 'source_record_root'
        THEN coalesce(regexp_like(f.xml_root, r.pattern), false) ELSE false END) AS source_record,
    bool_or(CASE
        WHEN r.kind = 'error_word' THEN coalesce(
            regexp_like(f.title, r.pattern) OR regexp_like(f.heading, r.pattern), false)
        WHEN r.kind = 'body_marker' THEN coalesce(regexp_like(f.text_head, r.pattern), false)
        ELSE false END) OR max(f.text_bytes) < max(t.near_empty) AS error_response,
    bool_or(CASE WHEN r.kind = 'wrapper_marker'
        THEN coalesce(regexp_like(f.text_head, r.pattern), false) ELSE false END) AS wrapper,
    bool_or(CASE WHEN r.kind = 'feed_root'
        THEN coalesce(regexp_like(f.xml_root, r.pattern), false) ELSE false END) AS feed,
    max(f.link_count) >= max(t.listing_links)
        AND 100 * cast(max(f.link_text_bytes) AS BIGINT)
            >= max(t.listing_percent) * cast(max(f.text_bytes) AS BIGINT) AS listing
FROM rules r CROSS JOIN thresholds t CROSS JOIN facts f
GROUP BY f.body_sha

specification.name: locator_signals
specification.sql:
-- DM 7.3. capture_locators is the distinct (url, member_path) relation.
-- URL-dependent rules remain separate from facts about a response body.
WITH rules AS (
    SELECT kind, pattern FROM page_signals
    WHERE kind IN ('error_url', 'api_endpoint', 'feed_url') AND pattern IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'file_shape' AS kind, pattern FROM file_shapes
)
-- A redirect is judged by both addresses (red-e1b): an error address at either end is an
-- error, and a file-shaped request stays file-shaped unless it landed on an error address.
SELECT c.url, c.requested_url, c.member_path,
    bool_or(CASE WHEN r.kind = 'api_endpoint'
        THEN coalesce(regexp_like(c.url, r.pattern), false) ELSE false END) AS api,
    bool_or(CASE WHEN r.kind = 'error_url'
        THEN coalesce(regexp_like(c.url, r.pattern), false)
          OR coalesce(regexp_like(c.requested_url, r.pattern), false) ELSE false END) AS error_response,
    bool_or(CASE WHEN r.kind = 'feed_url'
        THEN coalesce(regexp_like(c.url, r.pattern), false) ELSE false END) AS feed,
    bool_or(CASE WHEN r.kind = 'file_shape'
        THEN coalesce(regexp_like(coalesce(c.member_path, c.url), r.pattern), false)
        ELSE false END)
    OR (c.member_path IS NULL
        AND bool_or(CASE WHEN r.kind = 'file_shape'
            THEN coalesce(regexp_like(c.requested_url, r.pattern), false) ELSE false END)
        AND NOT bool_or(CASE WHEN r.kind = 'error_url'
            THEN coalesce(regexp_like(c.url, r.pattern), false) ELSE false END)) AS file_shaped
FROM rules r CROSS JOIN capture_locators c
GROUP BY c.url, c.requested_url, c.member_path

specification.name: record_roles
specification.sql:
-- DM 7.3. capture_evidence supplies pinned format/integrity facts and native
-- capture columns. Hash joins carry keys, flags and scalars; titles and text
-- heads remain inside the once-per-body signal step.
WITH roles AS (
    SELECT c.receipt_key, c.receipt_line, c.capture_index, c.sha256, c.format,
        c.intact_basis, c.error_type, c.mode, c.outcome, c.http_status,
        c.complete, c.bytes, p.sha256 AS placeholder_body, l.file_shaped,
        g.receipt_key IS NOT NULL AS good_fetch,
        CASE
            WHEN c.format IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN c.format = 'vtt' THEN 'caption'
            WHEN a.sha256 IS NOT NULL THEN 'archive'
            WHEN c.format = 'm3u8' THEN 'playlist'
            -- A stream segment or other unrecognized audio/video body is media, never a document
            -- (senate/players MP2T samples once their stated 200 is read; none listed in v21).
            WHEN c.format = 'other' AND (coalesce(sg.segment, false)
                 OR split_part(lower(c.media_type), '/', 1) IN ('video', 'audio')) THEN 'media'
            WHEN c.format = 'warc' THEN 'envelope'
            WHEN c.format = 'pdf' AND c.intact IS NOT TRUE
                 AND c.intact_basis <> 'unchecked' THEN 'damaged'
            -- JSON here is an API page or a provider's envelope, never a document: all 345 once listed
            -- were, and their contents have their own rows.
            WHEN c.format = 'json' THEN 'api'
            WHEN c.format IN ('html', 'xml', 'json')
                 AND (b.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed') THEN NULL
            WHEN c.format = 'xml' AND b.source_record THEN 'source_record'
            WHEN c.format = 'html' AND (b.error_response OR l.error_response)
                 THEN 'error_response'
            WHEN c.format = 'html' AND b.wrapper THEN 'wrapper'
            WHEN (c.format = 'html' AND b.listing)
                 OR (c.format = 'xml' AND (b.feed OR l.feed)) THEN 'listing'
            ELSE 'document'
        END AS record_role
    FROM archive_bodies a RIGHT JOIN (placeholders p RIGHT JOIN (
        locator_signals l RIGHT JOIN (
            body_signals b RIGHT JOIN (
                segment_captures sg RIGHT JOIN (good_fetch_keys g RIGHT JOIN capture_evidence c
                USING(receipt_key,receipt_line,capture_index))
                ON c.receipt_key = sg.receipt_key AND c.receipt_line = sg.receipt_line
                AND c.capture_index = sg.capture_index
            ) ON c.sha256 = b.body_sha

specification.name: effective_filenames
specification.sql:
-- DM 7.4. One caller-supplied input_id per capture or recovery original link.
-- filename_parameters holds ordered parameter names; URL decoding preserves +.
WITH urls AS (
    SELECT input_id,
        unnest(make_array(source_url, requested_url)) AS candidate_url,
        unnest(make_array(0, 1)) AS url_priority
    FROM filename_inputs
), queries AS (
    SELECT input_id, url_priority,
        CASE WHEN strpos(split_part(candidate_url, '#', 1), '?') > 0
            THEN substr(split_part(candidate_url, '#', 1),
                        strpos(split_part(candidate_url, '#', 1), '?') + 1)
            ELSE '' END AS query
    FROM urls WHERE candidate_url IS NOT NULL
), query_parts AS (
    SELECT input_id, url_priority,
        unnest(string_to_array(query, '&')) AS part,
        unnest(range(0, cast(array_length(string_to_array(
            query, '&')) AS BIGINT))) AS part_index
    FROM queries
), parameter_values AS (
    SELECT q.input_id,
        percent_decode_utf8(CASE WHEN strpos(q.part, '=') > 0
            THEN substr(q.part, strpos(q.part, '=') + 1) ELSE '' END) AS filename,
        q.url_priority,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY q.input_id
            ORDER BY q.url_priority, p.priority, q.part_index) AS preference,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY q.input_id, q.url_priority
            ORDER BY p.priority, q.part_index) AS url_preference
    FROM filename_parameters p JOIN query_parts q
        ON lower(percent_decode_utf8(split_part(q.part, '=', 1))) = p.parameter
), named AS (
SELECT i.input_id, i.source_url, i.requested_url, i.member_path,
    coalesce(
        CASE WHEN i.recovery_rejected IS NOT TRUE THEN nullif(i.recovered_filename, '') END,
        nullif(regexp_replace(i.member_path, '^.*/', ''), ''),
        nullif(disposition_filename(i.h_content_disposition), ''),
        nullif(p.filename, ''),
        nullif(url_filename(i.source_url), ''),
        nullif(url_filename(i.requested_url), ''),
        -- A capture with no URL of its own is published at its context address.
        nullif(url_filename(i.context_url), ''),
        -- A query-free URL ending in '/' names its last non-empty path segment.
        nullif(CASE WHEN strpos(i.source_url, '?') = 0
            THEN url_filename(regexp_replace(i.source_url, '/+(#.*)?$', '')) END, ''),
        nullif(CASE WHEN strpos(i.requested_url, '?') = 0
            THEN url_filename(regexp_replace(i.requested_url, '/+(#.*)?$', '')) END, ''),
        nullif(CASE WHEN strpos(i.context_url, '?') = 0
            THEN url_filename(regexp_replace(i.context_url, '/+(#.*)?$', '')) END, ''), '') AS filename,
    -- The requested (linked) URL's own name, by the same URL rules (owner, 2026-11-02: read both
    -- names). The shown name stays the one above; this second name is read only for the facts
    -- the shown name lacks or contradicts (source-annotations-filename.sql).
    coalesce(nullif(r.filename, ''), nullif(url_filename(i.requested_url), ''),
        nullif(CASE WHEN strpos(i.requested_url, '?') = 0
            THEN url_filename(regexp_replace(i.requested_url, '/+(#.*)?$', '')) END, '')) AS requested_name
FROM parameter_values r RIGHT JOIN (parameter_values p RIGHT JOIN filename_inputs i
    ON i.input_id = p.input_id AND p.preference = 1)
    ON i.input_id = r.input_id AND r.url_priority = 1 AND r.url_preference = 1
)
-- A requested name is kept only for a top-level capture whose requested URL differs from its
-- source URL and names it differently: redirects to a final URL, nothing else.
SELECT input_id, source_url, filename,
    CASE WHEN member_path IS NULL AND (requested_url IS DISTINCT FROM source_url)
        AND (requested_name IS DISTINCT FROM filename) THEN requested_name END AS requested_filename,
    CASE WHEN member_path IS NULL AND (requested_url IS DISTINCT FROM source_url)
        AND (requested_name IS DISTINCT FROM filename) AND requested_name IS NOT NULL THEN requested_url END AS requested_url
FROM named

specification.name: source_url_normalized
specification.sql:
-- Inputs: source_url_inputs(input_id,url), url_rules, active url_variants(canonical_url,variant_url).
-- Literal values remain unchanged. Every error makes the join key unusable.
WITH literals AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT url FROM source_url_inputs
 UNION SELECT canonical_url FROM url_variants
 UNION SELECT variant_url FROM url_variants
), first_matches AS (
 SELECT l.url,count(r.id) AS matches,
 max(CASE r.decoder WHEN 'proofpoint' THEN
   percent_decode_utf8(replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(l.url,r.pattern,r.replacement),'-([0-9A-Fa-f]{2})','%$1','g'),'_','/'))
 WHEN 'percent' THEN percent_decode_utf8(regexp_replace(l.url,r.pattern,r.replacement))
 ELSE regexp_replace(l.url,r.pattern,r.replacement) END) AS inner_url
 FROM url_rules r RIGHT JOIN literals l ON r.kind='wrapper' AND regexp_like(l.url,r.pattern)
 GROUP BY l.url
), first_pass AS (
 SELECT url,coalesce(inner_url,url) AS value,matches>1 AS conflict FROM first_matches
), second_matches AS (
 SELECT p.url,p.conflict,count(r.id) AS matches,
 max(CASE r.decoder WHEN 'proofpoint' THEN
   percent_decode_utf8(replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(p.value,r.pattern,r.replacement),'-([0-9A-Fa-f]{2})','%$1','g'),'_','/'))
 WHEN 'percent' THEN percent_decode_utf8(regexp_replace(p.value,r.pattern,r.replacement))
 ELSE regexp_replace(p.value,r.pattern,r.replacement) END) AS inner_url,max(p.value) AS prior
 FROM url_rules r RIGHT JOIN first_pass p ON r.kind='wrapper' AND regexp_like(p.value,r.pattern)
 GROUP BY p.url,p.conflict
), unwrapped AS (
 SELECT url,coalesce(inner_url,prior) AS value,conflict OR matches>1 AS conflict FROM second_matches
), serialized AS (
 SELECT u.url,u.value,u.conflict,uri_normalize_encoding(url_resolve(u.value,cast(NULL AS VARCHAR))) AS parsed,
 count(r.id)>0 AS still_wrapped FROM url_rules r
 RIGHT JOIN unwrapped u ON r.kind='wrapper' AND regexp_like(u.value,r.pattern)
 GROUP BY u.url,u.value,u.conflict
), components AS (
 SELECT *,regexp_replace((regexp_match(parsed,'^https?://([^/?#]+)'))[1],'^www\.','') AS authority,
 coalesce((regexp_match(parsed,'^https?://[^/?#]+([^?#]*)'))[1],'') AS path,
 (regexp_match(split_part(parsed,'#',1),'\?(.*)$'))[1] AS query FROM serialized
), pairs AS (
 SELECT url,authority,unnest(string_to_array(query,'&')) AS pair FROM components WHERE query<>''
), kept_pairs AS (
 SELECT p.* FROM url_rules r RIGHT ANTI JOIN pairs p ON r.kind='strip'
 AND (r.host_pattern IS NULL OR regexp_like(regexp_replace(p.authority,':[0-9]+$',''),r.host_pattern))
 AND regexp_like(split_part(p.pair,'=',1),r.pattern)
), queries AS (
 SELECT url,string_agg(pair,'&' ORDER BY pair) AS query FROM kept_pairs GROUP BY url
), base_keys AS (
 SELECT c.url,
 CASE WHEN c.conflict THEN 'wrapper_conflict'
 WHEN c.authority IS NULL THEN 'invalid_url' END AS error,c.still_wrapped,
 c.authority || regexp_replace(c.path,'/$','') ||
 coalesce('?' || q.query,'') AS base_key
 FROM queries q RIGHT JOIN components c ON c.url=q.url
 )
SELECT * FROM base_keys

specification.name: source_url_keys

-- Requires materialized source_url_normalized from url-normalized.sql.
WITH mappings AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT v.base_key AS variant,c.base_key AS canonical,
 v.error AS variant_error,c.error AS canonical_error
 FROM url_variants p JOIN source_url_normalized v ON p.variant_url IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v.url
 JOIN source_url_normalized c ON p.canonical_url IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.url
), validation AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)>0 THEN 1 END AS priority FROM (SELECT input_id FROM source_url_inputs GROUP BY input_id HAVING count(*)>1)
 UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)>0 THEN 2 END FROM (SELECT variant FROM mappings GROUP BY variant HAVING min(canonical)<>max(canonical))
 UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)>0 THEN 3 END FROM mappings a JOIN mappings b ON a.canonical=b.variant
 UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)>0 THEN 4 END FROM mappings WHERE variant_error IS NOT NULL OR canonical_error IS NOT NULL
), checks AS (
 SELECT CASE min(priority) WHEN 1 THEN 'duplicate_input' WHEN 2 THEN 'variant_conflict'
 WHEN 3 THEN 'variant_chain' WHEN 4 THEN 'invalid_variant' END AS error FROM validation
), resolved_mappings AS (
 SELECT variant,max(canonical) AS canonical FROM mappings GROUP BY variant
), selected AS (
 SELECT i.input_id,i.url,coalesce(checks.error,b.error) AS error,
 coalesce(m.canonical,b.base_key) AS candidate,coalesce(b.still_wrapped,false) AS still_wrapped
 FROM resolved_mappings m RIGHT JOIN (
  checks CROSS JOIN source_url_inputs i
  LEFT JOIN source_url_normalized b ON i.url IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.url
 ) ON b.base_key=m.variant
)
SELECT input_id,url,CASE WHEN error IS NULL THEN candidate END AS url_key,error,still_wrapped FROM selected

specification.name: link_contexts
specification.sql:
-- Resolve the document base once per distinct body/address/member context. context_id is the
-- null-preserving digest of those four keys, so link_targets, link_errors and resolved_links
-- group and join on one 32-byte key instead of four wide strings.
WITH contexts AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT page_body,context_url,member_path,base_href FROM link_inputs
), origins AS (
 SELECT *,sha256(json_array(page_body,context_url,member_path,base_href)) AS context_id,
 CASE WHEN member_path IS NULL THEN context_url
 ELSE 'https://archive.invalid/'||replace(replace(replace(member_path,'%','%25'),'#','%23'),'?','%3F') END AS origin
 FROM contexts
), bases AS (
 SELECT *,coalesce(url_resolve(nullif(base_href,''),origin),origin) AS resolved_base,
 regexp_replace(regexp_replace(coalesce(base_href,''),'[\t\n\r]','','g'),'^[\x00-\x20]+','') AS base_spelling
 FROM origins
)
SELECT *,member_path IS NOT NULL AND regexp_like(resolved_base,'^https://archive[.]invalid/')
 AND NOT regexp_like(base_spelling,'(?i)^(?:https?:)?[\\/]{2}') AS member_base FROM bases

specification.name: link_literals
specification.sql:
-- Retained publisher repair: never split query, fragment, whitespace or wrapper layouts.
WITH literals AS (SELECT DISTINCT href FROM link_inputs), wrapped AS (
 SELECT l.href,count(w.id) AS wrappers FROM url_rules w RIGHT JOIN literals l
 ON w.kind='wrapper' AND regexp_like(l.href,w.pattern) GROUP BY l.href
), matches AS (
 SELECT l.href,count(r.id) AS repair_matches,
 max(regexp_replace(l.href,r.pattern,r.replacement,'g')) AS repaired
 FROM url_rules r RIGHT JOIN wrapped l ON r.kind='repair' AND l.wrappers=0
 AND regexp_like(l.href,'(?i)^https?://.+https?://')
 AND NOT regexp_like(l.href,'[[:space:]?#]') AND regexp_like(l.href,r.pattern)
 GROUP BY l.href
)
SELECT href,repair_matches,CASE WHEN repair_matches=1 THEN string_to_array(substr(repaired,2),chr(10))
 ELSE make_array(href) END AS parts FROM matches

specification.name: link_targets
specification.sql:
-- Resolve distinct literal/context pairs, then reattach link ordinals and publisher facts.
-- Contexts are keyed by link_contexts.context_id (same digest of the same four keys).
WITH instances AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT sha256(json_array(page_body,context_url,member_path,base_href)) AS context_id,href FROM link_inputs
), parsed AS (
 SELECT l.context_id,l.href,c.context_url,p.repair_matches,p.split_position,p.target_literal,c.member_base,
 url_resolve(p.target_literal,c.resolved_base) AS resolved,
 regexp_replace(regexp_replace(p.target_literal,'[\t\n\r]','','g'),'^[\x00-\x20]+','') AS target_spelling
 FROM (SELECT * FROM link_contexts WHERE page_body IS NOT NULL AND context_url IS NOT NULL) c JOIN instances l
 ON l.context_id=c.context_id
 JOIN (SELECT * FROM link_parts WHERE href IS NOT NULL) p ON (l.href IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p.href)
), resolved AS (
 SELECT *,member_base AND regexp_like(resolved,'^https://archive[.]invalid/')
 AND NOT regexp_like(target_spelling,'(?i)^(?:https?:)?[\\/]{2}') AS member_target FROM parsed
)
SELECT r.context_id,r.href,r.split_position,r.target_literal,
 CASE WHEN member_target THEN context_url ELSE resolved END AS target_url,
 CASE WHEN member_target THEN percent_decode_utf8(regexp_replace(split_part(split_part(resolved,'?',1),'#',1),
 '^https://archive[.]invalid/','')) END AS target_member_path,
 CASE WHEN repair_matches>1 THEN 'repair_conflict'
 WHEN resolved IS NULL OR NOT regexp_like(resolved,'^https?://') THEN 'invalid_target'
 WHEN repair_matches=1 AND f.id IS NULL THEN 'invalid_repair' END AS target_error
FROM file_shapes f RIGHT JOIN resolved r ON f.id='extensions' AND regexp_like(r.resolved,f.pattern)

specification.name: meeting_records_ranked
specification.sql:
-- Its own materialized step: the steps after it read this many times, and the engine
-- inlines a CTE per reader, so one statement evaluated this ranking and captures join 21 times.
-- Keeps each (event, source)'s current record and the records sharing its updated, with the
-- row number of the record each collection comes from (meeting-records-current joins them back).
WITH candidate_meeting_shas AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT record_sha_hex
 FROM selected_meeting_records
 WHERE record_sha_hex IS NOT NULL
), fetch_times AS (
 SELECT encode(c.sha256,'hex') AS record_sha_hex,
  max(arrow_cast(cast(c.retrieved_at AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))')) AS retrieved_at
 FROM captures c
 JOIN candidate_meeting_shas cms ON encode(c.sha256,'hex')=cms.record_sha_hex
 WHERE c.sha256 IS NOT NULL AND c.mode='fetch' AND c.complete AND c.outcome IN ('stored','unchanged') AND c.http_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299
 GROUP BY c.sha256
), expanded AS (
 SELECT r.record_sha_hex,r.source,ms.priority,f.retrieved_at,unnest(r.meetings) AS m
 FROM selected_meeting_records r
 JOIN meeting_sources ms ON ms.kind='meeting' AND r.source=ms.source
 LEFT JOIN fetch_times f ON r.record_sha_hex=f.record_sha_hex
 WHERE r.status='completed' AND r.meetings IS NOT NULL
), extracted AS (
 SELECT record_sha_hex,source,priority,retrieved_at,
  cast(m['event_id'] AS BIGINT) AS event_id,
  lower(nullif(trim(m['chamber']),'')) AS chamber,
  cast(m['congress'] AS INT) AS congress,
  cast(m['session'] AS SMALLINT) AS session,
  arrow_cast(try_cast(m['updated'] AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))') AS updated,
  nullif(trim(m['updated']),'') AS updated_literal,
  nullif(trim(m['title']),'') AS title,
  try_cast(m['meeting_date'] AS DATE) AS meeting_date,
  nullif(trim(m['meeting_type']),'') AS meeting_type,
  nullif(trim(m['status']),'') AS status,
  m['sittings'] AS sittings,
  m['committees'] AS committees,
  m['subject_keys'] AS subject_keys,
  m['transcript_jackets'] AS transcript_jackets,
  m['videos'] AS videos,
  m['document_urls'] AS document_urls,
  m['document_references'] AS document_references,
  m['collection_states'] AS collection_states,
  m['access'] AS access,
  m['access_basis'] AS access_basis,
  m['not_held'] AS not_held,
  m['title_key'] AS title_key,
  m['reschedule_candidate'] AS reschedule_candidate
 FROM expanded WHERE m['event_id'] IS NOT NULL
), ranked AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER(
  PARTITION BY event_id,source
  ORDER BY updated DESC NULLS LAST,retrieved_at DESC NULLS LAST,record_sha_hex ASC
 ) AS rn,first_value(updated) OVER(
  PARTITION BY event_id,source
  ORDER BY updated DESC NULLS LAST,retrieved_at DESC NULLS LAST,record_sha_hex ASC
 ) AS current_updated FROM extracted
), stated AS (
 SELECT *,
  coalesce(nullif(trim(collection_states['sittings']),''),CASE WHEN coalesce(array_length(sittings),0)>0 THEN 'present' ELSE 'absent' END) AS sittings_state,
  coalesce(nullif(trim(collection_states['committees']),''),CASE WHEN coalesce(array_length(committees),0)>0 THEN 'present' ELSE 'absent' END) AS committees_state,
  coalesce(nullif(trim(collection_states['subject_keys']),''),CASE WHEN coalesce(array_length(subject_keys),0)>0 THEN 'present' ELSE 'absent' END) AS subjects_state,
  coalesce(nullif(trim(collection_states['transcript_jackets']),''),CASE WHEN coalesce(array_length(transcript_jackets),0)>0 THEN 'present' ELSE 'absent' END) AS jackets_state,
  coalesce(nullif(trim(collection_states['videos']),''),CASE WHEN coalesce(array_length(videos),0)>0 THEN 'present' ELSE 'absent' END) AS videos_state,
  coalesce(nullif(trim(collection_states['document_urls']),''),CASE WHEN coalesce(array_length(document_urls),0)>0 THEN 'present' ELSE 'absent' END) AS document_urls_state
 FROM ranked WHERE updated IS NOT DISTINCT FROM current_updated
), picked AS (
 -- Congress.gov omits a collection it has none of, so an omission under a later updated replaces the list.
 -- Records sharing the current updated state no change between them: a collection the current record
 -- omits comes from the best-ranked record of that stamp that states it (ct-5kk7). Empty and
 -- unrecognized never fall back. Windows pick row numbers only: the pinned engine's first_value over
 -- a nested list drops its element metadata from the array but not the schema.
 SELECT *,
  first_value(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY event_id,source ORDER BY sittings_state='absent',rn) AS sittings_rn,
  first_value(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY event_id,source ORDER BY committees_state='absent',rn) AS committees_rn,
  first_value(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY event_id,source ORDER BY subjects_state='absent',rn) AS subjects_rn,
  first_value(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY event_id,source ORDER BY jackets_state='absent',rn) AS jackets_rn,
  first_value(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY event_id,source ORDER BY videos_state='absent',rn) AS videos_rn,
  first_value(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY event_id,source ORDER BY document_urls_state='absent',rn) AS document_urls_rn
 FROM stated
)
SELECT * FROM picked
WHERE rn=1 OR rn IN (sittings_rn,committees_rn,subjects_rn,jackets_rn,videos_rn,document_urls_rn)

specification.name: meeting_records_current
specification.sql:
-- One current record per (event, source), each collection taken from the record meeting-records-ranked
-- picked for it. The picks are rows of that materialized step, so these joins rescan nothing.
SELECT w.record_sha_hex,w.source,w.priority,w.retrieved_at,w.event_id,w.chamber,w.congress,w.session,w.updated,
 w.updated_literal,w.title,w.meeting_date,w.meeting_type,w.status,
 s.sittings,c.committees,k.subject_keys,j.transcript_jackets,v.videos,d.document_urls,d.document_references,
 w.collection_states,w.access,w.access_basis,w.not_held,w.title_key,w.reschedule_candidate,w.rn,
 s.sittings_state,c.committees_state,k.subjects_state,j.jackets_state,v.videos_state,d.document_urls_state
FROM meeting_records_ranked w
LEFT JOIN meeting_records_ranked s ON s.event_id=w.event_id AND s.source=w.source AND s.rn=w.sittings_rn
LEFT JOIN meeting_records_ranked c ON c.event_id=w.event_id AND c.source=w.source AND c.rn=w.committees_rn
LEFT JOIN meeting_records_ranked k ON k.event_id=w.event_id AND k.source=w.source AND k.rn=w.subjects_rn
LEFT JOIN meeting_records_ranked j ON j.event_id=w.event_id AND j.source=w.source AND j.rn=w.jackets_rn
LEFT JOIN meeting_records_ranked v ON v.event_id=w.event_id AND v.source=w.source AND v.rn=w.videos_rn
LEFT JOIN meeting_records_ranked d ON d.event_id=w.event_id AND d.source=w.source AND d.rn=w.document_urls_rn
WHERE w.rn=1

specification.name: meeting_records_merged
specification.sql:
WITH event_keys AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT event_id FROM meeting_records_current
), merged AS (
 SELECT k.event_id,
  coalesce(h.chamber,c.chamber) AS chamber,
  coalesce(h.congress,c.congress) AS congress,
  coalesce(h.session,c.session) AS session,
  coalesce(h.updated,c.updated) AS updated,
  c.updated AS congress_gov_updated,
  h.updated_literal AS house_xml_updated,
  c.meeting_type AS congress_gov_meeting_type,
  coalesce(h.title,c.title) AS title,
  coalesce(h.meeting_date,c.meeting_date) AS meeting_date,
  coalesce(h.meeting_type,c.meeting_type) AS meeting_type,
  -- Congress.gov leads, as for sittings; House XML (S/R/P, read from the root) fills House-only events.
  coalesce(c.status,h.status) AS status,
  -- The first source stating access decides; unknown states nothing.
  coalesce(nullif(c.access,'unknown'),nullif(h.access,'unknown'),c.access,h.access) AS access,
  CASE WHEN nullif(c.access,'unknown') IS NOT NULL THEN concat('congress_gov',c.access_basis)
       WHEN nullif(h.access,'unknown') IS NOT NULL THEN concat('house_xml',h.access_basis) END AS access_basis,
  -- A curated read found the meeting's own recording of it on its date: held, whatever the status says.
  (coalesce(c.not_held,false) OR coalesce(h.not_held,false)) AND sc.event_id IS NULL AS not_held,
  coalesce(c.title_key,h.title_key) AS title_key,
  coalesce(c.reschedule_candidate,h.reschedule_candidate) AS reschedule_candidate,
  -- Congress.gov leads for sittings and House XML fills what it lacks, because each states
  -- facts the other omits. An explicit empty or unrecognized House state still blocks fallback.
  CASE WHEN h.sittings_state IN ('empty','unrecognized') THEN NULL
       WHEN c.sittings_state='present' THEN c.sittings
       WHEN h.sittings_state='present' THEN h.sittings END AS raw_sittings,
  CASE WHEN h.sittings_state='present' THEN h.sittings[1] END AS house_sitting,
  CASE WHEN h.committees_state='present' THEN h.committees
       WHEN h.committees_state IN ('empty','unrecognized') THEN NULL
       WHEN c.committees_state='present' THEN c.committees END AS raw_committees,
  h.subject_keys AS house_subjects,
  c.subject_keys AS congress_subjects,
  c.document_references,
  CASE WHEN h.jackets_state='present' THEN h.transcript_jackets
       WHEN h.jackets_state IN ('empty','unrecognized') THEN NULL
       WHEN c.jackets_state='present' THEN c.transcript_jackets END AS raw_jackets,
  CASE WHEN h.videos_state='present' THEN h.videos
       WHEN h.videos_state IN ('empty','unrecognized') THEN NULL
       WHEN c.videos_state='present' THEN c.videos END AS raw_videos
 FROM event_keys k
 LEFT JOIN meeting_records_current h ON k.event_id=h.event_id AND h.source='house_xml'
 LEFT JOIN meeting_records_current c ON k.event_id=c.event_id AND c.source='congress_gov'
 LEFT JOIN meeting_status_conflicts sc ON k.event_id=sc.event_id
)
SELECT * FROM merged

specification.name: meetings_resolved
specification.sql:
WITH sitting_rows AS (
 SELECT event_id,house_sitting AS h,unnest(raw_sittings) AS s,
  unnest(range(0,cast(array_length(raw_sittings) AS BIGINT))) AS idx
 FROM meeting_records_merged WHERE raw_sittings IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(array_length(raw_sittings),0)>0
), sitting_fields AS (
 -- A first sitting fills each fact Congress.gov lacks from the House record, field by field.
 SELECT event_id,idx,
  nullif(trim(s['start']),'') AS start_text,
  CASE WHEN same_start THEN coalesce(nullif(trim(s['end']),''),nullif(trim(h['end']),'')) ELSE nullif(trim(s['end']),'') END AS end_text,
  CASE WHEN same_start THEN coalesce(nullif(trim(s['room']),''),nullif(trim(h['room']),'')) ELSE nullif(trim(s['room']),'') END AS room,
  CASE WHEN same_start THEN coalesce(nullif(trim(s['building']),''),nullif(trim(h['building']),'')) ELSE nullif(trim(s['building']),'') END AS building,
  CASE WHEN same_start THEN coalesce(nullif(trim(s['address']),''),nullif(trim(h['address']),'')) ELSE nullif(trim(s['address']),'') END AS address
 FROM (SELECT *,idx=0 AND try_cast(s['start'] AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)=try_cast(h['start'] AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) AS same_start FROM sitting_rows)
), sittings_agg AS (
 SELECT event_id,array_agg(named_struct(
  'start',start_ts,
  'end',end_ts,
  'place',nullif(concat_ws(', ',room,building,address),''),
  'room',room,
  'building',building,
  'address',address
 ) ORDER BY idx) AS sittings
 FROM (
  -- Computed here, not in the aggregate: a computed CASE branch in an ordered array_agg exceeds the pool.
  -- A date alone states no instant, so it must not become UTC midnight.
  SELECT *,CASE WHEN start_text LIKE '%T%' THEN arrow_cast(try_cast(start_text AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))') END AS start_ts,CASE WHEN end_text LIKE '%T%' THEN arrow_cast(try_cast(end_text AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))') END AS end_ts FROM sitting_fields
 ) GROUP BY event_id
), committee_rows AS (
 SELECT event_id,unnest(raw_committees) AS c,
  unnest(range(0,cast(array_length(raw_committees) AS BIGINT))) AS idx
 FROM meeting_records_merged WHERE raw_committees IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(array_length(raw_committees),0)>0
), meeting_committee_codes AS (
 -- Computed before the aggregate: an expression inside an ordered array_agg took 15-19 GiB RSS
 -- on 2,900 rows under a 1 GiB pool. Committee codes are normalized once, by meeting_records.py
 -- (hs* select -> hl*, hszt -> htzt); the SQL copies matched 0 of 18,183 Congress.gov and 6,287
 -- House XML codes on v21 (ct-p3ff), so the model only lowercases.
 SELECT event_id,idx,c['role'] AS role,lower(c['system_code']) AS system_code
 FROM committee_rows WHERE c['system_code'] IS NOT NULL
), committees_agg AS (
 SELECT event_id,array_agg(named_struct('system_code',system_code,'role',role) ORDER BY idx) AS committees
 FROM meeting_committee_codes GROUP BY event_id
), committee_keys AS (
 SELECT event_id,array_to_string(array_sort(array_agg(DISTINCT system_code)),';') AS committee_key
 FROM meeting_committee_codes GROUP BY event_id
), held_meeting_committees AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT m.event_id,m.congress,m.meeting_date,mc.system_code AS sys_code
 FROM meeting_records_merged m
 JOIN meeting_committee_codes mc ON mc.event_id=m.event_id
 WHERE NOT coalesce(m.not_held,false) AND m.meeting_date IS NOT NULL
 UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT m.event_id,m.congress,m.meeting_date,substr(mc.system_code,1,4)||'00' AS sys_code
 FROM meeting_records_merged m
 JOIN meeting_committee_codes mc ON mc.event_id=m.event_id
 WHERE NOT coalesce(m.not_held,false) AND m.meeting_date IS NOT NULL
   AND length(mc.system_code)=6 AND substr(mc.system_code,5,2)<>'00'
), unambiguous_committee_dates AS (
 SELECT sys_code,meeting_date,min(event_id) AS event_id,min(congress) AS congress
 FROM held_meeting_committees
 GROUP BY sys_code,meeting_date
 HAVING min(event_id)=max(event_id)
), normalized_bill_activities AS (
 SELECT
  lower(trim(a.bill_id)) AS bill_id,
  try_cast(split_part(lower(trim(a.bill_id)),'-',1) AS INT) AS bill_congress,
  lower(trim(a.system_code)) AS sys_code,
  lower(trim(a.activity_name)) AS activity_lower,
  try_cast(substr(trim(a.activity_date),1,10) AS DATE) AS activity_day
 FROM spicy_bill_committee_activities a
 WHERE a.bill_id IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.bill_id)<>''
   AND a.system_code IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.system_code)<>''
), activity_subject_rows AS (
 -- Source 2: unambiguous 1:1 (committee or parent_committee, activity_date) 'Hearings%' or 'Markup%'
 SELECT DISTINCT ucd.event_id,nba.bill_id AS subject_key
 FROM normalized_bill_activities nba
 JOIN unambiguous_committee_dates ucd
  ON ucd.meeting_date=nba.activity_day
 AND (ucd.sys_code=nba.sys_code OR (length(nba.sys_code)=6 AND substr(nba.sys_code,5,2)<>'00' AND ucd.sys_code=substr(nba.sys_code,1,4)||'00'))
 WHERE (nba.activity_lower LIKE 'hearings%' OR nba.activity_lower LIKE 'markup%')
   AND (ucd.congress IS NULL OR nba.bill_congress=ucd.congress)
), orig_bill_meeting_titles AS (
 -- Source 3: Senate/House "original bill entitled '...'" markups
 SELECT
  event_id,
  congress,
  CASE
   WHEN lower(trim(chamber)) IN ('senate','s') THEN 's'
   WHEN lower(trim(chamber)) IN ('house','h','house of representatives') THEN 'hr'
  END AS bill_type,
  trim(regexp_replace(
   regexp_replace(
    regexp_replace(
     regexp_replace(lower(trim(substr(raw_seg,11))),'\s*\([a-z0-9-]+\)','','g'),
     '^the\s+',''
    ),
    '[.,;]+$',''
   ),
   '\s+',' ','g'
  )) AS norm_title
 FROM (
  SELECT event_id,congress,chamber,
   unnest(string_to_array(
    regexp_replace(
     coalesce(title,''),
     '(?i)original\s+bills?\s+entitled[,:\s]*(?:"([^"]+)"|“([^”]+)”|¿([^¿"”]+)[¿"”]|''([^'']+)'')',
     '|||ORIG_BILL:$1$2$3$4|||',
     'g'
    ),
    '|||'
   )) AS raw_seg
  FROM meeting_records_merged
  WHERE title IS NOT NULL AND regexp_like(title,'(?i)original\s+bills?\s+entitled')
 )
 WHERE raw_seg LIKE 'ORIG_BILL:%'
), normalized_congress_bills AS (
 SELECT
  lower(trim(cb.bill_id)) AS bill_id,
  try_cast(split_part(lower(trim(cb.bill_id)),'-',1) AS INT) AS bill_congress,
  split_part(lower(trim(cb.bill_id)),'-',2) AS bill_type,
  trim(regexp_replace(
   regexp_replace(
    regexp_replace(
     regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(cb.title,'')),'\s*\([a-z0-9-]+\)','','g'),
     '^the\s+',''
    ),
    '[.,;]+$',''
   ),
   '\s+',' ','g'
  )) AS norm_title,
  trim(regexp_replace(
   regexp_replace(
    regexp_replace(
     regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(cb.short_title,'')),'\s*\([a-z0-9-]+\)','','g'),
     '^the\s+',''
    ),
    '[.,;]+$',''
   ),
   '\s+',' ','g'
  )) AS norm_short_title
 FROM spicy_congress_bills cb
 WHERE cb.bill_id IS NOT NULL AND trim(cb.bill_id)<>''
), orig_bill_subject_rows AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT ob.event_id,ncb.bill_id AS subject_key
 FROM orig_bill_meeting_titles ob
 JOIN normalized_congress_bills ncb
  ON ncb.bill_congress=ob.congress
 AND (ob.bill_type IS NULL OR ncb.bill_type=ob.bill_type)
 AND (
  ncb.norm_title=ob.norm_title
  OR ncb.norm_short_title=ob.norm_title
  OR regexp_replace(ncb.norm_title,'\s+of\s+20[0-9]{2}$','')=regexp_replace(ob.norm_title,'\s+of\s+20[0-9]{2}$','')
  OR (ncb.norm_short_title<>'' AND regexp_replace(ncb.norm_short_title,'\s+of\s+20[0-9]{2}$','')=regexp_replace(ob.norm_title,'\s+of\s+20[0-9]{2}$',''))
 )
 JOIN meeting_committee_codes mc ON mc.event_id=ob.event_id
 JOIN normalized_bill_activities nba
  ON nba.bill_id=ncb.bill_id
 AND (mc.system_code=nba.sys_code OR substr(mc.system_code,1,4)=substr(nba.sys_code,1,4))
 WHERE ob.norm_title<>''
), title_bill_candidates AS (
 -- Source 5b: explicit bill numbers in meetings.title (ignoring U.S. / D.S. abbreviations)
 SELECT
  event_id,
  cast(congress AS VARCHAR)||'-'||
   regexp_replace(lower(split_part(raw_ref,':',2)),'[^a-z]','','g')||'-'||
   trim(split_part(raw_ref,':',3)) AS bill_id
 FROM (
  SELECT event_id,congress,
   unnest(string_to_array(
    regexp_replace(
     regexp_replace(coalesce(title,''),'(?i)(?:\bU\.\s*S\.(?:\s*C\.)?|\b[A-Za-z]\.\s*S\.)','US','g'),
     '(?i)\b(H\.\s*R\.|S\.|H\.\s*J\.\s*Res\.|S\.\s*J\.\s*Res\.|H\.\s*Con\.\s*Res\.|S\.\s*Con\.\s*Res\.|H\.\s*Res\.|S\.\s*Res\.)\s*([0-9]+)\b',
     '|||BILL_REF:$1:$2|||',
     'g'
    ),
    '|||'
   )) AS raw_ref
  FROM meeting_records_merged
  WHERE congress IS NOT NULL AND title IS NOT NULL
 )
 WHERE raw_ref LIKE 'BILL_REF:%'
), title_bill_subject_rows AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT tbc.event_id,tbc.bill_id AS subject_key
 FROM title_bill_candidates tbc
 JOIN normalized_congress_bills ncb ON ncb.bill_id=tbc.bill_id
), jacket_rows AS (
 SELECT event_id,cast(unnest(raw_jackets) AS BIGINT) AS jacket
 FROM meeting_records_merged WHERE raw_jackets IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(array_length(raw_jackets),0)>0
), jackets_agg AS (
 SELECT event_id,array_sort(array_distinct(array_agg(jacket))) AS transcript_jackets
 FROM jacket_rows WHERE jacket IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_id
), nomination_jacket_subjects AS (
 -- Source 5a (jacket part): confirmation hearing nominations matched by jacketNumber / jacket_number / package_id
 SELECT DISTINCT jr.event_id,
  cast(n.congress AS VARCHAR)||'-pn-'||cast(n.number AS VARCHAR)||
  CASE
   WHEN n.part_number IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(n.part_number AS INT) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(n.part_number AS INT)<>0
    THEN '-'||regexp_replace(trim(n.part_number),'^0+','')
   ELSE ''
  END AS subject_key
 FROM jacket_rows jr
 JOIN meeting_records_merged m ON m.event_id=jr.event_id
 JOIN (
  SELECT congress,number,part_number,
   try_cast(coalesce(
    (regexp_match(chunk,'(?i)"jacket(?:_?number)?"\s*:\s*"?([0-9]+)"?'))[1],
    (regexp_match(chunk,'CHRG-[0-9]+[hsj]hrg([0-9]+)'))[1]
   ) AS BIGINT) AS jacket
  FROM (
   SELECT congress,number,part_number,
    unnest(string_to_array(hearings_json,'}')) AS chunk
   FROM spicy_nominations
   WHERE congress IS NOT NULL AND number IS NOT NULL AND hearings_json IS NOT NULL
  )
 ) n ON n.jacket=jr.jacket AND (m.congress IS NULL OR m.congress=n.congress)
 WHERE n.jacket IS NOT NULL
), subject_rows AS (
 SELECT event_id,lower(trim(unnest(house_subjects))) AS subject_key
 FROM meeting_records_merged WHERE house_subjects IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(array_length(house_subjects),0)>0
 UNION ALL
 SELECT event_id,lower(trim(unnest(congress_subjects))) AS subject_key
 FROM meeting_records_merged WHERE congress_subjects IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(array_length(congress_subjects),0)>0
 UNION ALL
 SELECT event_id,subject_key FROM activity_subject_rows
 UNION ALL
 SELECT event_id,subject_key FROM orig_bill_subject_rows
 UNION ALL
 SELECT event_id,subject_key FROM title_bill_subject_rows
 UNION ALL
 SELECT event_id,subject_key FROM nomination_jacket_subjects
), subjects_agg AS (
 SELECT event_id,array_sort(array_distinct(array_agg(subject_key))) AS subject_keys
 FROM subject_rows WHERE subject_key IS NOT NULL AND subject_key<>'' GROUP BY event_id
), video_unnested AS (
 SELECT event_id,unnest(raw_videos) AS v,
  unnest(range(0,cast(array_length(raw_videos) AS BIGINT))) AS idx
 FROM meeting_records_merged WHERE raw_videos IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(array_length(raw_videos),0)>0
), video_rows AS (
 SELECT event_id,idx,
  v['title'] AS video_title,
  v['url'] AS video_url,
  nullif(trim(v['video_key']),'') AS explicit_video_key
 FROM video_unnested
), video_matched AS (
 SELECT vr.event_id,vr.idx,vr.video_title AS name,vr.video_url AS url,
  coalesce(vr.explicit_video_key,
   min(regexp_replace((regexp_match(vr.video_url,rs.pattern))[1],'^(.+)$',rs.key_template))
  ) AS video_key
 FROM video_rows vr
 LEFT JOIN recording_sources rs ON rs.kind='video_url' AND vr.video_url IS NOT NULL AND regexp_like(vr.video_url,rs.pattern)
 GROUP BY vr.event_id,vr.idx,vr.video_title,vr.video_url,vr.explicit_video_key
), videos_agg AS (
 SELECT event_id,array_agg(named_struct(
  'name',name,'url',url,'video_key',video_key
 ) ORDER BY idx) AS videos
 FROM video_matched GROUP BY event_id
)
SELECT m.event_id,m.chamber,m.congress,m.session,m.updated,m.congress_gov_updated,m.house_xml_updated,m.congress_gov_meeting_type,m.access,m.access_basis,m.not_held,m.title_key,m.reschedule_candidate,ck.committee_key,m.title,m.meeting_date,m.meeting_type,m.status,m.document_references,
 coalesce(sa.sittings,array_slice(make_array(named_struct(
  'start',arrow_cast(NULL,'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))'),
  'end',arrow_cast(NULL,'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))'),
  'place',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'room',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'building',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'address',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR))),1,0)) AS sittings,

  'system_code',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'role',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR))),1,0)) AS committees,
 coalesce(sba.subject_keys,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')) AS subject_keys,
 coalesce(ja.transcript_jackets,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS BIGINT)),1,0),'List(Int64)')) AS transcript_jackets,

specification.name: url_normalized
specification.sql:
WITH literals AS (
 SELECT url FROM url_literals WHERE NOT reused
), first_matches AS (
 SELECT l.url,count(r.id) AS matches,
 max(CASE r.decoder WHEN 'proofpoint' THEN
   percent_decode_utf8(replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(l.url,r.pattern,r.replacement),'-([0-9A-Fa-f]{2})','%$1','g'),'_','/'))
 WHEN 'percent' THEN percent_decode_utf8(regexp_replace(l.url,r.pattern,r.replacement))
 ELSE regexp_replace(l.url,r.pattern,r.replacement) END) AS inner_url
 FROM url_rules r RIGHT JOIN literals l ON r.kind='wrapper' AND regexp_like(l.url,r.pattern)
 GROUP BY l.url
), first_pass AS (
 SELECT url,coalesce(inner_url,url) AS value,matches>1 AS conflict FROM first_matches
), second_matches AS (
 SELECT p.url,p.conflict,count(r.id) AS matches,
 max(CASE r.decoder WHEN 'proofpoint' THEN
   percent_decode_utf8(replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(p.value,r.pattern,r.replacement),'-([0-9A-Fa-f]{2})','%$1','g'),'_','/'))
 WHEN 'percent' THEN percent_decode_utf8(regexp_replace(p.value,r.pattern,r.replacement))
 ELSE regexp_replace(p.value,r.pattern,r.replacement) END) AS inner_url,max(p.value) AS prior
 FROM url_rules r RIGHT JOIN first_pass p ON r.kind='wrapper' AND regexp_like(p.value,r.pattern)
 GROUP BY p.url,p.conflict
), unwrapped AS (
 SELECT url,coalesce(inner_url,prior) AS value,conflict OR matches>1 AS conflict FROM second_matches
), serialized AS (
 SELECT u.url,u.value,u.conflict,uri_normalize_encoding(url_resolve(u.value,cast(NULL AS VARCHAR))) AS parsed,
 count(r.id)>0 AS still_wrapped FROM url_rules r
 RIGHT JOIN unwrapped u ON r.kind='wrapper' AND regexp_like(u.value,r.pattern)
 GROUP BY u.url,u.value,u.conflict
), components AS (
 SELECT *,regexp_replace((regexp_match(parsed,'^https?://([^/?#]+)'))[1],'^www\.','') AS authority,
 coalesce((regexp_match(parsed,'^https?://[^/?#]+([^?#]*)'))[1],'') AS path,
 (regexp_match(split_part(parsed,'#',1),'\?(.*)$'))[1] AS query FROM serialized
), pairs AS (
 SELECT url,authority,unnest(string_to_array(query,'&')) AS pair FROM components WHERE query<>''
), kept_pairs AS (
 SELECT p.* FROM url_rules r RIGHT ANTI JOIN pairs p ON r.kind='strip'
 AND (r.host_pattern IS NULL OR regexp_like(regexp_replace(p.authority,':[0-9]+$',''),r.host_pattern))
 AND regexp_like(split_part(p.pair,'=',1),r.pattern)
), queries AS (
 SELECT url,string_agg(pair,'&' ORDER BY pair) AS query FROM kept_pairs GROUP BY url
), base_keys AS (
 SELECT c.url,
 CASE WHEN c.conflict THEN 'wrapper_conflict'
 WHEN c.authority IS NULL THEN 'invalid_url' END AS error,c.still_wrapped,
 c.authority || regexp_replace(c.path,'/$','') ||
 coalesce('?' || q.query,'') AS base_key
 FROM queries q RIGHT JOIN components c ON c.url=q.url
 )
SELECT * FROM base_keys
UNION ALL SELECT url,error,still_wrapped,base_key FROM url_literals WHERE reused

specification.name: model_url_keys
specification.sql:
-- Requires materialized url_normalized from url-normalized.sql.
WITH mappings AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT v.base_key AS variant,c.base_key AS canonical,
 v.error AS variant_error,c.error AS canonical_error
 FROM url_variants p JOIN url_normalized v ON p.variant_url IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v.url
 JOIN url_normalized c ON p.canonical_url IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.url
), validation AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)>0 THEN 1 END AS priority FROM (SELECT input_id FROM url_inputs GROUP BY input_id HAVING count(*)>1)
 UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)>0 THEN 2 END FROM (SELECT variant FROM mappings GROUP BY variant HAVING min(canonical)<>max(canonical))
 UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)>0 THEN 3 END FROM mappings a JOIN mappings b ON a.canonical=b.variant
 UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)>0 THEN 4 END FROM mappings WHERE variant_error IS NOT NULL OR canonical_error IS NOT NULL
), checks AS (
 SELECT CASE min(priority) WHEN 1 THEN 'duplicate_input' WHEN 2 THEN 'variant_conflict'
 WHEN 3 THEN 'variant_chain' WHEN 4 THEN 'invalid_variant' END AS error FROM validation
), resolved_mappings AS (
 SELECT variant,max(canonical) AS canonical FROM mappings GROUP BY variant
), selected AS (
 SELECT i.input_id,i.url,coalesce(checks.error,b.error) AS error,
 coalesce(m.canonical,b.base_key) AS candidate,coalesce(b.still_wrapped,false) AS still_wrapped
 FROM resolved_mappings m RIGHT JOIN (
  checks CROSS JOIN url_inputs i
  LEFT JOIN url_normalized b ON i.url IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.url
 ) ON b.base_key=m.variant
)
SELECT input_id,url,CASE WHEN error IS NULL THEN candidate END AS url_key,error,still_wrapped FROM selected

specification.name: rendition_members
specification.sql:
-- Publisher memberships precede edition exclusion; fallback never uses one of
-- their source files, even when the publisher group is later rejected.
WITH publisher AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT 'publisher' AS group_kind,
 encode(sha256(json_array(p.page_body,p.context,p.group_path)),'hex') AS group_id,
 f.source_id AS source_id,f.body_sha AS body_sha,f.format AS format
 FROM source_files f JOIN publisher_links p USING(source_id)
 WHERE f.is_real_file AND p.group_path IS NOT NULL
), fallback AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT 'same_stem' AS group_kind,
 encode(sha256(json_array(d.directory_key,d.stem)),'hex') AS group_id,
 f.source_id AS source_id,f.body_sha AS body_sha,f.format AS format
 FROM publisher p RIGHT ANTI JOIN (
  formats x RIGHT ANTI JOIN (
   formats r JOIN (source_directories d JOIN source_files f ON f.source_id=d.source_id)
   ON r.kind='preference' AND r.value=f.format
  ) ON x.kind='generic_stem' AND x.value=d.stem
 ) ON p.source_id=f.source_id
 WHERE f.is_real_file AND d.directory_key IS NOT NULL AND d.stem<>''
)
SELECT * FROM publisher UNION ALL SELECT * FROM fallback

specification.name: source_linked_filename_readings
specification.sql:
-- Every completed requested-name reading, not only the canonical alternate used for display fills.
-- A final-URL source can have several requested URLs; each disagreement needs its own triage row.
WITH requested AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT source_id,requested_filename,requested_url FROM capture_sources WHERE requested_filename IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT q.source_id,q.requested_filename,q.requested_url,
 CASE WHEN f.date_token IS NOT NULL AND strpos(regexp_replace(lower(f.filename),'[\s_]+',' ','g'),'act of '||regexp_replace(lower(f.date_token),'[\s_]+',' ','g'))>0 THEN NULL ELSE f.filename_date END AS filename_date,f.congress,f.valid,
 -- Foreign Relations used opaque transcript download IDs that parse as dates.
 -- Keep the literal reading but require other evidence to date the document.
 (coalesce(f.valid,false) OR NOT (
  regexp_like(q.requested_url,'(?i)^https?://(?:www[.])?foreign[.]senate[.]gov/download/')
  AND regexp_like(q.requested_filename,'(?i)^transcript-[0-9]{8}$')
 )) AS date_eligible,
 -- Iceberg carries element field ids (document_kind is 19); the aggregated choices relation
 -- does not. Normalize the three public list fields so both sides concatenate as one type.
 arrow_cast(f.document_kind,'List(Utf8)') AS document_kind,
 arrow_cast(f.document_family,'List(Utf8)') AS document_family,
 arrow_cast(f.committee_code,'List(Utf8)') AS committee_code,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY q.source_id ORDER BY q.requested_url,q.requested_filename) AS preference
FROM requested q JOIN filename_readings f ON f.filename=q.requested_filename AND f.source_url=q.requested_url
WHERE f.catalog_version='c65e505ef8eb085e38072297aad395ca532fdc76a348a72b86f88c7734a83b09' AND f.status='completed'

specification.name: source_filename_readings
specification.sql:
-- Filename producers own typed keys; the model joins their exact admitted pair.
-- Both names (owner, 2026-11-02): a completed, nonempty shown value has precedence. Otherwise each
-- field takes the first completed linked reading that supplies it, in canonical URL/name order, and
-- keeps that supplier's name and URL. Dates eligible for selection rank before opaque aliases. Shown status/error stay separate from the per-field suppliers.
WITH own AS (
 SELECT s.source_id,
  f.* EXCLUDE(document_kind,document_family,committee_code,filename_date),
  CASE WHEN f.date_token IS NOT NULL AND strpos(regexp_replace(lower(f.filename),'[\s_]+',' ','g'),'act of '||regexp_replace(lower(f.date_token),'[\s_]+',' ','g'))>0 THEN NULL ELSE f.filename_date END AS filename_date,
  -- Normalize Iceberg element field ids before these values meet the aggregated linked choices.
  arrow_cast(f.document_kind,'List(Utf8)') AS document_kind,
  arrow_cast(f.document_family,'List(Utf8)') AS document_family,
  arrow_cast(f.committee_code,'List(Utf8)') AS committee_code
 FROM source_files s JOIN filename_readings f
  ON s.filename=f.filename AND coalesce(s.source_url,'')=f.source_url
 WHERE f.catalog_version='c65e505ef8eb085e38072297aad395ca532fdc76a348a72b86f88c7734a83b09'
), choices AS (
 -- One scan and one choices join: window the five supplying subsets together, then fold each
 -- field's first row and the canonical linked row. Separate per-field joins exhaust the pool.
 SELECT source_id,
  max(requested_filename) FILTER (WHERE preference=1) AS linked_filename,
  max(requested_url) FILTER (WHERE preference=1) AS linked_url,
  max(filename_date) FILTER (WHERE preference=1) AS linked_filename_date,
  max(congress) FILTER (WHERE preference=1) AS linked_congress,
  max(document_kind) FILTER (WHERE preference=1) AS linked_document_kind,
  max(document_family) FILTER (WHERE preference=1) AS linked_document_family,
  max(committee_code) FILTER (WHERE preference=1) AS linked_committee_code,
  max(filename_date) FILTER (WHERE date_choice=1) AS filename_date,
  max(requested_filename) FILTER (WHERE date_choice=1) AS date_name,
  max(requested_url) FILTER (WHERE date_choice=1) AS date_url,
  bool_or(valid) FILTER (WHERE date_choice=1) AS date_valid,
  bool_or(date_eligible) FILTER (WHERE date_choice=1) AS date_eligible,
  max(congress) FILTER (WHERE congress_choice=1) AS congress,
  max(requested_filename) FILTER (WHERE congress_choice=1) AS congress_name,
  max(requested_url) FILTER (WHERE congress_choice=1) AS congress_url,
  bool_or(valid) FILTER (WHERE congress_choice=1) AS congress_valid,
  max(document_kind) FILTER (WHERE kind_choice=1) AS document_kind,
  max(requested_filename) FILTER (WHERE kind_choice=1) AS kind_name,
  max(requested_url) FILTER (WHERE kind_choice=1) AS kind_url,
  max(document_family) FILTER (WHERE family_choice=1) AS document_family,
  max(requested_filename) FILTER (WHERE family_choice=1) AS family_name,
  max(requested_url) FILTER (WHERE family_choice=1) AS family_url,
  max(committee_code) FILTER (WHERE committee_choice=1) AS committee_code,
  max(requested_filename) FILTER (WHERE committee_choice=1) AS committee_name,
  max(requested_url) FILTER (WHERE committee_choice=1) AS committee_url
 FROM (
  SELECT l.*,
   CASE WHEN filename_date IS NOT NULL THEN row_number() OVER(
    PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY filename_date IS NULL,date_eligible DESC,preference) END AS date_choice,
   CASE WHEN congress IS NOT NULL THEN row_number() OVER(
    PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY congress IS NULL,preference) END AS congress_choice,
   CASE WHEN coalesce(array_length(document_kind),0)>0 THEN row_number() OVER(
    PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY coalesce(array_length(document_kind),0)=0,preference) END AS kind_choice,
   CASE WHEN coalesce(array_length(document_family),0)>0 THEN row_number() OVER(
    PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY coalesce(array_length(document_family),0)=0,preference) END AS family_choice,
   CASE WHEN coalesce(array_length(committee_code),0)>0 THEN row_number() OVER(
    PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY coalesce(array_length(committee_code),0)=0,preference) END AS committee_choice
  FROM source_linked_filename_readings l
 ) l GROUP BY source_id
)
SELECT o.source_id,o.filename,o.source_url,o.catalog_version,o.status,o.error_type,o.valid,
 o.status AS shown_status,o.error_type AS shown_error_type,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND coalesce(array_length(o.document_kind),0)>0 THEN o.document_kind ELSE l.document_kind END AS document_kind,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND coalesce(array_length(o.document_family),0)>0 THEN o.document_family ELSE l.document_family END AS document_family,

 o.date_token,o.measure_type,o.measure_number,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND o.filename_date IS NOT NULL THEN o.filename_date ELSE l.filename_date END AS filename_date,
 o.measure_keys,o.bioguide_ids,o.package_id,o.fields,
 l.linked_filename,l.linked_url,l.linked_filename_date,l.linked_congress,l.linked_document_kind,
 l.linked_document_family,l.linked_committee_code,
 -- Raw shown-name values and status remain available independently of the effective choices.
 o.filename_date AS shown_filename_date,o.congress AS shown_congress,o.document_kind AS shown_document_kind,
 o.document_family AS shown_document_family,o.committee_code AS shown_committee_code,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND o.filename_date IS NOT NULL THEN o.status WHEN l.filename_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'completed' ELSE o.status END AS filename_date_status,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND o.congress IS NOT NULL THEN o.status WHEN l.congress IS NOT NULL THEN 'completed' ELSE o.status END AS congress_status,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND coalesce(array_length(o.document_kind),0)>0 THEN o.status WHEN l.document_kind IS NOT NULL THEN 'completed' ELSE o.status END AS document_kind_status,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND coalesce(array_length(o.document_family),0)>0 THEN o.status WHEN l.document_family IS NOT NULL THEN 'completed' ELSE o.status END AS document_family_status,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND coalesce(array_length(o.committee_code),0)>0 THEN o.status WHEN l.committee_code IS NOT NULL THEN 'completed' ELSE o.status END AS committee_code_status,
 -- Whether the name supplying the value follows a published naming convention (the reading's valid).
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND o.filename_date IS NOT NULL THEN o.valid ELSE l.date_valid END AS filename_date_valid,
 (o.status='completed' AND o.filename_date IS NOT NULL) OR coalesce(l.date_eligible,false) AS filename_date_eligible,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND o.congress IS NOT NULL THEN o.valid ELSE l.congress_valid END AS congress_valid,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND o.filename_date IS NOT NULL THEN o.filename ELSE l.date_name END AS filename_date_name,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND o.filename_date IS NOT NULL THEN o.source_url ELSE l.date_url END AS filename_date_url,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND o.congress IS NOT NULL THEN o.filename ELSE l.congress_name END AS congress_name,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND o.congress IS NOT NULL THEN o.source_url ELSE l.congress_url END AS congress_url,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND coalesce(array_length(o.document_kind),0)>0 THEN o.filename ELSE l.kind_name END AS document_kind_name,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND coalesce(array_length(o.document_kind),0)>0 THEN o.source_url ELSE l.kind_url END AS document_kind_url,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND coalesce(array_length(o.document_family),0)>0 THEN o.filename ELSE l.family_name END AS document_family_name,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND coalesce(array_length(o.document_family),0)>0 THEN o.source_url ELSE l.family_url END AS document_family_url,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND coalesce(array_length(o.committee_code),0)>0 THEN o.filename ELSE l.committee_name END AS committee_code_name,
 CASE WHEN o.status='completed' AND coalesce(array_length(o.committee_code),0)>0 THEN o.source_url ELSE l.committee_url END AS committee_code_url,

-- A member's source URL is null; its container remains an attributable address.
WITH addresses AS (
 SELECT source_id,source_url AS url,false AS publisher FROM source_files WHERE source_url IS NOT NULL
 UNION SELECT source_id,context_url AS url,false AS publisher FROM capture_source_contexts WHERE context_url IS NOT NULL

 (regexp_match(url,'(?i)^https?://(?:www[.])?(?:govinfo[.]gov|gpo[.]gov)/(?:content/)?pkg/([^/?#]+)/'))[1] AS package_id,
 coalesce((regexp_match(url,'(?i)^https?://docs[.]house[.]gov/meetings/[^/]+/[^/]+/[0-9]{8}/(?:HHRG|HMKP|HMTG)?([0-9]+)(?:/|$)'))[1],
 (regexp_match(url,'(?i)^https?://(?:www[.])?congress[.]gov/[0-9]+/meeting/(?:house|senate|joint)/([0-9]+)(?:/|$)'))[1]) AS meeting_key,
 CASE WHEN regexp_like(url,'(?i)^https?://docs[.]house[.]gov/meetings/') THEN 'house'
 ELSE (regexp_match(url,'(?i)^https?://(?:www[.])?congress[.]gov/[0-9]+/meeting/(house|senate|joint)/'))[1] END AS chamber
FROM addresses

specification.name: source_annotation_publisher
specification.sql:
WITH kinds AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT l.source_id,r.basis,r.document_kind
 FROM publisher_kinds r JOIN publisher_links l ON
 (r.basis='doc_type' AND regexp_like(l.doc_type,r.pattern)) OR
 (r.basis='text' AND regexp_like(l.text,r.pattern))
), chosen_kinds AS (
 SELECT * FROM kinds k WHERE basis='doc_type' OR NOT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM kinds c WHERE c.source_id=k.source_id AND c.basis='doc_type')
), kind_arrays AS (
 SELECT source_id,array_agg(document_kind ORDER BY document_kind) AS document_kind
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT source_id,document_kind FROM chosen_kinds) GROUP BY source_id
), titled AS (
 -- Link text says what a link does; a link word ("ZIP", "here", "Download PDF") is never a title.
 SELECT l.* FROM (SELECT pattern FROM page_signals WHERE kind='link_word') g
 RIGHT ANTI JOIN (SELECT * FROM publisher_links WHERE nullif(trim(text),'') IS NOT NULL) l
 ON regexp_like(regexp_replace(trim(l.text),'\s+',' ','g'),g.pattern)
), labels AS (
 SELECT source_id,text,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY
 cast(first_good_at AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) NULLS LAST,context,page_body,link_index,split_position) AS preference
 FROM titled
)
SELECT s.source_id,k.document_kind,l.text AS listing_title FROM labels l RIGHT JOIN (
 kind_arrays k RIGHT JOIN source_files s ON s.source_id=k.source_id
) ON s.source_id=l.source_id AND l.preference=1

-- DM 7.5: page facts whose title or heading is a link word ("Download", "Email") give no reading title.
WITH link_word_texts AS (

specification.sql:
WITH packages AS (
 SELECT source_id,min(package_id) AS package_id FROM source_annotation_addresses
 WHERE package_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT publisher GROUP BY source_id
)
SELECT s.source_id,
 CASE WHEN f.document_kind_status='completed' AND coalesce(array_length(f.document_kind),0)>0
 THEN array_sort(array_distinct(f.document_kind)) ELSE coalesce(k.document_kind,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')) END AS document_kind,
 coalesce(CASE WHEN f.document_family_status='completed' THEN array_sort(array_distinct(f.document_family)) END,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')) AS document_family,
 CASE WHEN f.congress_status='completed' THEN f.congress END AS congress,
 -- A filename names a package only in GovInfo's own form (govinfo.gov/help/{bills,chrg,crpt,cprt,cdoc});
 -- a granule's part, volume or errata suffix names its package. Look-alike committee-site names
 -- (BILLS-117hr1833ih-Katko, BILLS-1171833ih, CHRG-116hhrg43625-add2) name none.
 -- A filename's bill version must be recognized by the maintained GovInfo vocabulary.
 coalesce(u.package_id,CASE WHEN f.status='completed' THEN coalesce(
  (regexp_match(f.package_id,'^(BILLS-[1-9][0-9]{0,2}(?:hr|s|hjres|sjres|hconres|sconres|hres|sres)[1-9][0-9]*(?:as|ash|ath|ats|cdh|cds|cph|cps|eah|eas|eh|enr|eph|es|fah|fph|fps|hdh|hds|ih|iph|ips|is|lth|lts|oph|ops|pap|pav|pch|pcs|pp|pwah|rah|ras|rch|rcs|rdh|rds|reah|renr|res|rfh|rfs|rh|rhuc|rih|ris|rs|rth|rts|sas|sc))$'))[1],
  (regexp_match(f.package_id,'^(CHRG-[1-9][0-9]{0,2}[hsj]hrg[0-9]+)(?:-vol[0-9]+)?(?:-pt[0-9]+)?(?:-err[0-9]*)?$'))[1],
  (regexp_match(f.package_id,'^(CRPT-[1-9][0-9]{0,2}(?:hrpt|srpt|erpt)[1-9][0-9]*)(?:-vol[0-9]+)?(?:-pt[0-9]+)?(?:-ERRATA[0-9]*)?$'))[1],
  (regexp_match(f.package_id,'^(CPRT-[1-9][0-9]{0,2}[HSJ]PRT[0-9]+)$'))[1],
  (regexp_match(f.package_id,'^(CDOC-[1-9][0-9]{0,2}(?:hdoc|sdoc|tdoc)[0-9]+)$'))[1]) END) AS package_id,
 CASE WHEN f.filename_date_status='completed' AND f.filename_date_eligible THEN f.filename_date END AS filename_date,
 CASE WHEN p.status='completed' THEN cast(p.content_date AS DATE) END AS content_date,
 coalesce(CASE WHEN p.status='completed' AND nullif(trim(p.title),'') IS NOT NULL THEN p.title END,
 CASE WHEN p.status='completed' AND nullif(trim(p.heading),'') IS NOT NULL THEN p.heading END,k.listing_title) AS title,
 coalesce(CASE WHEN p.status='completed' AND nullif(trim(p.title),'') IS NOT NULL THEN p.title END,
 CASE WHEN p.status='completed' AND nullif(trim(p.heading),'') IS NOT NULL THEN p.heading END) AS reading_title,
 k.listing_title,
 coalesce(m.meeting_keys,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')) AS meeting_keys,
 coalesce(CASE WHEN f.status='completed' THEN array_sort(array_distinct(f.measure_keys)) END,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')) AS measure_keys,
 coalesce(CASE WHEN f.status='completed' THEN array_sort(array_distinct(f.bioguide_ids)) END,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')) AS bioguide_ids,
 coalesce(c.committee_keys,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')) AS committee_keys,
 array_sort(array_distinct(array_concat(coalesce(c.chambers,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')),coalesce(m.chambers,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)'))))) AS chambers,
 coalesce(d.facts,array_slice(make_array(named_struct('field',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'value',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR))),1,0)) AS facts,f.status AS filename_status
FROM packages u RIGHT JOIN (
 source_annotation_meetings m RIGHT JOIN (
  source_annotation_facts d RIGHT JOIN (
   source_annotation_committees c RIGHT JOIN (
    source_annotation_publisher k RIGHT JOIN (
     source_annotation_pages p RIGHT JOIN (
      source_files s LEFT JOIN source_filename_readings f ON s.source_id=f.source_id
     ) ON s.body_sha=encode(p.body_sha,'hex')
    ) ON s.source_id=k.source_id
   ) ON s.source_id=c.source_id
  ) ON s.source_id=d.source_id
 ) ON s.source_id=m.source_id
) ON s.source_id=u.source_id

specification.name: saved_files
specification.sql:
-- DM 7.5 saved-file order chooses the saved body; among that body's source
-- files a named one comes first, otherwise saved-file order holds (a ZIP
-- member, whose source has no address of its own, is a first-class copy), and a
-- source with neither an address nor a member path comes last, so the published
-- address never goes blank. The body cannot change, only these rows' places. Running windows only, so the
-- plan streams (no whole-partition WindowAggExec).
WITH ranked AS (
 SELECT m.*,row_number() OVER w AS base_rank,first_value(m.body_sha) OVER w AS saved_body
 FROM formats p RIGHT JOIN (SELECT * FROM document_members WHERE is_real_file) m
  ON p.kind='preference' AND p.value=m.format
 WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY m.component ORDER BY coalesce(p.rank,2147483647),
 CASE WHEN p.rank IS NULL THEN m.format ELSE '' END,coalesce(m.exact_bytes,false) DESC,
 m.first_fetched DESC NULLS LAST,m.body_sha,m.source_id)
)
SELECT * EXCLUDE(base_rank,saved_body,is_saved_body),row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY component
 ORDER BY is_saved_body DESC,is_saved_body AND coalesce(filename,'')='',
  is_saved_body AND source_url IS NULL AND NOT coalesce(archive_member,false),base_rank) AS saved_rank
FROM (SELECT *,body_sha IS NOT DISTINCT FROM saved_body AS is_saved_body FROM ranked)

specification.name: document_packages
specification.sql:
-- GovInfo source and container addresses outrank filenames. A reviewed PDF
-- can supply a missing package when the document holds those exact bytes.
-- All non-authoritative bill candidates must agree on the measure itself.
-- Different versions of the same bill keep the existing filename order.
WITH candidates AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT s.component,1 AS evidence,s.saved_rank,
  arrow_cast(NULL,'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))') AS first_fetched,a.package_id FROM saved_files s
 JOIN source_annotation_addresses a ON s.source_id=a.source_id
 WHERE NOT a.publisher AND a.package_id IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL
 SELECT s.component,2 AS evidence,0 AS saved_rank,
  arrow_cast(s.first_fetched,'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))') AS first_fetched,a.package_id FROM saved_files s
 JOIN source_annotations a ON s.source_id=a.source_id
 WHERE a.package_id IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL
 SELECT DISTINCT pdf.component,3 AS evidence,0 AS saved_rank,
  arrow_cast(NULL,'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))') AS first_fetched,e.package_id
 FROM bill_package_evidence e
 JOIN saved_files pdf ON e.pdf_sha=pdf.body_sha AND pdf.format='pdf'
), ranked AS (
 -- Scan from least to most preferred so the last row has both the winning
 -- package and the complete bill range. Every candidate has a package ID.
 SELECT *,
  lead(package_id) OVER w AS next_package,
  min(bill_measure) OVER w AS min_bill_measure,
  max(bill_measure) OVER w AS max_bill_measure
 FROM (
  SELECT *,CASE WHEN evidence>1 AND starts_with(package_id,'BILLS-')
   THEN (regexp_match(package_id,'^(BILLS-[0-9]+[a-z]+[0-9]+)'))[1] END AS bill_measure
  FROM candidates
 )
 WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY component
  ORDER BY evidence DESC,saved_rank DESC,first_fetched DESC NULLS FIRST,package_id DESC
  ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
), preferred AS (
 SELECT component,package_id,
  coalesce(evidence>1 AND starts_with(package_id,'BILLS-') AND min_bill_measure<>max_bill_measure,false) AS bill_package_conflict
 FROM ranked WHERE next_package IS NULL
)
SELECT c.component,CASE WHEN NOT p.bill_package_conflict THEN p.package_id END AS package_id,
 coalesce(p.bill_package_conflict,false) AS bill_package_conflict
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT component FROM saved_files) c
LEFT JOIN preferred p ON c.component=p.component

-- document. document-normalized.sql shows the copy's own value and takes one of these only where
-- the copy has none; a differing value stays on that link's source annotation.
WITH linked AS (
 SELECT l.component,f.source_id,f.source_url,nullif(f.filename,'') AS filename,coalesce(t.title,a.title) AS title,

 -- The recovered body's own page title, read for these bodies only (candidate semi-join).
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT encode(p.body_sha,'hex') AS body_sha,coalesce(nullif(trim(max(p.title)),''),nullif(trim(max(p.heading)),'')) AS title
  FROM source_annotation_pages p JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT decode(body_sha,'hex') AS sha256 FROM recovered_copy_links) s ON p.body_sha=s.sha256
  WHERE p.status='completed' GROUP BY p.body_sha) t ON t.body_sha=r.body_sha
), fields AS (
 SELECT component,min(filename) AS filename,min(title) AS title,
  array_sort(array_distinct(flatten(array_agg(document_kind)))) AS document_kind,

specification.name: document_filename_facts
specification.sql:
-- A document's filename date and Congress come from every copy of its saved bytes, not only the saved
-- one: a name that follows a published convention (HHRG, HMKP, BILLS, CHRG ...; the reading's valid)
-- outranks a committee site's '<sha256>.hhrg-...' copy of one (often dated the day it was posted, a
-- day before the hearing), which outranks a plain committee-site name; then the earliest value
-- (identical bytes posted for several meetings date from the first), so neither a newer copy nor
-- crawl order re-dates the document. A date after its copy was captured or outside its Congress (a
-- truncated '-2070906') is misread and ranks below every plausible one.
-- One window pass picks both fields (one scan of the copies).
WITH copies AS (
 SELECT s.component,s.source_id,s.source_url,s.filename,s.first_fetched
 FROM saved_files s JOIN saved_files k ON k.component=s.component AND k.saved_rank=1 AND k.body_sha=s.body_sha
), named AS (
 SELECT c.*,
  CASE WHEN f.filename_date_status='completed' AND f.filename_date_eligible THEN f.filename_date END AS filename_date,
  CASE WHEN f.filename_date_valid THEN 2
   WHEN regexp_like(coalesce(f.filename_date_name,''),'(?i)^[0-9a-f]{64}[.](hhrg|hmkp|hmtg)-') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS date_convention,
  CASE WHEN f.congress_status='completed' THEN f.congress END AS congress,
  CASE WHEN f.congress_valid THEN 2
   WHEN regexp_like(coalesce(f.congress_name,''),'(?i)^[0-9a-f]{64}[.](hhrg|hmkp|hmtg)-') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS congress_convention
 FROM copies c JOIN source_filename_readings f ON f.source_id=c.source_id
), judged AS (
 SELECT *,
  (first_fetched IS NULL OR filename_date<=cast(first_fetched AS DATE))
  AND (congress IS NULL OR date_part('year',filename_date) BETWEEN 2*congress+1787 AND 2*congress+1789) AS date_plausible
 FROM named
)
SELECT component,
 max(filename_date) FILTER (WHERE date_choice=1) AS filename_date,
 max(congress) FILTER (WHERE congress_choice=1) AS congress
FROM (
 SELECT component,filename_date,congress,
  CASE WHEN filename_date IS NOT NULL THEN row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY component
   ORDER BY filename_date IS NULL,date_plausible DESC,date_convention DESC,filename_date,first_fetched NULLS LAST,source_url,filename,source_id) END AS date_choice,
  CASE WHEN congress IS NOT NULL THEN row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY component
   ORDER BY congress IS NULL,congress_convention DESC,congress,first_fetched NULLS LAST,source_url,filename,source_id) END AS congress_choice
 FROM judged
) GROUP BY component

specification.name: appearance_people
specification.sql:
-- One person key per stated appearance: family name and given name from the stated name, so two rows can be
-- judged the same person. Shared by print-to-meeting agreement and per-person witness precedence.
-- Built from the name, not name_key: a parenthetical ("(TX-27)") and everything after the first comma
-- (", M.D., M.P.H.", ", Jr.") are dropped, so credentials and districts never become keys (red-f3: Walke and
-- Marston both keyed "mph"). Honorifics, ranks, suffixes and credentials are dropped as words. A surname
-- particle belongs to the family name only before it ("Carlos Del Toro" -> del toro, carlos); a two-word
-- "Van Jackson" has no given name and the family "van jackson". Nicknames map one way to the formal name
-- (Bob -> Robert, never Barbara -> Robert).
WITH rows AS (
 SELECT r.record_sha_hex,r.source,r.event_id,nullif(trim(r.package_id),'') AS print_id,
  unnest(r.appearances) AS a,unnest(range(0,cast(array_length(r.appearances) AS BIGINT))) AS ordinal
 FROM selected_appearance_records r
 WHERE r.status='completed' AND r.appearances IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(array_length(r.appearances),0)>0
), words AS (
 SELECT record_sha_hex,source,event_id,print_id,ordinal,a['witness_type'] AS witness_type,
  array_except(string_to_array(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(split_part(regexp_replace(
    lower(coalesce(a['name'],a['name_key'],'')),'\([^)]*\)',' ','g'),',',1),'[^a-z \-]+','','g'),'[ \-]+',' ','g')),' '),
   make_array('','mr','mrs','ms','miss','mx','dr','hon','honorable','the','rev','reverend','sen','senator','rep','representative',
    'gen','general','lt','lieutenant','col','colonel','maj','major','adm','admiral','vadm','radm','ltg','mg','bg','vice','rear',
    'capt','captain','sgt','sergeant','brigadier','chief','ambassador','secretary','judge','governor','mayor','professor','prof',
    'commissioner','chairman','chairwoman','chair','ranking','member','congressman','congresswoman','delegate',
    'jr','sr','ii','iii','iv','phd','md','mph','jd','rn','mba','dvm','esq','cpa','edd','dds','mpa','mpp','msw','ret',
    'usa','usn','usaf','usmc','uscg','ussf')) AS t
 FROM rows
), keyed AS (
 SELECT *,cast(cardinality(t) AS BIGINT) AS n FROM words
), parted AS (
 SELECT *,n>=2 AND t[n-1] IN ('del','de','della','van','von','la','le','di','da','du','st','mac','mc','dos','das') AS particle FROM keyed
), named AS (
 SELECT record_sha_hex,source,event_id,print_id,ordinal,witness_type,
  CASE WHEN n=0 THEN NULL WHEN particle THEN concat(t[n-1],' ',t[n]) ELSE t[n] END AS family,
  CASE WHEN particle AND n>=3 THEN t[1] WHEN NOT particle AND n>=2 THEN t[1] END AS given
 FROM parted
)
SELECT record_sha_hex,source,event_id,print_id AS package_id,ordinal,
 coalesce(witness_type IN ('statement_for_record','member_statement'),false) AS statement,
 family,given,
 CASE given
  WHEN 'bob' THEN 'robert' WHEN 'bobby' THEN 'robert' WHEN 'rob' THEN 'robert' WHEN 'bill' THEN 'william' WHEN 'billy' THEN 'william'
  WHEN 'will' THEN 'william' WHEN 'dick' THEN 'richard' WHEN 'rick' THEN 'richard' WHEN 'rich' THEN 'richard'
  WHEN 'ted' THEN 'edward' WHEN 'ned' THEN 'edward' WHEN 'ed' THEN 'edward' WHEN 'eddie' THEN 'edward'
  WHEN 'liz' THEN 'elizabeth' WHEN 'beth' THEN 'elizabeth' WHEN 'betsy' THEN 'elizabeth' WHEN 'betty' THEN 'elizabeth' WHEN 'libby' THEN 'elizabeth'
  WHEN 'peggy' THEN 'margaret' WHEN 'maggie' THEN 'margaret' WHEN 'meg' THEN 'margaret'
  WHEN 'jim' THEN 'james' WHEN 'jimmy' THEN 'james' WHEN 'mike' THEN 'michael' WHEN 'tom' THEN 'thomas' WHEN 'tommy' THEN 'thomas'
  WHEN 'chuck' THEN 'charles' WHEN 'jack' THEN 'john' WHEN 'hank' THEN 'henry' WHEN 'joe' THEN 'joseph' WHEN 'tony' THEN 'anthony'
  WHEN 'larry' THEN 'lawrence' WHEN 'harry' THEN 'harold' WHEN 'jerry' THEN 'gerald' WHEN 'sandy' THEN 'sandra' WHEN 'kathy' THEN 'katherine'
  ELSE given END AS given_canon
FROM named
