specification.name: print_meeting_agreement
specification.sql:
-- Which meetings each print records (ct-dx22), among the meetings held on one of its days:
-- 1. When both sides list witnesses, the people decide: at least half of the shorter list (and two people
--    when both list two or more) is the same person (as in witness-precedence.sql: family name, then agreeing
--    given names).
--    A GovInfo <eventId> never vetoes (it is wrong on 29369's print) and titles are not consulted
--    ("PENDING LEGISLATION"; boilerplate Armed Services titles fit many hearings).
-- 2. Otherwise the title decides: half the shorter title's substantive words (3+ characters, not stop
--    words) shared. "U.S. Cyber Diplomacy" shares only letters with "Assessing the U.S.-Qatar Relationship".
-- When a print agrees with several same-day meetings, a meeting that did not sit (a superseded duplicate
-- such as 105066, re-entered as 105084) yields to one that did.
-- named records whether the print states this meeting's eventId (null when it states none).
WITH prints AS (
 SELECT package_id,unnest(held_dates) AS day,array_distinct(array_except(string_to_array(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(title,'')),'[^a-z0-9]+',' ','g'),'\b[a-z0-9]{1,2}\b',' ','g')),' '),make_array('','the','a','an','of','and','to','in','on','for','with','from','at','by','is','are','be','as','or','its','it','this','that','hearing','hearings','subcommittee','committee','house','us','part','examining','examine','review','oversight','markup','meeting','full'))) AS words FROM package_mods_facts
), meetings AS (
 SELECT event_id,cast(meeting_date AS VARCHAR) AS day,coalesce(not_held,false) AS not_held,array_distinct(array_except(string_to_array(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(title,'')),'[^a-z0-9]+',' ','g'),'\b[a-z0-9]{1,2}\b',' ','g')),' '),make_array('','the','a','an','of','and','to','in','on','for','with','from','at','by','is','are','be','as','or','its','it','this','that','hearing','hearings','subcommittee','committee','house','us','part','examining','examine','review','oversight','markup','meeting','full'))) AS words
 FROM meetings_resolved WHERE meeting_date IS NOT NULL
), candidates AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT p.package_id,m.event_id,m.day,m.not_held FROM prints p JOIN meetings m ON p.day=m.day
), print_people AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT package_id,family,given,given_canon FROM appearance_people
 WHERE source='mods' AND NOT statement AND family IS NOT NULL AND package_id IS NOT NULL
), meeting_people AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT event_id,family,given,given_canon FROM appearance_people
 WHERE source IN ('house_xml','congress_gov') AND NOT statement AND family IS NOT NULL AND event_id IS NOT NULL
), print_counts AS (SELECT package_id,count(*) AS n FROM print_people GROUP BY package_id
), meeting_counts AS (SELECT event_id,count(*) AS n FROM meeting_people GROUP BY event_id
), shared AS (
 -- Slim pairs only: people rows carry no titles, so the join stays small.
 SELECT c.package_id,c.event_id,count(DISTINCT concat(a.family,'|',coalesce(a.given,''))) AS n
 FROM candidates c
 JOIN print_people a ON a.package_id=c.package_id
 JOIN meeting_people b ON b.event_id=c.event_id
 -- The same person as in witness-precedence.sql: family name, then agreeing given names.
 WHERE (a.family=b.family OR (length(a.family)>=5 AND levenshtein(a.family,b.family)<=1))
  AND (a.given IS NULL OR b.given IS NULL OR a.given_canon=b.given_canon
   OR (length(a.given)>=3 AND length(b.given)>=3 AND substr(a.given,1,3)=substr(b.given,1,3))
   OR (length(a.given)=1 AND a.given=substr(b.given,1,1)) OR (length(b.given)=1 AND b.given=substr(a.given,1,1)))
 GROUP BY c.package_id,c.event_id
), titled AS (
 -- Titles are compared only for pairs where a side lists no witnesses.
 SELECT DISTINCT c.package_id,c.event_id,
  least(cardinality(p.words),cardinality(m.words))>0
   AND 2*cardinality(array_intersect(p.words,m.words))>=least(cardinality(p.words),cardinality(m.words)) AS agrees,
  cast(cardinality(array_intersect(p.words,m.words)) AS DOUBLE)/greatest(1,least(cardinality(p.words),cardinality(m.words))) AS score
 FROM candidates c
 LEFT JOIN print_counts pc ON pc.package_id=c.package_id
 LEFT JOIN meeting_counts mc ON mc.event_id=c.event_id
 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT package_id,words FROM prints) p ON p.package_id=c.package_id
 JOIN meetings m ON m.event_id=c.event_id
 WHERE pc.n IS NULL OR mc.n IS NULL
), decided AS (
 SELECT c.package_id,c.event_id,c.day,c.not_held,f.named_meetings,
  -- Half the shorter list, and at least two people when both lists have two: one shared family name is chance.
  CASE WHEN pc.n IS NOT NULL AND mc.n IS NOT NULL THEN 2*coalesce(s.n,0)>=least(pc.n,mc.n) AND coalesce(s.n,0)>=least(2,pc.n,mc.n)
   ELSE coalesce(t.agrees,false) END AS agrees,
  CASE WHEN pc.n IS NOT NULL AND mc.n IS NOT NULL THEN 'witnesses' ELSE 'title' END AS basis,
  CASE WHEN pc.n IS NOT NULL AND mc.n IS NOT NULL THEN cast(coalesce(s.n,0) AS DOUBLE)/least(pc.n,mc.n) ELSE coalesce(t.score,0) END AS score
 FROM candidates c
 JOIN package_mods_facts f ON f.package_id=c.package_id
 LEFT JOIN print_counts pc ON pc.package_id=c.package_id
 LEFT JOIN meeting_counts mc ON mc.event_id=c.event_id
 LEFT JOIN shared s ON s.package_id=c.package_id AND s.event_id=c.event_id
 LEFT JOIN titled t ON t.package_id=c.package_id AND t.event_id=c.event_id
), agreeing AS (
 -- Ordered windows (first_value), not unbounded aggregates over the partition (join audit).
 SELECT *,NOT first_value(not_held) OVER(PARTITION BY package_id,day ORDER BY not_held ASC) AS some_sat FROM decided WHERE agrees
), sat AS (
 SELECT *,first_value(score) OVER(PARTITION BY package_id,day ORDER BY score DESC) AS best FROM agreeing WHERE NOT (not_held AND some_sat)
)
-- One print records one meeting a day: of several same-day meetings that agree (a hearing and a markup of
-- the same bills, 100692 and 100693), the best match keeps it; ties stay.
SELECT package_id,event_id,basis,
 CASE WHEN coalesce(cardinality(named_meetings),0)>0 THEN array_has(named_meetings,event_id) END AS named
FROM sat WHERE score=best

specification.name: meeting_transcript_links
specification.sql:
-- A meeting's jacket names a package; a package named anywhere we hold (annotations, document
-- packages, appearance records or a capture address) links when its congress, chamber and jacket match.
-- Capture addresses are parsed per row and joined to the meetings' small jacket set before any
-- DISTINCT (AGENTS.md candidate rule): DISTINCT over all captures exhausts the aggregate memory cap.
WITH meeting_jackets AS (
 SELECT event_id,congress,chamber,meeting_date,unnest(transcript_jackets) AS jacket
 FROM meetings_resolved
 WHERE transcript_jackets IS NOT NULL
), named_packages AS (
 SELECT package_id FROM source_annotations WHERE package_id IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL
 SELECT package_id FROM document_packages WHERE package_id IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL
 SELECT nullif(trim(r.package_id),'') AS package_id
 FROM selected_appearance_records r
 WHERE r.status='completed' AND r.package_id IS NOT NULL AND trim(r.package_id)<>''
 UNION ALL
 SELECT (regexp_match(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,c.context_url,c.member_path,''),'(?i)(CHRG-[0-9]+[hsj]hrg[0-9]+)'))[1] AS package_id
 FROM captures c
 WHERE regexp_like(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,c.context_url,c.member_path,''),'(?i)CHRG-[0-9]+[hsj]hrg[0-9]+')
), parsed_packages AS (
 SELECT package_id,
  try_cast((regexp_match(package_id,'(?i)^CHRG-([0-9]+)([hsj])hrg0*([0-9]+)$'))[1] AS INT) AS congress,
  lower((regexp_match(package_id,'(?i)^CHRG-([0-9]+)([hsj])hrg0*([0-9]+)$'))[2]) AS chamber_letter,
  try_cast((regexp_match(package_id,'(?i)^CHRG-([0-9]+)([hsj])hrg0*([0-9]+)$'))[3] AS BIGINT) AS jacket
 FROM named_packages
 WHERE regexp_like(package_id,'(?i)^CHRG-[0-9]+[hsj]hrg[0-9]+$')
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.package_id,m.event_id,m.meeting_date,m.chamber
FROM parsed_packages p
JOIN meeting_jackets m ON p.congress=m.congress AND p.jacket=m.jacket
WHERE m.chamber IS NULL
   OR (m.chamber='house' AND p.chamber_letter='h')
   OR (m.chamber='senate' AND p.chamber_letter='s')
   OR (m.chamber='joint' AND p.chamber_letter='j')
UNION
SELECT package_id,event_id,meeting_date,chamber FROM meeting_mods_links

specification.name: package_meeting_links
specification.sql:
-- A package's video and print stand for a meeting only when its own print records that meeting
-- (print_meeting_agreement: held that day, the same witnesses or, without lists, an agreeing title). A jacket
-- list or a GovInfo eventId alone cannot decide: GPO puts one eventId on several same-day hearings or on the
-- wrong event (330128, 326063), and Congress.gov lists same-day jackets of other hearings (330128 -> 52109).
-- A multi-day print stands for each day's meeting. Its flat witness list supplies
-- event-level evidence only when the print covers one day and one vetted event.
WITH vetted AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT l.package_id,l.event_id
 FROM meeting_transcript_links l
 JOIN print_meeting_agreement a ON a.package_id=l.package_id AND a.event_id=l.event_id
)
SELECT v.package_id,v.event_id,
 coalesce(cardinality(f.held_dates)=1 AND count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY v.package_id)=1,false) AS witness_eligible
FROM vetted v
LEFT JOIN package_mods_facts f ON f.package_id=v.package_id

specification.name: appearance_url_inputs
specification.sql:
WITH selected_app_records AS (
        SELECT r.record_sha_hex,r.source,nullif(trim(r.declared_base),'') AS declared_base,
            r.context_url,r.appearances
        FROM selected_appearance_records r
        WHERE r.status='completed'
    ), candidate_app_shas AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT record_sha_hex FROM selected_app_records WHERE record_sha_hex IS NOT NULL
    ), distinct_capture_urls AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT encode(c.sha256,'hex') AS record_sha_hex,
            coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,c.context_url) AS source_url
        FROM captures c
        JOIN candidate_app_shas cas ON encode(c.sha256,'hex')=cas.record_sha_hex
        WHERE c.mode='fetch' AND c.complete AND c.outcome IN ('stored','unchanged')
          AND c.http_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299 AND c.sha256 IS NOT NULL
    ), app_contexts AS (
        SELECT r.record_sha_hex,r.source,r.declared_base,
            coalesce(c.source_url,r.context_url) AS source_url,
            r.appearances
        FROM selected_app_records r
        LEFT JOIN distinct_capture_urls c ON c.record_sha_hex=r.record_sha_hex
    ), with_base AS (
        SELECT source_url,appearances,
            CASE
                WHEN source_url IS NOT NULL AND declared_base IS NOT NULL
                    THEN coalesce(url_resolve(declared_base,source_url),source_url)
                ELSE source_url
            END AS resolved_base
        FROM app_contexts
    ), apps AS (
        SELECT source_url,resolved_base,unnest(appearances) AS app
        FROM with_base WHERE appearances IS NOT NULL
    ), raw_links AS (
        SELECT resolved_base,
            nullif(trim(unnest(coalesce(app['document_links'],arrow_cast(make_array(),'List(Utf8)')))),'') AS raw_link
        FROM apps
    ), raw_urls AS (
        SELECT source_url AS raw_url FROM with_base WHERE source_url IS NOT NULL
        UNION
        SELECT CASE WHEN resolved_base IS NOT NULL THEN coalesce(url_resolve(raw_link,resolved_base),raw_link) ELSE raw_link END AS raw_url
        FROM raw_links WHERE raw_link IS NOT NULL
        UNION
        SELECT raw_link AS raw_url FROM raw_links WHERE raw_link IS NOT NULL
    ), distinct_urls AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT raw_url AS url FROM raw_urls WHERE raw_url IS NOT NULL AND trim(raw_url)<>''
    ) SELECT encode(sha256(json_array(url)),'hex') AS input_id,url FROM distinct_urls

specification.name: appearance_url_normalized
specification.sql:
-- Inputs: appearance_url_inputs(input_id,url), url_rules, active url_variants(canonical_url,variant_url).
-- Literal values remain unchanged. Every error makes the join key unusable.
WITH literals AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT url FROM appearance_url_inputs
 UNION SELECT canonical_url FROM url_variants
 UNION SELECT variant_url FROM url_variants
), first_matches AS (
 SELECT l.url,count(r.id) AS matches,
 max(CASE r.decoder WHEN 'proofpoint' THEN
   percent_decode_utf8(replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(l.url,r.pattern,r.replacement),'-([0-9A-Fa-f]{2})','%$1','g'),'_','/'))
 WHEN 'percent' THEN percent_decode_utf8(regexp_replace(l.url,r.pattern,r.replacement))
 ELSE regexp_replace(l.url,r.pattern,r.replacement) END) AS inner_url
 FROM url_rules r RIGHT JOIN literals l ON r.kind='wrapper' AND regexp_like(l.url,r.pattern)
 GROUP BY l.url
), first_pass AS (
 SELECT url,coalesce(inner_url,url) AS value,matches>1 AS conflict FROM first_matches
), second_matches AS (
 SELECT p.url,p.conflict,count(r.id) AS matches,
 max(CASE r.decoder WHEN 'proofpoint' THEN
   percent_decode_utf8(replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(p.value,r.pattern,r.replacement),'-([0-9A-Fa-f]{2})','%$1','g'),'_','/'))
 WHEN 'percent' THEN percent_decode_utf8(regexp_replace(p.value,r.pattern,r.replacement))
 ELSE regexp_replace(p.value,r.pattern,r.replacement) END) AS inner_url,max(p.value) AS prior
 FROM url_rules r RIGHT JOIN first_pass p ON r.kind='wrapper' AND regexp_like(p.value,r.pattern)
 GROUP BY p.url,p.conflict
), unwrapped AS (
 SELECT url,coalesce(inner_url,prior) AS value,conflict OR matches>1 AS conflict FROM second_matches
), serialized AS (
 SELECT u.url,u.value,u.conflict,uri_normalize_encoding(url_resolve(u.value,cast(NULL AS VARCHAR))) AS parsed,
 count(r.id)>0 AS still_wrapped FROM url_rules r
 RIGHT JOIN unwrapped u ON r.kind='wrapper' AND regexp_like(u.value,r.pattern)
 GROUP BY u.url,u.value,u.conflict
), components AS (
 SELECT *,regexp_replace((regexp_match(parsed,'^https?://([^/?#]+)'))[1],'^www\.','') AS authority,
 coalesce((regexp_match(parsed,'^https?://[^/?#]+([^?#]*)'))[1],'') AS path,
 (regexp_match(split_part(parsed,'#',1),'\?(.*)$'))[1] AS query FROM serialized
), pairs AS (
 SELECT url,authority,unnest(string_to_array(query,'&')) AS pair FROM components WHERE query<>''
), kept_pairs AS (
 SELECT p.* FROM url_rules r RIGHT ANTI JOIN pairs p ON r.kind='strip'
 AND (r.host_pattern IS NULL OR regexp_like(regexp_replace(p.authority,':[0-9]+$',''),r.host_pattern))
 AND regexp_like(split_part(p.pair,'=',1),r.pattern)
), queries AS (
 SELECT url,string_agg(pair,'&' ORDER BY pair) AS query FROM kept_pairs GROUP BY url
), base_keys AS (
 SELECT c.url,
 CASE WHEN c.conflict THEN 'wrapper_conflict'
 WHEN c.authority IS NULL THEN 'invalid_url' END AS error,c.still_wrapped,
 c.authority || regexp_replace(c.path,'/$','') ||
 coalesce('?' || q.query,'') AS base_key
 FROM queries q RIGHT JOIN components c ON c.url=q.url
 )
SELECT * FROM base_keys

specification.name: appearance_url_keys
specification.sql:
-- Requires materialized appearance_url_normalized from url-normalized.sql.
WITH mappings AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT v.base_key AS variant,c.base_key AS canonical,
 v.error AS variant_error,c.error AS canonical_error
 FROM url_variants p JOIN appearance_url_normalized v ON p.variant_url IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v.url
 JOIN appearance_url_normalized c ON p.canonical_url IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.url
), validation AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)>0 THEN 1 END AS priority FROM (SELECT input_id FROM appearance_url_inputs GROUP BY input_id HAVING count(*)>1)
 UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)>0 THEN 2 END FROM (SELECT variant FROM mappings GROUP BY variant HAVING min(canonical)<>max(canonical))
 UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)>0 THEN 3 END FROM mappings a JOIN mappings b ON a.canonical=b.variant
 UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)>0 THEN 4 END FROM mappings WHERE variant_error IS NOT NULL OR canonical_error IS NOT NULL
), checks AS (
 SELECT CASE min(priority) WHEN 1 THEN 'duplicate_input' WHEN 2 THEN 'variant_conflict'
 WHEN 3 THEN 'variant_chain' WHEN 4 THEN 'invalid_variant' END AS error FROM validation
), resolved_mappings AS (
 SELECT variant,max(canonical) AS canonical FROM mappings GROUP BY variant
), selected AS (
 SELECT i.input_id,i.url,coalesce(checks.error,b.error) AS error,
 coalesce(m.canonical,b.base_key) AS candidate,coalesce(b.still_wrapped,false) AS still_wrapped
 FROM resolved_mappings m RIGHT JOIN (
  checks CROSS JOIN appearance_url_inputs i
  LEFT JOIN appearance_url_normalized b ON i.url IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.url
 ) ON b.base_key=m.variant
)
SELECT input_id,url,CASE WHEN error IS NULL THEN candidate END AS url_key,error,still_wrapped FROM selected

specification.name: senate_page_meeting_links
specification.sql:
-- Link present Senate committee hearing pages (senate_page) to canonical meetings (ct-j2yo).
-- Pages resolve by parent committee (.senate.gov host) and hearing date (page_facts.content_date,
-- bracketed [YYYY-MM-DD] in title, URL date tokens, or written Month DD, YYYY in text_head),
-- disambiguated across same-day committee meetings by witness surname overlap (with MODS / Congress.gov)
-- and substantive title/slug word overlap.
-- Empty or absent senate_page containers are excluded so they never suppress MODS witnesses.
WITH stopwords AS (
 SELECT make_array(
  '','the','a','an','of','and','to','in','on','for','with','from','at','by','is','are','be','as','or','its','it','this','that',
  'hearing','hearings','subcommittee','committee','senate','united','states','congress','washington','full','open','closed',
  'session','examine','examining','review','oversight','part','http','https','www','gov','html','htm','imo','media','doc','pdf','download','watch','live'
 ) AS sw
), senate_candidates AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT r.record_sha_hex,r.context_url,
  arrow_cast(decode(r.record_sha_hex,'hex'),'FixedSizeBinary(32)') AS sha256
 FROM selected_appearance_records r
 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT record_sha_hex FROM appearance_people WHERE source='senate_page') ap
  ON ap.record_sha_hex=r.record_sha_hex
 WHERE r.source='senate_page' AND r.status='completed'
  AND coalesce(nullif(trim(r.collection_state),''),'present')='present'
), capture_urls AS (
 SELECT sc.record_sha_hex,
  coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,c.context_url) AS source_url
 FROM captures c
 JOIN senate_candidates sc ON c.sha256=sc.sha256
 WHERE c.mode='fetch' AND c.complete AND c.outcome IN ('stored','unchanged')
  AND c.http_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299 AND c.sha256 IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY sc.record_sha_hex,coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,c.context_url)
), senate_hosts AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT
  lower((regexp_match(website_url,'(?i)^https?://(?:www[.])?([a-z0-9-]+)[.]senate[.]gov'))[1]) AS host,
  CASE WHEN lower(system_code)='jsec00' THEN 'jjec00'
   ELSE substr(lower(system_code),1,4)||'00' END AS parent_committee
 FROM spicy_committees
 WHERE parent_system_code IS NULL
  AND regexp_like(coalesce(website_url,''),'(?i)^https?://(?:www[.])?[a-z0-9-]+[.]senate[.]gov')
 UNION
 SELECT 'aging' AS host,'spag00' AS parent_committee
 UNION SELECT 'ag','ssaf00'
 UNION SELECT 'agriculture','ssaf00'
 UNION SELECT 'appropriations','ssap00'
 UNION SELECT 'armed-services','ssas00'
 UNION SELECT 'banking','ssbk00'
 UNION SELECT 'budget','ssbu00'
 UNION SELECT 'commerce','sscm00'
 UNION SELECT 'drugcaucus','scnc00'
 UNION SELECT 'energy','sseg00'
 UNION SELECT 'epw','ssev00'
 UNION SELECT 'ethics','slet00'
 UNION SELECT 'finance','ssfi00'
 UNION SELECT 'foreign','ssfr00'
 UNION SELECT 'help','sshr00'
 UNION SELECT 'hsgac','ssga00'
 UNION SELECT 'indian','slia00'
 UNION SELECT 'intelligence','slin00'
 UNION SELECT 'judiciary','ssju00'
 UNION SELECT 'rules','ssra00'
 UNION SELECT 'sbc','sssb00'
 UNION SELECT 'veterans','ssva00'
 UNION SELECT 'jec','jjec00'
), senate_pages_raw AS (
 SELECT
  sc.record_sha_hex,
  coalesce(cu.source_url,sc.context_url) AS source_url,
  sh.parent_committee,
  coalesce(pf.heading,'')||' '||coalesce(pf.title,'')||' '||
   regexp_replace(coalesce(cu.source_url,sc.context_url,''),'^https?://[^/]+/','') AS page_text,
  try_cast(pf.content_date AS DATE) AS pf_date,
  try_cast((regexp_match(coalesce(pf.title,''),'\[([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})\]'))[1] AS DATE) AS title_bracket_date,
  try_cast((regexp_match(coalesce(cu.source_url,sc.context_url,''),'/([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})(?:[^0-9]|$)'))[1] AS DATE) AS url_iso_date,
  regexp_match(coalesce(cu.source_url,sc.context_url,''),'/([0-9]{2})[/-]([0-9]{2})[/-]([0-9]{4})(?:[^0-9]|$)') AS url_mdy,
  regexp_match(coalesce(cu.source_url,sc.context_url,''),'/([0-9]{2})-([0-9]{2})-([0-9]{2})-[a-zA-Z]') AS url_mdy2,
  regexp_match(coalesce(pf.text_head,''),'(?i)\b(January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December)\s+([0-9]{1,2}),\s*([0-9]{4})\b') AS th_mdy
 FROM senate_candidates sc
 LEFT JOIN capture_urls cu ON cu.record_sha_hex=sc.record_sha_hex
 LEFT JOIN page_facts pf ON pf.body_sha=sc.sha256 AND pf.status='completed'
 JOIN senate_hosts sh ON sh.host=lower((regexp_match(coalesce(cu.source_url,sc.context_url,''),'(?i)^https?://(?:www[.])?([a-z0-9-]+)[.]senate[.]gov'))[1])
), senate_pages_grouped AS (
 SELECT
  r.record_sha_hex,
  min(r.source_url) AS source_url,
  r.parent_committee,
  min(coalesce(
   r.pf_date,
   r.title_bracket_date,
   r.url_iso_date,
   CASE WHEN r.url_mdy IS NOT NULL THEN try_cast(r.url_mdy[3]||'-'||r.url_mdy[1]||'-'||r.url_mdy[2] AS DATE) END,
   CASE WHEN r.url_mdy2 IS NOT NULL THEN try_cast('20'||r.url_mdy2[3]||'-'||r.url_mdy2[1]||'-'||r.url_mdy2[2] AS DATE) END,
   CASE WHEN r.th_mdy IS NOT NULL THEN try_cast(
    r.th_mdy[3]||'-'||
    CASE lower(r.th_mdy[1])
     WHEN 'january' THEN '01' WHEN 'february' THEN '02' WHEN 'march' THEN '03'
     WHEN 'april' THEN '04' WHEN 'may' THEN '05' WHEN 'june' THEN '06'
     WHEN 'july' THEN '07' WHEN 'august' THEN '08' WHEN 'september' THEN '09'
     WHEN 'october' THEN '10' WHEN 'november' THEN '11' WHEN 'december' THEN '12'
    END||'-'||lpad(r.th_mdy[2],2,'0') AS DATE) END
  )) AS page_date,
  min(r.page_text) AS page_text
 FROM senate_pages_raw r
 GROUP BY r.record_sha_hex,r.parent_committee
), senate_pages AS (
 SELECT
  g.record_sha_hex,
  g.source_url,
  g.parent_committee,
  g.page_date,
  array_distinct(array_except(
   string_to_array(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(lower(g.page_text),'[^a-z0-9]+',' ','g'),'\b(?:[a-z0-9]{1,2}|[0-9]+)\b',' ','g')),' '),
   sw.sw
  )) AS words,
  first_value(g.source_url) OVER (PARTITION BY g.page_date,g.parent_committee ORDER BY g.source_url ASC,g.record_sha_hex ASC)=
   first_value(g.source_url) OVER (PARTITION BY g.page_date,g.parent_committee ORDER BY g.source_url DESC,g.record_sha_hex ASC) AS single_url_on_date
 FROM senate_pages_grouped g
 CROSS JOIN stopwords sw
 WHERE g.page_date IS NOT NULL
), meeting_committee_codes AS (
 SELECT event_id,meeting_date,title,chamber,substr(lower(c['system_code']),1,4)||'00' AS parent_committee
 FROM (
  SELECT event_id,meeting_date,title,chamber,unnest(committees) AS c
  FROM meetings_resolved
  WHERE (chamber IN ('senate','joint') OR chamber IS NULL) AND meeting_date IS NOT NULL
   AND NOT coalesce(not_held,false) AND committees IS NOT NULL
 )
 WHERE c['system_code'] IS NOT NULL AND trim(c['system_code'])<>''
 UNION ALL
 SELECT event_id,meeting_date,title,chamber,substr(lower(committee_key),1,4)||'00' AS parent_committee
 FROM meetings_resolved
 WHERE (chamber IN ('senate','joint') OR chamber IS NULL) AND meeting_date IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT coalesce(not_held,false) AND committee_key IS NOT NULL AND trim(committee_key)<>''
), raw_meeting_committees AS (
 -- The JEC site and reference data use both codes for the same committee.
 -- Keep that equivalence local to page matching, including source-backed
 -- events with no stated chamber. Require corroboration for those events.
 SELECT DISTINCT event_id,meeting_date,title,chamber IS NULL AS requires_overlap,
  CASE WHEN parent_committee='jsec00' THEN 'jjec00' ELSE parent_committee END AS parent_committee
 FROM meeting_committee_codes
 WHERE chamber IS NOT NULL OR parent_committee IN ('jjec00','jsec00')
), meeting_parent_committees AS (
 SELECT
  m.event_id,
  m.meeting_date,
  m.parent_committee,
  m.requires_overlap,
  array_distinct(array_except(
   string_to_array(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(m.title,'')),'[^a-z0-9]+',' ','g'),'\b(?:[a-z0-9]{1,2}|[0-9]+)\b',' ','g')),' '),
   sw.sw
  )) AS words,
  first_value(m.event_id) OVER (PARTITION BY m.meeting_date,m.parent_committee ORDER BY m.event_id ASC,m.title ASC)=
   first_value(m.event_id) OVER (PARTITION BY m.meeting_date,m.parent_committee ORDER BY m.event_id DESC,m.title ASC) AS single_event_on_date
 FROM raw_meeting_committees m
 CROSS JOIN stopwords sw
), senate_people AS (
 SELECT record_sha_hex,array_distinct(array_agg(family)) AS families
 FROM appearance_people
 WHERE source='senate_page' AND family IS NOT NULL AND NOT statement
 GROUP BY record_sha_hex
), meeting_known_people AS (
 SELECT event_id,array_distinct(array_agg(family)) AS families
 FROM (
  SELECT pml.event_id,ap.family
  FROM package_meeting_links pml
  JOIN appearance_people ap ON ap.source='mods' AND ap.package_id=pml.package_id
  WHERE pml.witness_eligible AND ap.family IS NOT NULL AND NOT ap.statement
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ap.event_id,ap.family
  FROM appearance_people ap
  WHERE ap.source='congress_gov' AND ap.event_id IS NOT NULL AND ap.family IS NOT NULL AND NOT ap.statement
 ) p
 GROUP BY event_id
), dated_candidates AS (
 SELECT
  s.record_sha_hex,
  s.source_url,
  m.event_id,
  s.single_url_on_date,
  m.single_event_on_date,
  m.requires_overlap,
  coalesce(cast(cardinality(array_intersect(sp.families,mp.families)) AS BIGINT),cast(0 AS BIGINT)) AS shared_surnames,
  cast(cardinality(array_intersect(s.words,m.words)) AS BIGINT) AS shared_words
 FROM senate_pages s
 JOIN meeting_parent_committees m
  ON m.parent_committee=s.parent_committee AND m.meeting_date=s.page_date
 LEFT JOIN senate_people sp ON sp.record_sha_hex=s.record_sha_hex
 LEFT JOIN meeting_known_people mp ON mp.event_id=m.event_id
), dated_scored AS (
 SELECT
  record_sha_hex,
  source_url,
  event_id,
  shared_surnames,
  shared_surnames*cast(100 AS BIGINT)+shared_words AS score
 FROM dated_candidates
 WHERE (single_event_on_date AND single_url_on_date AND NOT requires_overlap)
  OR shared_surnames>0
  OR shared_words>=2
), sha_ranked AS (
 SELECT
  record_sha_hex,
  source_url,
  event_id,
  shared_surnames,
  score,
  row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY record_sha_hex ORDER BY score DESC,event_id ASC) AS sha_rn,
  lead(score) OVER (PARTITION BY record_sha_hex ORDER BY score DESC,event_id ASC) AS next_sha_score
 FROM dated_scored
), unique_sha_winners AS (
 SELECT record_sha_hex,source_url,event_id,shared_surnames,score
 FROM sha_ranked
 WHERE sha_rn=1 AND (next_sha_score IS NULL OR next_sha_score<score)
), event_ranked AS (
 SELECT
  record_sha_hex,
  source_url,
  event_id,
  shared_surnames,
  score,
  first_value(score) OVER (PARTITION BY event_id ORDER BY score DESC) AS max_event_score
 FROM unique_sha_winners
), event_top_winners AS (
 SELECT
  record_sha_hex,
  event_id,
  first_value(source_url) OVER (PARTITION BY event_id ORDER BY source_url ASC,record_sha_hex ASC)=
   first_value(source_url) OVER (PARTITION BY event_id ORDER BY source_url DESC,record_sha_hex ASC)
   OR first_value(shared_surnames) OVER (PARTITION BY event_id ORDER BY shared_surnames DESC,record_sha_hex ASC)>0 AS keep_event
 FROM event_ranked
 WHERE score=max_event_score
)
SELECT record_sha_hex,event_id
FROM event_top_winners
WHERE keep_event

specification.name: appearance_observations
specification.sql:
-- One materialized row per selected appearance record and capture context, without its appearance
-- list. appearance_records_resolved ranks these narrow rows and re-reads the lists of the selected
-- ones by (record_sha_hex,source), the selected records' key. Inlined, this chain (and its captures
-- join) was planned once per reference: six copies.
WITH candidate_appearance_shas AS (
 -- The raw binary digest, so captures probes this small candidate set instead of being the hash
 -- build (2.07M rows, 1.33 GB) behind an expression key (AGENTS.md).
 SELECT DISTINCT arrow_cast(decode(record_sha_hex,'hex'),'FixedSizeBinary(32)') AS sha256
 FROM selected_appearance_records
 WHERE record_sha_hex IS NOT NULL
), capture_contexts AS (
 SELECT
  encode(c.sha256,'hex') AS record_sha_hex,
  CASE
   WHEN coalesce(c.sniffed_format,'') NOT IN ('html','pdf','zip','vtt','m3u8')
    AND lower(coalesce(c.media_type,'')) NOT LIKE '%html%'
    AND lower(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,'')) NOT LIKE '%.html%'
    AND (c.family='congress/meetings'
     OR regexp_like(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,''),'(?i)(?:api[.]|www[.])?congress[.]gov/(?:v3/)?committee-meeting/[0-9]+/(?:house|senate|joint|nochamber)/[0-9]+')
     OR lower(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,'')) LIKE '%api.congress.gov%/committee-meeting%'
     OR lower(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,'')) LIKE '%congress.gov/committee-meeting%') THEN 'congress_gov'
   WHEN (upper(coalesce(c.url,'')) LIKE '%CHRG%'
     OR upper(coalesce(c.requested_url,'')) LIKE '%CHRG%'
     OR upper(coalesce(c.context_url,'')) LIKE '%CHRG%'
     OR upper(coalesce(c.member_path,'')) LIKE '%CHRG%')
    AND (c.family='govinfo/mods'
     OR ((lower(coalesce(c.url,'')) LIKE '%mods%'
       OR lower(coalesce(c.requested_url,'')) LIKE '%mods%'
       OR lower(coalesce(c.context_url,'')) LIKE '%mods%'
       OR lower(coalesce(c.member_path,'')) LIKE '%mods%')
      AND (coalesce(c.sniffed_format,'')='xml'
       OR lower(coalesce(c.media_type,'')) LIKE '%xml%'
       OR lower(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,'')) LIKE '%.xml%'
       OR lower(coalesce(c.context_url,'')) LIKE '%/mods%'
       OR lower(coalesce(c.member_path,'')) LIKE '%.xml%'))) THEN 'mods'
   WHEN c.member_path IS NULL
    AND coalesce(c.family,'')<>'documents'
    AND coalesce(c.sniffed_format,'') NOT IN ('pdf','xml','json','zip','vtt','m3u8')
    AND lower(coalesce(c.media_type,'')) NOT LIKE '%pdf%'
    AND lower(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,'')) NOT LIKE '%.pdf%'
    AND (c.family IN ('senate/hearings','senate/pages','senate/hearing-page')
     OR (lower(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,'')) LIKE '%.senate.gov%'
      AND (lower(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,'')) LIKE '%hearing%'
       OR lower(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,'')) LIKE '%meeting%'
       OR lower(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,'')) LIKE '%business%'))) THEN 'senate_page'
   ELSE 'house_xml'
  END AS source,
  coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,c.context_url) AS source_url,
  c.member_path,
  max(arrow_cast(try_cast(c.retrieved_at AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))')) AS retrieved_at
 FROM captures c
 JOIN candidate_appearance_shas cas ON c.sha256=cas.sha256
 WHERE c.mode='fetch' AND c.complete AND c.outcome IN ('stored','unchanged')
  AND c.http_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299 AND c.sha256 IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY c.sha256,
  CASE
   WHEN coalesce(c.sniffed_format,'') NOT IN ('html','pdf','zip','vtt','m3u8')
    AND lower(coalesce(c.media_type,'')) NOT LIKE '%html%'
    AND lower(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,'')) NOT LIKE '%.html%'
    AND (c.family='congress/meetings'
     OR regexp_like(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,''),'(?i)(?:api[.]|www[.])?congress[.]gov/(?:v3/)?committee-meeting/[0-9]+/(?:house|senate|joint|nochamber)/[0-9]+')
     OR lower(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,'')) LIKE '%api.congress.gov%/committee-meeting%'
     OR lower(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,'')) LIKE '%congress.gov/committee-meeting%') THEN 'congress_gov'
   WHEN (upper(coalesce(c.url,'')) LIKE '%CHRG%'
     OR upper(coalesce(c.requested_url,'')) LIKE '%CHRG%'
     OR upper(coalesce(c.context_url,'')) LIKE '%CHRG%'
     OR upper(coalesce(c.member_path,'')) LIKE '%CHRG%')
    AND (c.family='govinfo/mods'
     OR ((lower(coalesce(c.url,'')) LIKE '%mods%'
       OR lower(coalesce(c.requested_url,'')) LIKE '%mods%'
       OR lower(coalesce(c.context_url,'')) LIKE '%mods%'
       OR lower(coalesce(c.member_path,'')) LIKE '%mods%')
      AND (coalesce(c.sniffed_format,'')='xml'
       OR lower(coalesce(c.media_type,'')) LIKE '%xml%'
       OR lower(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,'')) LIKE '%.xml%'
       OR lower(coalesce(c.context_url,'')) LIKE '%/mods%'
       OR lower(coalesce(c.member_path,'')) LIKE '%.xml%'))) THEN 'mods'
   WHEN c.member_path IS NULL
    AND coalesce(c.family,'')<>'documents'
    AND coalesce(c.sniffed_format,'') NOT IN ('pdf','xml','json','zip','vtt','m3u8')
    AND lower(coalesce(c.media_type,'')) NOT LIKE '%pdf%'
    AND lower(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,'')) NOT LIKE '%.pdf%'
    AND (c.family IN ('senate/hearings','senate/pages','senate/hearing-page')
     OR (lower(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,'')) LIKE '%.senate.gov%'
      AND (lower(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,'')) LIKE '%hearing%'
       OR lower(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,'')) LIKE '%meeting%'
       OR lower(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,'')) LIKE '%business%'))) THEN 'senate_page'
   ELSE 'house_xml'
  END,
  coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,c.context_url),c.member_path
), meeting_updates AS (
 SELECT record_sha_hex,
  max(arrow_cast(try_cast(m['updated'] AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))')) AS updated
 FROM (
  SELECT r.record_sha_hex,unnest(r.meetings) AS m
  FROM selected_meeting_records r
  WHERE r.status='completed' AND r.meetings IS NOT NULL
 ) GROUP BY record_sha_hex
), linked_house_lists AS (
 SELECT record_sha_hex,unnest(appearances) AS a FROM selected_appearance_records
 WHERE source='house_xml' AND status='completed' AND event_id IS NULL AND appearances IS NOT NULL
), house_list_links AS (
 SELECT record_sha_hex,trim(unnest(a['document_links'])) AS link FROM linked_house_lists
), stated_list_events AS (
 -- ct-x78c: a House witness list with no meeting-id still states its event, in its own document
 -- links (/meetings/<c>/<sc>/<yyyymmdd>/<event>/) and in its retained file name (wlist/<event>.xml).
 SELECT record_sha_hex,try_cast((regexp_match(link,'(?i)/meetings/[A-Za-z0-9]+/[A-Za-z0-9]+/[0-9]{8}/([0-9]+)/'))[1] AS BIGINT) AS event_id
 FROM house_list_links
 UNION ALL
 -- Retained lists name their event only in the receipt's file path; those rows are not good fetches,
 -- so every capture row of the body counts (captures.original_path, relative paths only).
 SELECT h.record_sha_hex,try_cast((regexp_match(c.original_path,'(?i)(?:^|/)wlist/([0-9]+)[.]xml$'))[1] AS BIGINT)
 FROM captures c
 -- Join on the raw binary digest so the small candidate set prunes the captures scan (AGENTS.md).
 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT record_sha_hex,arrow_cast(decode(record_sha_hex,'hex'),'FixedSizeBinary(32)') AS sha256
  FROM selected_appearance_records
  WHERE source='house_xml' AND status='completed' AND event_id IS NULL) h ON c.sha256=h.sha256
 WHERE c.original_path IS NOT NULL
), list_events AS (
 -- One event only: links or paths that disagree state no event.
 SELECT record_sha_hex,min(event_id) AS event_id FROM stated_list_events WHERE event_id IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY record_sha_hex HAVING min(event_id)=max(event_id)
), bound_contexts AS (
 SELECT
  r.record_sha_hex,
  r.parser_version,
  r.status,
  r.error_type,
  r.source,
  ms.priority,
  u.updated,
  cc.retrieved_at,
  coalesce(cc.source_url,r.context_url) AS source_url,
  cc.member_path,
  encode(sha256(json_array(coalesce(cc.source_url,r.context_url),cc.member_path)),'hex') AS context_key,
  -- The context key before any capture context was bound: earlier witness keys hashed it (ct-kb4w).
  encode(sha256(json_array(r.context_url,cast(NULL AS VARCHAR))),'hex') AS free_context_key,
  coalesce(
   try_cast(r.event_id AS BIGINT),
   try_cast((regexp_match(coalesce(cc.source_url,r.context_url,''),'(?i)/committee-meeting/[0-9]+/(?:house|senate|joint|nochamber)/([0-9]+)'))[1] AS BIGINT),
   try_cast((regexp_match(coalesce(cc.source_url,r.context_url,''),'(?i)/meetings/[A-Za-z0-9]+/[A-Za-z0-9]+/[0-9]{8}/([0-9]+)/'))[1] AS BIGINT),
   try_cast((regexp_match(coalesce(cc.source_url,r.context_url,''),'(?i)[?&]eventid=([0-9]+)'))[1] AS BIGINT),
   le.event_id
  ) AS raw_event_id,
  coalesce(
   nullif(trim(r.package_id),''),
   (regexp_match(coalesce(cc.source_url,''),'(?i)(CHRG-[0-9]+[hsj]hrg[0-9]+)'))[1],
   (regexp_match(coalesce(cc.member_path,''),'(?i)(CHRG-[0-9]+[hsj]hrg[0-9]+)'))[1],
   (regexp_match(coalesce(r.context_url,''),'(?i)(CHRG-[0-9]+[hsj]hrg[0-9]+)'))[1]
  ) AS package_id,
  CASE WHEN r.source='senate_page' THEN coalesce(cc.source_url,r.context_url) END AS page_url,
  nullif(trim(r.declared_base),'') AS declared_base,
  CASE
   WHEN r.status<>'completed' THEN 'failed'
   -- An empty House list made before its hearing is a placeholder, not a statement that no one testified
   -- (111420's was created 2021-04-07 for a 2021-04-15 hearing), so it blocks no other source.
   WHEN r.source='house_xml' AND r.collection_state='empty' AND md.meeting_date IS NOT NULL
    AND try_cast(substr(r.created,1,10) AS DATE)<md.meeting_date THEN 'absent'
   ELSE coalesce(
    nullif(trim(r.collection_state),''),
    CASE
     WHEN coalesce(array_length(r.appearances),0)>0 THEN 'present'
     ELSE 'empty'
    END
   )
  END AS collection_state
 FROM selected_appearance_records r
 JOIN meeting_sources ms ON ms.kind='appearance' AND r.source=ms.source
 LEFT JOIN capture_contexts cc ON r.record_sha_hex=cc.record_sha_hex AND r.source=cc.source
 LEFT JOIN meeting_updates u ON r.record_sha_hex=u.record_sha_hex
 LEFT JOIN list_events le ON r.source='house_xml' AND r.record_sha_hex=le.record_sha_hex
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT event_id,meeting_date FROM meetings_resolved) md ON r.source='house_xml' AND md.event_id=r.event_id
), observations_with_occasion AS (
 SELECT
  b.*,
  CASE
   WHEN b.source IN ('house_xml','congress_gov') AND b.raw_event_id IS NOT NULL
    THEN 'meeting:'||cast(b.raw_event_id AS VARCHAR)
   WHEN b.source='mods' AND spm.event_id IS NOT NULL
    THEN 'meeting:'||cast(spm.event_id AS VARCHAR)
   WHEN b.source='mods' AND b.package_id IS NOT NULL
    THEN 'package:'||b.package_id
   WHEN b.source='senate_page' AND b.collection_state='present' AND coalesce(b.raw_event_id,spml.event_id) IS NOT NULL
    THEN 'meeting:'||cast(coalesce(b.raw_event_id,spml.event_id) AS VARCHAR)
   WHEN b.source='senate_page' AND pk.url_key IS NOT NULL
    THEN 'page:'||substr(encode(sha256(pk.url_key),'hex'),1,16)
  END AS occasion,
  -- Where a print or Senate page is filed while no meeting link holds it, so a witness key made before
  -- the link maps to the linked row (ct-kb4w).
  CASE
   WHEN b.source='mods' AND b.package_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'package:'||b.package_id
   WHEN b.source='senate_page' AND pk.url_key IS NOT NULL THEN 'page:'||substr(encode(sha256(pk.url_key),'hex'),1,16)
  END AS fallback_occasion,
  CASE
   WHEN b.source IN ('house_xml','congress_gov') THEN b.raw_event_id
   WHEN b.source='mods' THEN spm.event_id
   WHEN b.source='senate_page' AND b.collection_state='present' THEN coalesce(b.raw_event_id,spml.event_id)
  END AS event_id,
  CASE
   WHEN b.source_url IS NOT NULL AND b.declared_base IS NOT NULL
    THEN coalesce(url_resolve(b.declared_base,b.source_url),b.source_url)
   ELSE b.source_url
  END AS resolved_base
 FROM bound_contexts b
 LEFT JOIN package_meeting_links spm ON b.source='mods' AND b.package_id=spm.package_id AND spm.witness_eligible
 LEFT JOIN senate_page_meeting_links spml ON b.source='senate_page' AND b.record_sha_hex=spml.record_sha_hex
 LEFT JOIN appearance_url_keys pk ON b.source='senate_page' AND b.page_url=pk.url AND pk.error IS NULL
)
 SELECT *,
  CASE
   WHEN status<>'completed' OR collection_state IN ('failed','unrecognized') THEN 'unresolved'
   ELSE collection_state
  END AS effective_state
 FROM observations_with_occasion
 WHERE occasion IS NOT NULL

specification.name: appearance_records_resolved
specification.sql:
WITH ranked_context_observations AS (
 SELECT *,
  row_number() OVER(
   PARTITION BY occasion,source,context_key,coalesce(package_id,'')
   ORDER BY (effective_state IN ('present','empty')) DESC,(effective_state='absent') ASC,updated DESC NULLS LAST,retrieved_at DESC NULLS LAST,(effective_state='present') DESC,record_sha_hex ASC
  ) AS ctx_rn
 FROM appearance_observations
), current_context_observations AS (
 SELECT *
 FROM ranked_context_observations
 WHERE ctx_rn=1
), superseded_source_bodies AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT old.occasion,old.source,old.record_sha_hex
 FROM ranked_context_observations old
 JOIN current_context_observations cur
  ON old.occasion=cur.occasion AND old.source=cur.source AND old.context_key=cur.context_key
  AND coalesce(old.package_id,'')=coalesce(cur.package_id,'')
 WHERE old.ctx_rn>1 AND old.record_sha_hex<>cur.record_sha_hex
), ranked_source_observations AS (
 SELECT c.*,
  -- One current body per print: several prints that stand for one meeting each keep their witnesses.
  row_number() OVER(
   PARTITION BY c.occasion,c.source,coalesce(c.package_id,'')
   ORDER BY (c.effective_state IN ('present','empty')) DESC,(c.effective_state='absent') ASC,(sb.record_sha_hex IS NOT NULL) ASC,c.updated DESC NULLS LAST,c.retrieved_at DESC NULLS LAST,(c.effective_state='present') DESC,c.record_sha_hex ASC,c.context_key ASC
  ) AS obs_rn
 FROM current_context_observations c
 LEFT JOIN superseded_source_bodies sb
  ON c.occasion=sb.occasion AND c.source=sb.source AND c.record_sha_hex=sb.record_sha_hex
), current_source_observations AS (
 SELECT *
 FROM ranked_source_observations
 WHERE obs_rn=1
), ranked_sources AS (
 -- One window over the occasion, as before: the lowest code is 2*priority for a present top source and
 -- 2*priority-1 when a top-priority body states none or failed. Joins or repeated references to these
 -- rows, which carry their appearance lists, made the engine sort them again.
 SELECT *,first_value(CASE WHEN effective_state='present' THEN 2*priority ELSE 2*priority-1 END) OVER(
  PARTITION BY occasion ORDER BY CASE WHEN effective_state='present' THEN 2*priority ELSE 2*priority-1 END ASC) AS top_code
 FROM current_source_observations
 WHERE effective_state IN ('present','empty','unresolved')
), selected_observations AS (
 -- When the top-ranked source lists witnesses, every source's current body publishes and precedence is
 -- per person, not per source (red-f2): a lower row is superseded only by the same person from a
 -- higher-ranked body. A top source that states none or failed still blocks lower fallback (ct-30fp).
 SELECT * FROM ranked_sources
 WHERE effective_state='present' AND (top_code%2=0 OR 2*priority-1=top_code)
), unnested_occurrences AS (
 SELECT
  s.record_sha_hex,
  s.source,
  s.occasion,
  s.context_key,
  s.event_id,
  s.package_id,
  s.page_url,
  s.resolved_base,
  s.priority,
  unnest(r.appearances) AS a,
  unnest(range(0,cast(array_length(r.appearances) AS BIGINT))) AS ordinal
 FROM selected_observations s
 -- (record_sha_hex,source) is the selected records' key: one pinned version per body and parser.
 JOIN selected_appearance_records r ON r.record_sha_hex=s.record_sha_hex AND r.source=s.source
 WHERE r.appearances IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(array_length(r.appearances),0)>0
), extracted_occurrences AS (
 SELECT
  record_sha_hex,
  source,
  occasion,
  context_key,
  event_id,
  package_id,
  page_url,
  resolved_base,
  priority,
  ordinal,
  coalesce(nullif(trim(a['source_locator']),''),source||':witness['||cast(ordinal+1 AS VARCHAR)||']') AS source_locator,
  nullif(trim(a['name_key']),'') AS name_key,
  nullif(trim(a['name']),'') AS name,
  nullif(trim(a['honorific']),'') AS honorific,
  nullif(trim(a['given']),'') AS given,
  nullif(trim(a['middle']),'') AS middle,
  nullif(trim(a['family']),'') AS family,
  nullif(trim(a['suffix']),'') AS suffix,
  nullif(trim(a['position']),'') AS position,
  nullif(trim(a['organization']),'') AS organization,
  nullif(trim(a['on_behalf_of']),'') AS on_behalf_of,
  nullif(trim(a['location']),'') AS location,
  nullif(trim(a['panel']),'') AS panel,
  cast(a['panel_order'] AS SMALLINT) AS panel_order,
  cast(a['display_order'] AS SMALLINT) AS display_order,
  nullif(trim(a['witness_type']),'') AS witness_type,
  a['testified'] AS testified,
  nullif(trim(a['bioguide_id']),'') AS bioguide_id,
  a['document_links'] AS document_links
 FROM unnested_occurrences
), with_witness_key AS (
 SELECT
  substr(encode(sha256(json_array('witness-occurrence-v2',occasion,source,record_sha_hex,source_locator,context_key)),'hex'),1,16) AS witness_key,
  *
 FROM extracted_occurrences
), raw_link_rows AS (
 SELECT
  witness_key,
  resolved_base,
  unnest(document_links) AS raw_link,
  unnest(range(0,cast(array_length(document_links) AS BIGINT))) AS link_idx
 FROM with_witness_key
 WHERE document_links IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(array_length(document_links),0)>0
), resolved_link_rows AS (
 SELECT
  witness_key,
  link_idx,
  CASE
   WHEN resolved_base IS NOT NULL THEN url_resolve(trim(raw_link),resolved_base)
   WHEN regexp_like(trim(raw_link),'(?i)^https?://') THEN trim(raw_link)
  END AS resolved_url
 FROM raw_link_rows
 WHERE raw_link IS NOT NULL AND trim(raw_link)<>''
), aggregated_links AS (
 SELECT
  witness_key,
  array_agg(resolved_url ORDER BY link_idx) AS document_urls
 FROM resolved_link_rows
 WHERE resolved_url IS NOT NULL AND regexp_like(resolved_url,'(?i)^https?://')
 GROUP BY witness_key
)
SELECT
 w.witness_key,
 w.occasion,
 w.source,
 arrow_cast(decode(w.record_sha_hex,'hex'),'FixedSizeBinary(32)') AS record_sha,
 w.record_sha_hex,
 w.source_locator,
 w.context_key,

specification.name: witness_precedence
specification.sql:
-- Precedence per person, not per source (red-f2). On a meeting, a witness row is superseded_by the same
-- person stated by a higher-ranked body (source priority, then record digest, then ordinal). The same person:
-- the same family name (one-letter slips in names of 5+ letters), and given names that agree as written, through a
-- one-way nickname, by a shared first three letters, or as an initial; a row with no given name matches only
-- when that family name is unique among the higher rows (red-f3: Barbara and Joan Smith are not Robert and
-- John Smith). Print entries labelled statements are matched too: a statement by someone the meeting's own
-- list names is that witness. Within one record, collapse repeats when the normalized name and appearance facts agree.
-- Its own step: as a CTE it re-ran the whole appearance resolution.
WITH people AS (
 SELECT w.witness_key,w.occasion,s.priority,w.source,w.record_sha_hex,w.ordinal,w.name_key,p.statement,p.family,p.given,p.given_canon,
  sha256(json_array(w.position,w.organization,w.on_behalf_of,w.location,w.panel,w.panel_order,
   w.witness_type,w.testified,w.bioguide_id,array_sort(array_distinct(w.document_urls)))) AS occurrence_facts
 FROM appearance_records_resolved w
 JOIN meeting_sources s ON s.kind='appearance' AND s.source=w.source
 JOIN appearance_people p ON p.record_sha_hex=w.record_sha_hex AND p.source=w.source AND p.ordinal=w.ordinal
 WHERE p.family IS NOT NULL
), pairs AS (
 SELECT
  a.witness_key,
  a.given IS NULL AS open_given,
  b.witness_key AS higher,
  coalesce(b.family||'|'||substr(b.given_canon,1,3),b.witness_key) AS higher_person_key,
  first_value(b.witness_key) OVER (
   PARTITION BY a.witness_key
   ORDER BY b.priority ASC,b.record_sha_hex ASC,b.ordinal ASC
  ) AS root_higher
 FROM people a JOIN people b ON a.occasion=b.occasion
  AND ((a.occasion LIKE 'meeting:%' AND (b.priority<a.priority OR (b.priority=a.priority AND b.record_sha_hex<a.record_sha_hex)))
   -- A list can repeat a witness or list them in separate roles (ct-x78c). Keep distinct facts and statements.
   OR (b.source=a.source AND b.record_sha_hex=a.record_sha_hex AND b.ordinal<a.ordinal
    AND b.name_key=a.name_key AND b.occurrence_facts=a.occurrence_facts AND NOT a.statement AND NOT b.statement))
 WHERE (a.family=b.family OR (length(a.family)>=5 AND levenshtein(a.family,b.family)<=1))
  AND (a.given IS NULL OR b.given IS NULL OR a.given_canon=b.given_canon
   OR (length(a.given)>=3 AND length(b.given)>=3 AND substr(a.given,1,3)=substr(b.given,1,3))
   OR (length(a.given)=1 AND a.given=substr(b.given,1,1)) OR (length(b.given)=1 AND b.given=substr(a.given,1,1)))
), direct_precedence AS (
 SELECT witness_key,min(root_higher) AS superseded_by
 FROM pairs
 GROUP BY witness_key
 -- An open given name names nobody in particular when the higher rows hold several distinct people of that family.
 HAVING NOT bool_or(open_given) OR min(higher_person_key)=max(higher_person_key)
)
SELECT a.witness_key,coalesce(b.superseded_by,a.superseded_by) AS superseded_by
FROM direct_precedence a
LEFT JOIN direct_precedence b ON a.superseded_by=b.witness_key

specification.name: witness_key_current
specification.sql:
-- The published witness rows in the shape witness_key_priors is matched on (ct-kb4w). Its own step:
-- witness_key_map reads it in three joins.
SELECT
 w.witness_key,
 w.occasion,
 w.source,
 coalesce(w.package_id,'') AS package_key,
 w.record_sha_hex,
 w.source_locator,
 w.name_key,
 w.position,
 w.organization,

 w.location,
 w.panel,

 encode(sha256(json_array(w.name_key,w.position,w.organization,w.on_behalf_of,w.location,w.panel,w.witness_type,w.bioguide_id)),'hex') AS signature,
 row_number() OVER (
  PARTITION BY w.occasion,w.source,coalesce(w.package_id,''),w.name_key,w.position,w.organization,w.on_behalf_of,w.location,w.panel,w.witness_type,w.bioguide_id
  ORDER BY w.ordinal) AS repeat_rank,
 p.family,
 p.given,
 p.given_canon
FROM appearance_records_resolved w
LEFT JOIN appearance_people p ON p.record_sha_hex=w.record_sha_hex AND p.source=w.source AND p.ordinal=w.ordinal

specification.name: witness_key_priors
specification.sql:
-- Every witness key that a held observation produces but this release does not publish (ct-kb4w): a
-- superseded body or capture context at an occasion, the same occurrence filed under its print or page
-- before a meeting link held it (fallback_occasion), and the key hashed before a capture context was
-- bound (free_context_key). witness-occurrence-v2 is unchanged; these are the keys earlier releases
-- could have published. A key appears once per context of its body that produces it, filed under the
-- occasion its observation holds now.
WITH occurrences AS (
 SELECT
  o.occasion,
  o.fallback_occasion,
  o.source,
  o.record_sha_hex,
  o.context_key,
  o.free_context_key,
  coalesce(o.package_id,'') AS package_key,
  unnest(r.appearances) AS a,
  unnest(range(0,cast(array_length(r.appearances) AS BIGINT))) AS ordinal
 FROM appearance_observations o
 JOIN selected_appearance_records r ON r.record_sha_hex=o.record_sha_hex AND r.source=o.source
 WHERE o.effective_state='present' AND coalesce(array_length(r.appearances),0)>0
), extracted AS (
 SELECT
  occasion,
  fallback_occasion,
  source,
  record_sha_hex,
  context_key,
  free_context_key,
  package_key,
  ordinal,
  coalesce(nullif(trim(a['source_locator']),''),source||':witness['||cast(ordinal+1 AS VARCHAR)||']') AS source_locator,
  nullif(trim(a['name_key']),'') AS name_key,
  nullif(trim(a['position']),'') AS position,
  nullif(trim(a['organization']),'') AS organization,
  nullif(trim(a['on_behalf_of']),'') AS on_behalf_of,
  nullif(trim(a['location']),'') AS location,
  nullif(trim(a['panel']),'') AS panel,
  nullif(trim(a['witness_type']),'') AS witness_type,
  nullif(trim(a['bioguide_id']),'') AS bioguide_id
 FROM occurrences
), ranked AS (
 -- A list that names the same person twice pairs its repeats in order with the current list's repeats.
 SELECT *,
  encode(sha256(json_array(name_key,position,organization,on_behalf_of,location,panel,witness_type,bioguide_id)),'hex') AS signature,
  row_number() OVER (
   PARTITION BY record_sha_hex,source,occasion,context_key,name_key,position,organization,on_behalf_of,location,panel,witness_type,bioguide_id
   ORDER BY ordinal) AS repeat_rank
 FROM extracted
), variants AS (
 -- A variant equal to an earlier one is left out; the free variants of one body still repeat across its
 -- contexts, and witness_key_map groups them by key.
 SELECT r.*,unnest(make_array(
   named_struct('occasion',occasion,'context',context_key),
   named_struct('occasion',CASE WHEN fallback_occasion<>occasion THEN fallback_occasion END,'context',context_key),
   named_struct('occasion',CASE WHEN free_context_key<>context_key THEN occasion END,'context',free_context_key),
   named_struct('occasion',CASE WHEN fallback_occasion<>occasion AND free_context_key<>context_key THEN fallback_occasion END,
    'context',free_context_key))) AS v
 FROM ranked r
), keyed AS (
 SELECT
  substr(encode(sha256(json_array('witness-occurrence-v2',v['occasion'],source,record_sha_hex,source_locator,v['context'])),'hex'),1,16) AS old_key,
  occasion,source,package_key,record_sha_hex,source_locator,ordinal,name_key,position,organization,on_behalf_of,location,panel,
  witness_type,bioguide_id,signature,repeat_rank
 FROM variants
 WHERE v['occasion'] IS NOT NULL
), unpublished AS (
 SELECT k.*
 FROM (SELECT witness_key FROM appearance_records_resolved) w
 RIGHT ANTI JOIN keyed k ON w.witness_key=k.old_key
)
SELECT k.*,p.family,p.given,p.given_canon
FROM unpublished k
LEFT JOIN appearance_people p ON p.record_sha_hex=k.record_sha_hex AND p.source=k.source AND p.ordinal=k.ordinal

specification.name: witness_key_map
specification.sql:
-- The current witness for each key in witness_key_priors (ct-kb4w), from the strongest evidence found;
-- a name alone never maps (ct-30fp).
--  occurrence: the same body and locator, published under another occasion or context key.
--  content: at the same occasion, source and print, a row equal in name and every other stated attribute,
--   with a non-name attribute stated or the same locator. Repeats of one person pair in list order.
--  locator: at the same locator of the same occasion, source and print, an edited name of the same
--   person (family and given name as witness_precedence judges them) with every other attribute equal
--   and position, organization or Bioguide ID stated.
-- One paired candidate maps. Several candidates without a unique pair are ambiguous.
-- A lone content candidate with a different repeat rank leaves the earlier occurrence unresolved.
WITH pairs AS (
 SELECT k.old_key,c.witness_key,1 AS tier,true AS paired
 FROM witness_key_priors k
 JOIN witness_key_current c ON c.source=k.source AND c.record_sha_hex=k.record_sha_hex AND c.source_locator=k.source_locator
 UNION ALL
 SELECT k.old_key,c.witness_key,2 AS tier,k.repeat_rank=c.repeat_rank AS paired
 FROM witness_key_priors k
 JOIN witness_key_current c ON c.occasion=k.occasion AND c.source=k.source AND c.package_key=k.package_key AND c.signature=k.signature
 WHERE k.name_key IS NOT NULL
  AND (coalesce(k.position,k.organization,k.on_behalf_of,k.bioguide_id) IS NOT NULL OR c.source_locator=k.source_locator)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT k.old_key,c.witness_key,3 AS tier,true AS paired
 FROM witness_key_priors k
 JOIN witness_key_current c ON c.occasion=k.occasion AND c.source=k.source AND c.package_key=k.package_key AND c.source_locator=k.source_locator
 WHERE (k.name_key IS DISTINCT FROM c.name_key)
  AND coalesce(k.position,k.organization,k.bioguide_id) IS NOT NULL
  AND (k.position IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.position) AND (k.organization IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.organization)
  AND (k.on_behalf_of IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.on_behalf_of) AND (k.location IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.location)
  AND (k.panel IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.panel) AND (k.witness_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.witness_type)
  AND (k.bioguide_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.bioguide_id)
  AND (k.family=c.family OR (length(k.family)>=5 AND levenshtein(k.family,c.family)<=1))
  AND (k.given IS NULL OR c.given IS NULL OR k.given_canon=c.given_canon
   OR (length(k.given)>=3 AND length(c.given)>=3 AND substr(k.given,1,3)=substr(c.given,1,3))
   OR (length(k.given)=1 AND k.given=substr(c.given,1,1)) OR (length(c.given)=1 AND c.given=substr(k.given,1,1)))
), per_candidate AS (
 SELECT old_key,witness_key,min(tier) AS tier,bool_or(paired) AS paired
 FROM pairs
 GROUP BY old_key,witness_key
), best AS (
 SELECT *,min(tier) OVER (PARTITION BY old_key) AS best_tier FROM per_candidate
), decided AS (
 -- per_candidate holds one row per (old_key, witness_key), so plain counts need no count(DISTINCT).
 SELECT old_key,min(tier) AS tier,count(witness_key) AS candidates,count(witness_key) FILTER (WHERE paired) AS paired_candidates,
  min(witness_key) FILTER (WHERE paired) AS paired_key,
  array_agg(witness_key ORDER BY witness_key) AS candidate_keys
 FROM best
 WHERE tier=best_tier
 GROUP BY old_key
), olds AS (
 -- A key can come from several contexts of one body; its rows agree on all but the filing occasion.
 SELECT old_key,min(occasion) AS occasion,min(source) AS source
 FROM witness_key_priors
 GROUP BY old_key
)
SELECT
 o.old_key,
 o.occasion,
 o.source,
 CASE WHEN d.paired_candidates=1 THEN d.paired_key END AS witness_key,
 CASE
  WHEN d.paired_candidates=1 THEN 'unambiguous'
  WHEN d.candidates>1 THEN 'ambiguous'
  ELSE 'unresolved'
 END AS status,
 CASE WHEN d.paired_candidates=1 OR d.candidates>1 THEN
  CASE d.tier WHEN 1 THEN 'occurrence' WHEN 2 THEN 'content' WHEN 3 THEN 'locator' END END AS basis,
 CASE WHEN d.candidates>1 AND d.paired_candidates<>1 THEN d.candidate_keys
  ELSE arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)') END AS candidate_keys
FROM olds o
LEFT JOIN decided d ON d.old_key=o.old_key

   lower((regexp_match(n.filename,'(?i)^(?:[0-9a-f]{64}[.])?(?:HHRG|HMTG)-[0-9]+-[A-Z0-9]+-(?:Wstate|TTF|Bio)-([A-Za-z0-9''-]+)-[0-9]{8}'))[1]),
   '[^a-z0-9]','','g'
  ) AS norm_slug
 FROM saved_recoveries r
 JOIN effective_filenames n ON n.input_id='recovery:'||r.id
 JOIN document_witness_single_meeting_components smc ON smc.component=r.component
 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_witness_chrg_components c WHERE c.component=r.component)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_witness_url_matches u WHERE u.component=r.component)
  AND regexp_like(n.filename,'(?i)^(?:[0-9a-f]{64}[.])?(?:HHRG|HMTG)-[0-9]+-[A-Z0-9]+-(?:Wstate|TTF|Bio)-[A-Za-z0-9''-]+-[0-9]{8}')
), unique_family_per_event AS (
 SELECT event_id,norm_family
 FROM document_witness_meeting_witnesses
 GROUP BY event_id,norm_family
 HAVING min(witness_key)=max(witness_key)
), witness_slug_candidates AS (
 SELECT event_id,witness_key,norm_family_init AS norm_slug
 FROM document_witness_meeting_witnesses
 WHERE norm_family_init<>''
 UNION
 SELECT w.event_id,w.witness_key,w.norm_family AS norm_slug
 FROM document_witness_meeting_witnesses w
 JOIN unique_family_per_event u ON u.event_id=w.event_id AND u.norm_family=w.norm_family
 WHERE w.norm_family<>''
), unambiguous_slug_witness AS (
 SELECT event_id,norm_slug,min(witness_key) AS witness_key
 FROM witness_slug_candidates
 GROUP BY event_id,norm_slug
 HAVING min(witness_key)=max(witness_key)
), slug_matched_members AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT h.component,u.witness_key
 FROM hhrg_slugs h
 JOIN unambiguous_slug_witness u ON u.event_id=h.event_id AND u.norm_slug=h.norm_slug

)
SELECT component,witness_key FROM document_witness_url_matches
UNION

specification.name: document_witness_keys
specification.sql:
WITH canonical_expanded AS (
 SELECT component,witness_key FROM document_witness_raw_matches
 UNION
 SELECT m.component,wp.superseded_by AS witness_key
 FROM document_witness_raw_matches m
 JOIN witness_precedence wp ON wp.witness_key=m.witness_key
 WHERE wp.superseded_by IS NOT NULL
), all_matched AS (
 SELECT component,witness_key FROM canonical_expanded
 UNION
 SELECT c.component,wp.witness_key
 FROM canonical_expanded c
 JOIN witness_precedence wp ON wp.superseded_by=c.witness_key
), per_key AS (
 -- One row per (component, witness_key), so the outer counts need no count(DISTINCT): the engine
 -- holds a separate distinct-set accumulator per group for it, ~17 KB each over ~128K components.
 SELECT
  m.component,
  m.witness_key,
  bool_or(wp.superseded_by IS NULL) AS is_current,
  min(w.name) FILTER (WHERE wp.superseded_by IS NULL) AS current_name,
  min(w.name) AS any_name
 FROM all_matched m
 LEFT JOIN appearance_records_resolved w ON w.witness_key=m.witness_key
 LEFT JOIN witness_precedence wp ON wp.witness_key=m.witness_key
 GROUP BY m.component,m.witness_key
)
SELECT
 component,
 array_sort(array_distinct(array_agg(witness_key))) AS witness_keys,
 CASE
  WHEN count(witness_key) FILTER (WHERE is_current)=1
   THEN min(current_name)
  WHEN count(witness_key)=1
   THEN min(any_name)
 END AS witness_name
FROM per_key
GROUP BY component

specification.name: component_meeting_links
specification.sql:
WITH vetted_transcript_links AS (
 SELECT package_id,event_id FROM package_meeting_links
 UNION
 SELECT l.package_id,l.event_id FROM meeting_transcript_links l
 LEFT JOIN package_mods_facts f ON f.package_id=l.package_id WHERE f.package_id IS NULL
), transcript_links AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT s.component,l.event_id
 FROM saved_files s
 JOIN source_annotations a ON s.source_id=a.source_id
 LEFT JOIN document_packages pk ON s.component=pk.component
 JOIN vetted_transcript_links l ON coalesce(pk.package_id,a.package_id)=l.package_id
 UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT r.component,l.event_id
 FROM saved_recoveries r
 JOIN effective_filenames n ON n.input_id='recovery:'||r.id
 JOIN source_files f ON f.body_sha IS NULL AND f.source_url=r.original_url AND f.filename=n.filename
 JOIN source_annotations a ON f.source_id=a.source_id
 JOIN vetted_transcript_links l ON a.package_id=l.package_id
), existing_keys AS (
 SELECT m.component,try_cast(unnest(m.meeting_keys) AS BIGINT) AS event_id
 FROM document_metadata m WHERE m.meeting_keys IS NOT NULL
 UNION
 SELECT r.component,try_cast(unnest(a.meeting_keys) AS BIGINT) AS event_id
 FROM saved_recoveries r
 JOIN effective_filenames n ON n.input_id='recovery:'||r.id
 JOIN source_files f ON f.body_sha IS NULL AND f.source_url=r.original_url AND f.filename=n.filename
 JOIN source_annotations a ON f.source_id=a.source_id
 WHERE a.meeting_keys IS NOT NULL
), witness_meetings AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT dwk.component,w.event_id
 FROM (SELECT component,unnest(witness_keys) AS witness_key FROM document_witness_keys WHERE witness_keys IS NOT NULL) dwk
 JOIN appearance_records_resolved w ON w.witness_key=dwk.witness_key
 WHERE w.event_id IS NOT NULL
), all_component_meetings AS (
 SELECT component,event_id FROM transcript_links
 UNION
 SELECT component,event_id FROM existing_keys WHERE event_id IS NOT NULL
 UNION
 SELECT component,event_id FROM witness_meetings
), dated AS (
 SELECT cm.component,cm.event_id,mr.meeting_date,
  nullif(lower(trim(mr.chamber)),'') AS chamber,
  cast(mr.congress AS SMALLINT) AS congress
 FROM all_component_meetings cm
 LEFT JOIN meetings_resolved mr ON cm.event_id=mr.event_id
), meeting_committees AS (
 SELECT cm.component,nullif(lower(trim(mc.c['system_code'])),'') AS committee_key
 FROM all_component_meetings cm
 JOIN (SELECT event_id,unnest(committees) AS c FROM meetings_resolved WHERE committees IS NOT NULL) mc
  ON mc.event_id=cm.event_id
 WHERE mc.c['system_code'] IS NOT NULL AND trim(mc.c['system_code'])<>''
), committee_agg AS (
 SELECT component,
  array_sort(array_distinct(array_agg(committee_key))) AS committee_keys
 FROM meeting_committees
 WHERE committee_key IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY component
), meeting_agg AS (
 SELECT component,
  array_sort(array_distinct(array_agg(cast(event_id AS VARCHAR)))) AS meeting_keys,
  min(meeting_date) AS meeting_date,
  array_sort(array_distinct(array_agg(chamber) FILTER (WHERE chamber IS NOT NULL))) AS chambers,
  min(congress) AS congress
 FROM dated
 GROUP BY component
)
SELECT
 ma.component,
 ma.meeting_keys,
 ma.meeting_date,
 coalesce(ca.committee_keys,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')) AS committee_keys,
 coalesce(ma.chambers,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')) AS chambers,
 ma.congress
FROM meeting_agg ma
LEFT JOIN committee_agg ca ON ca.component=ma.component

specification.name: base_normalized
specification.sql:
-- A merged recovered copy's link (x, recovered-copy-fills.sql) fills only a field the copy lacks.
-- Filename date, Congress and package come from every copy (fc, pk), never only the saved one (a).
SELECT d.document_id AS doc_key,true AS body_expected,
 CASE WHEN coalesce(s.filename,'')='' THEN coalesce(x.filename,s.filename) ELSE s.filename END AS filename,
 CASE
  WHEN wk.witness_name IS NOT NULL THEN coalesce(
   CASE WHEN NOT regexp_like(trim(a.reading_title),'(?i)^(?:witness\s+(?:statement|testimony|biography)|(?:prepared|written)\s+statement|testimony|truth\s+in\s+testimony(?:\s+form|\s+disclosure(?:\s+form)?)?)$') THEN a.reading_title END,
   CASE WHEN NOT regexp_like(trim(a.listing_title),'(?i)^(?:witness\s+(?:statement|testimony|biography)|(?:prepared|written)\s+statement|testimony|truth\s+in\s+testimony(?:\s+form|\s+disclosure(?:\s+form)?)?)$') THEN a.listing_title END,
   CASE WHEN NOT regexp_like(trim(rt.title),'(?i)^(?:witness\s+(?:statement|testimony|biography)|(?:prepared|written)\s+statement|testimony|truth\s+in\s+testimony(?:\s+form|\s+disclosure(?:\s+form)?)?)$') THEN rt.title END,
   CASE WHEN NOT regexp_like(trim(x.title),'(?i)^(?:witness\s+(?:statement|testimony|biography)|(?:prepared|written)\s+statement|testimony|truth\s+in\s+testimony(?:\s+form|\s+disclosure(?:\s+form)?)?)$') THEN x.title END,
   CASE WHEN coalesce(a.reading_title,a.listing_title,rt.title,x.title) IS NOT NULL THEN coalesce(a.reading_title,a.listing_title,rt.title,x.title)||' - '||wk.witness_name END
  )
  ELSE coalesce(a.reading_title,a.listing_title,rt.title,x.title)
 END AS title,
 CASE WHEN coalesce(array_length(a.document_kind),0)=0 THEN coalesce(x.document_kind,a.document_kind) ELSE a.document_kind END AS document_kind,
 CASE WHEN coalesce(array_length(a.document_family),0)=0 THEN coalesce(x.document_family,a.document_family) ELSE a.document_family END AS document_family,
 array_sort(array_distinct(array_concat(m.committee_keys,coalesce(ml.committee_keys,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)'))))) AS committee_keys,
 array_sort(array_distinct(array_concat(m.chambers,coalesce(ml.chambers,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)'))))) AS chambers,
 cast(coalesce(fc.congress,x.congress,ml.congress) AS SMALLINT) AS congress,s.format,
 coalesce(fc.filename_date,a.content_date,ml.meeting_date,x.filename_date) AS document_date,cast(m.first_fetched AS DATE) AS first_captured,
 CASE WHEN m.first_fetched IS NOT NULL THEN 'captured' WHEN m.in_archive_since IS NOT NULL THEN 'import_day' ELSE 'unknown' END AS date_kind,
 'original' AS saved_kind,false AS hidden,
 array_sort(array_distinct(array_concat(m.meeting_keys,coalesce(ml.meeting_keys,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)'))))) AS meeting_keys,
 m.measure_keys,m.bioguide_ids,
 coalesce(wk.witness_keys,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')) AS witness_keys,
 coalesce(v.version_keys,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')) AS version_keys,
 s.body_sha AS body_hex,s.source_url,b.suffix,
 CASE s.format WHEN 'pdf' THEN 'application/pdf' WHEN 'html' THEN 'text/html' WHEN 'xml' THEN 'application/xml'
 WHEN 'json' THEN 'application/json' WHEN 'text' THEN 'text/plain' WHEN 'doc' THEN 'application/msword'
 WHEN 'docx' THEN 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'
 WHEN 'zip' THEN 'application/zip' ELSE s.media_type END AS media_type,
 b.original_size AS bytes,
 CASE WHEN fc.filename_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'filename' WHEN a.content_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'content' WHEN ml.meeting_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'meeting'
 WHEN x.filename_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'filename' END AS document_date_source,
 m.in_archive_since,cast(NULL AS DATE) AS removed_on,cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS review_note,cast(NULL AS DATE) AS review_decided_at,
 coalesce(alt.alternates,array_slice(make_array(named_struct('format',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),
 'body',arrow_cast(NULL,'FixedSizeBinary(32)'),'suffix',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'size',cast(NULL AS BIGINT))),1,0)) AS alternates,
 CASE WHEN NOT coalesce(pk.bill_package_conflict,false) THEN coalesce(pk.package_id,x.package_id) END AS package_id,
 CASE WHEN coalesce(array_length(a.facts),0)=0 THEN coalesce(x.facts,a.facts) ELSE a.facts END AS facts,bodies.link_bodies
FROM document_witness_keys wk RIGHT JOIN (
 component_meeting_links ml RIGHT JOIN (
  document_versions v RIGHT JOIN (
   document_alternates alt RIGHT JOIN (
    document_packages pk RIGHT JOIN (
     document_bodies bodies JOIN (
      body_evidence b JOIN (
       document_metadata m JOIN (
        document_identities d JOIN saved_files s ON d.component=s.component AND s.saved_rank=1
        JOIN source_annotations a ON s.source_id=a.source_id
       ) ON d.component=m.component
      ) ON s.body_sha=b.body_sha
     ) ON d.component=bodies.component
    ) ON d.component=pk.component
   ) ON d.component=alt.component
  ) ON d.component=v.component
 ) ON d.component=ml.component
) ON d.component=wk.component
LEFT JOIN document_rendition_titles rt ON d.component=rt.component
LEFT JOIN recovered_copy_fills x ON d.component=x.component
LEFT JOIN document_filename_facts fc ON d.component=fc.component
 UNION ALL SELECT d.document_id AS doc_key,false AS body_expected,n.filename,
 CASE
  WHEN wk.witness_name IS NOT NULL THEN coalesce(
   CASE WHEN NOT regexp_like(trim(t.title),'(?i)^(?:witness\s+(?:statement|testimony|biography)|(?:prepared|written)\s+statement|testimony|truth\s+in\s+testimony(?:\s+form|\s+disclosure(?:\s+form)?)?)$') THEN t.title END,
   CASE WHEN NOT regexp_like(trim(a.title),'(?i)^(?:witness\s+(?:statement|testimony|biography)|(?:prepared|written)\s+statement|testimony|truth\s+in\s+testimony(?:\s+form|\s+disclosure(?:\s+form)?)?)$') THEN a.title END,
   CASE WHEN coalesce(t.title,a.title) IS NOT NULL THEN coalesce(t.title,a.title)||' - '||wk.witness_name END
  )
  ELSE coalesce(t.title,a.title)
 END AS title,
 a.document_kind,a.document_family,
 array_sort(array_distinct(array_concat(a.committee_keys,coalesce(ml.committee_keys,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)'))))) AS committee_keys,
 array_sort(array_distinct(array_concat(a.chambers,coalesce(ml.chambers,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)'))))) AS chambers,
 cast(coalesce(a.congress,ml.congress) AS SMALLINT) AS congress,
 coalesce(b.format,'other') AS format,coalesce(a.filename_date,ml.meeting_date) AS document_date,cast(NULL AS DATE) AS first_captured,
 'import_day' AS date_kind,'recovery' AS saved_kind,false AS hidden,
 array_sort(array_distinct(array_concat(a.meeting_keys,coalesce(ml.meeting_keys,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)'))))) AS meeting_keys,
 a.measure_keys,a.bioguide_ids,
 coalesce(wk.witness_keys,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')) AS witness_keys,
 arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)') AS version_keys,
 r.body_sha AS body_hex,r.original_url AS source_url,b.suffix,
 coalesce(c.media_type,'application/octet-stream') AS media_type,r.bytes AS bytes,
 CASE WHEN a.filename_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'filename' WHEN ml.meeting_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'meeting' END AS document_date_source,
 cast(r.imported_at AS DATE) AS in_archive_since,cast(NULL AS DATE) AS removed_on,
 cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS review_note,cast(NULL AS DATE) AS review_decided_at,
 array_slice(make_array(named_struct('format',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'body',arrow_cast(NULL,'FixedSizeBinary(32)'),
 'suffix',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'size',cast(NULL AS BIGINT))),1,0) AS alternates,
 a.package_id,a.facts,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)') AS link_bodies
FROM saved_recoveries r JOIN document_identities d ON d.component=r.component AND r.saved_rank=1
JOIN effective_filenames n ON n.input_id='recovery:'||r.id
JOIN source_files f ON f.body_sha IS NULL AND f.source_url=r.original_url AND f.filename=n.filename
JOIN source_annotations a ON f.source_id=a.source_id
JOIN body_evidence b ON r.body_sha=b.body_sha
-- Only the saved recovered bodies are read from captures and page_facts (candidate semi-join).
LEFT JOIN (SELECT encode(c.sha256,'hex') AS body_sha,max(c.media_type) AS media_type
 FROM captures c JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT decode(body_sha,'hex') AS sha256 FROM saved_recoveries WHERE saved_rank=1) s ON c.sha256=s.sha256 GROUP BY c.sha256) c ON r.body_sha=c.body_sha
LEFT JOIN (SELECT encode(p.body_sha,'hex') AS body_sha,coalesce(nullif(trim(max(p.title)),''),nullif(trim(max(p.heading)),'')) AS title
 FROM source_annotation_pages p JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT decode(body_sha,'hex') AS sha256 FROM saved_recoveries WHERE saved_rank=1) s ON p.body_sha=s.sha256 WHERE p.status='completed' GROUP BY p.body_sha) t ON r.body_sha=t.body_sha
LEFT JOIN component_meeting_links ml ON d.component=ml.component
LEFT JOIN document_witness_keys wk ON d.component=wk.component
WHERE NOT d.has_real

specification.name: document_hearing_date_corrections
specification.sql:
-- A printed hearing can be refiled as an attachment to a different meeting.
-- Correct a later filename date only when the package records an earlier held
-- meeting under an agreeing title or witness list (package_meeting_links).
-- Keep filename dates that match any day in a multi-day print. Use an unknown
-- date when a reposting has several possible dates in the print.
WITH print_sittings AS (
 SELECT l.package_id,
  min(m.meeting_date) AS first_day,max(m.meeting_date) AS last_day
 FROM package_meeting_links l
 JOIN meetings_resolved m ON m.event_id=l.event_id
 WHERE NOT coalesce(m.not_held,false)
 GROUP BY l.package_id
), checked AS (
 SELECT n.doc_key,
  CASE WHEN s.first_day=s.last_day AND array_length(f.held_dates)=1 THEN s.first_day END AS hearing_date
 FROM print_sittings s JOIN package_mods_facts f ON f.package_id=s.package_id
 JOIN base_normalized n ON n.package_id=s.package_id
 WHERE n.document_date_source='filename' AND n.document_date>s.last_day
  AND regexp_like(n.package_id,'(?i)^CHRG-[0-9]+[hsj]hrg[0-9]+$')
  AND NOT coalesce(array_has(f.held_dates,cast(n.document_date AS VARCHAR)),false)
)
SELECT doc_key,hearing_date AS document_date,
 CASE WHEN hearing_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'meeting' END AS document_date_source
FROM checked
UNION ALL
SELECT n.doc_key,
 CASE WHEN array_has(f.held_dates,v.cover_day) AND (v.event_id IS NULL OR m.event_id IS NOT NULL)
  THEN cast(v.cover_day AS DATE) END AS document_date,
 CASE WHEN array_has(f.held_dates,v.cover_day) AND (v.event_id IS NULL OR m.event_id IS NOT NULL)
  THEN CASE WHEN v.event_id IS NULL THEN 'content' ELSE 'meeting' END END AS document_date_source
-- ct-cxc5: independently checked GovInfo covers. Bind the evidence to the printed bytes.
-- The September print also has a vetted September event. The other attachments establish
-- the dates of their own events and remain linked, even though the print covers differ.
FROM (VALUES
 ('CHRG-112hhrg68347','09bd414d3340e2460f48c6894ebdea0d3ee2420456ec1fde19a2e8f75f59a81f','2011-09-22',cast(103921 AS BIGINT)),
 ('CHRG-112hhrg80849','a600af79338071e29eba24fcb61977e89635fc0e6c1de7948013cddb3fe95749','2012-06-25',cast(NULL AS BIGINT)),
 ('CHRG-113hhrg82590','dc3e89f2578626fda386ab7fc85ae735dbeee8b69d6b2801b504b7ba7a88bc56','2013-05-09',cast(NULL AS BIGINT))
) v(package_id,body_hex,cover_day,event_id)
JOIN base_normalized n ON n.package_id=v.package_id AND n.body_hex=v.body_hex
LEFT JOIN package_mods_facts f ON f.package_id=v.package_id
LEFT JOIN package_meeting_links l ON l.package_id=v.package_id AND l.event_id=v.event_id
LEFT JOIN meetings_resolved m ON m.event_id=l.event_id AND m.meeting_date=cast(v.cover_day AS DATE)
 AND NOT coalesce(m.not_held,false)
WHERE n.document_date_source='meeting' AND n.document_date<>cast(v.cover_day AS DATE)

specification.name: page_metadata_values
specification.sql:
-- One row per declared string fact: field `fact:<name> <JSON Pointer>` = the literal value.
-- Dates follow adapters/common.reported_time: the stated local date, no zone conversion,
-- date-only stays day precision; anything else (20250401, RFC 2822, day 30 of February) has no date.
WITH entries AS (
 SELECT body_sha,body_hex,unnest(fields) AS f FROM html_metadata_readings
), facts AS (
 SELECT body_sha,body_hex,substr(f['field'],6) AS named,f['value'] AS value FROM entries WHERE starts_with(f['field'],'fact:')
), parsed AS (
 -- The engine's regexp_match omits groups that did not take part, so each part is read on its own.
 SELECT body_sha,body_hex,split_part(named,' ',1) AS field,substr(named,strpos(named,' ')+1) AS path,value,
  trim(value) AS v FROM facts
), shaped AS (
 SELECT *,regexp_like(v,'^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(?:[T ][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(?::[0-9]{2}(?:[.][0-9]+)?)?(?:Z|[+-][0-9]{2}(?::?[0-9]{2})?)?)?$') AS shaped,
  length(v)>10 AS clock,regexp_like(v,'^.{10}[T ][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}') AS seconds
 FROM parsed
), dated AS (
 -- The shape fixes two-digit parts, so they compare as text: no cast (the engine evaluates
 -- casts on rows a CASE would skip).
 SELECT *,CASE WHEN shaped AND field IN ('published_time','modified_time')
   AND (NOT clock OR (substr(v,12,2)<'24' AND substr(v,15,2)<'60' AND (NOT seconds OR substr(v,18,2)<'60')
     AND NOT regexp_like(substr(v,17),'[+-](?:2[4-9]|[3-9][0-9])(?::?[0-9]{2})?$')))
   THEN try_cast(substr(v,1,10) AS DATE) END AS stated_date
 FROM shaped
)
SELECT body_sha,body_hex,field,value,path,
 CASE WHEN starts_with(path,'/formats/') THEN split_part(path,'/',3) ELSE split_part(path,'/',2) END AS format,
 stated_date AS date,
 CASE WHEN stated_date IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NOT clock THEN 'day' WHEN seconds THEN 'second' ELSE 'minute' END AS precision
FROM dated

specification.name: page_dates
specification.sql:
-- A page's declared dates, per body: the first valid value by registry format rank, then pointer.
WITH ranked AS (
 SELECT v.body_sha,v.field,v.date,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY v.body_sha,v.field
   ORDER BY coalesce(r.number,99),v.path) AS choice,v.path
 FROM page_metadata_values v LEFT JOIN page_signals r ON r.kind='date_format' AND regexp_like(v.format,r.pattern)
 WHERE v.field IN ('published_time','modified_time') AND v.date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT body_sha,
 max(CASE WHEN field='published_time' THEN date END) AS published_on,
 max(CASE WHEN field='published_time' THEN path END) AS published_path,
 max(CASE WHEN field='modified_time' THEN date END) AS modified_on,
 max(CASE WHEN field='modified_time' THEN path END) AS modified_path
FROM ranked WHERE choice=1 GROUP BY body_sha
