specification.name: page_descriptions
specification.sql:
-- The publisher's page summary per html document, never the title or the site's own description.
-- Rejected: empty, equal to <title> or a declared site name (trim, casefold), declared on a JSON-LD
-- site node, a registry site template, or repeated across at least the registry threshold of
-- distinct bodies on one host. Kept values order by registry format rank, then pointer.
WITH docs AS (
 SELECT doc_key,arrow_cast(decode(body_hex,'hex'),'FixedSizeBinary(32)') AS body_sha,
  coalesce(regexp_replace(lower(array_element(regexp_match(source_url,'^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*://([^/?#:]*)'),1)),'^www[.]',''),'') AS host
 FROM base_normalized WHERE format='html' AND body_hex IS NOT NULL
), described AS (
 SELECT v.body_sha,v.value,v.path,v.format,lower(trim(v.value)) AS folded,
  regexp_replace(v.path,'/description(/[0-9]+)?$','') AS node
 FROM page_metadata_values v WHERE v.field='description'
), site_nodes AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT v.body_sha,regexp_replace(v.path,'/@type(/[0-9]+)?$','') AS node
 FROM page_metadata_values v JOIN page_signals s ON s.kind='site_node_type' AND regexp_like(v.value,s.pattern)
 WHERE v.field='declared_type'
), names AS (
 SELECT body_sha,lower(trim(value)) AS folded FROM page_metadata_values WHERE field='site_name'
 UNION SELECT body_sha,lower(trim(title)) FROM html_metadata_readings WHERE title IS NOT NULL
), repeats AS (
 SELECT host,folded,count(*) AS bodies FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.host,x.folded,d.body_sha
  FROM docs d JOIN described x ON x.body_sha=d.body_sha
 ) GROUP BY host,folded
), named AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT body_sha,folded FROM names
), templated AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT x.body_sha,x.path FROM described x JOIN page_signals t ON t.kind='description_template' AND regexp_like(x.folded,t.pattern)
), threshold AS (
 SELECT min(number) AS bodies FROM page_signals WHERE kind='description_repeat'
), candidates AS (
 SELECT d.doc_key,x.*,
  x.folded='' OR n.body_sha IS NOT NULL OR s.body_sha IS NOT NULL OR t.body_sha IS NOT NULL
  OR coalesce(r.bodies>=h.bodies,false) AS rejected
 FROM docs d JOIN described x ON x.body_sha=d.body_sha
 LEFT JOIN repeats r ON r.host=d.host AND r.folded=x.folded
 LEFT JOIN named n ON n.body_sha=x.body_sha AND n.folded=x.folded
 LEFT JOIN site_nodes s ON s.body_sha=x.body_sha AND s.node=x.node AND x.format='json-ld'
 LEFT JOIN templated t ON t.body_sha=x.body_sha AND t.path=x.path
 CROSS JOIN threshold h
), ranked AS (
 SELECT c.*,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.doc_key ORDER BY coalesce(f.number,99),c.path) AS choice
 FROM candidates c LEFT JOIN page_signals f ON f.kind='description_format' AND regexp_like(c.format,f.pattern)
 WHERE NOT c.rejected
)
SELECT doc_key,trim(value) AS description,path FROM ranked WHERE choice=1

specification.name: document_page_metadata
specification.sql:
-- One row per saved HTML document. A single body reading supplies every qualifying
-- capture address for that exact body. The declared address stays literal alongside
-- each resolution. A missing capture context leaves the declaration unresolved.
WITH docs AS (
 SELECT doc_key,body_hex,arrow_cast(decode(body_hex,'hex'),'FixedSizeBinary(32)') AS body_sha
 FROM base_normalized WHERE format='html' AND body_hex IS NOT NULL
), contexts AS (
 SELECT *,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY doc_key) AS context_count,
  sum(octet_length(context_url)) OVER (PARTITION BY doc_key) AS context_bytes,
  row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY doc_key ORDER BY context_url) AS context_position
 FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.doc_key,c.context_url
  FROM docs d JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT body_sha FROM page_metadata_values WHERE field='declared_url') declared
  ON declared.body_sha=d.body_sha
  JOIN document_identities i ON d.doc_key=i.document_id
  JOIN document_members m ON m.component=i.component AND m.body_sha=d.body_hex
  JOIN capture_sources c ON c.source_id=m.source_id AND c.body_sha=m.body_sha
  WHERE c.is_real_file AND c.outcome NOT IN ('reference','saved-record') AND c.context_url IS NOT NULL
 ) distinct_contexts
), declarations AS (
 SELECT *,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY body_sha,field) AS field_count FROM page_metadata_values
), content AS (
 SELECT body_sha,
  max(CASE WHEN f['field']='main_content:outcome' THEN f['value'] END) AS outcome,
  max(CASE WHEN f['field']='main_content:selector' THEN f['value'] END) AS selector,
  max(CASE WHEN f['field']='main_content:sha256' THEN f['value'] END) AS text_sha256,
  max(CASE WHEN f['field']='main_content:text' THEN f['value'] END) AS selected_text,
  max(CASE WHEN f['field']='main_content:reason' THEN f['value'] END) AS reason,
  max(CASE WHEN f['field']='detail_facts_limit' THEN f['value'] END) AS detail_facts_limit
 FROM (SELECT body_sha,unnest(fields) AS f FROM html_metadata_readings)
 WHERE starts_with(f['field'],'main_content:') OR f['field']='detail_facts_limit' GROUP BY body_sha
), reading AS (
 -- A reading without a main-content outcome (reader error, size limit) is failed, not unread.
 SELECT h.body_sha,h.parser_version,h.status,h.base_href,h.text_bytes,h.text_head,coalesce(c.outcome,'failed') AS outcome,
  c.selector,c.text_sha256,c.selected_text,coalesce(c.reason,h.error_type) AS reason,c.detail_facts_limit
 FROM html_metadata_readings h LEFT JOIN content c ON c.body_sha=h.body_sha
), decisions AS (
 SELECT u.body_sha256,u.id,u.parser_version,u.reason,row_number() OVER (
  PARTITION BY u.body_sha256
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN u.parser_version=p.version THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
           cast(u.decided_at AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) DESC NULLS LAST,u.id) AS preference
 FROM parser_versions p
 JOIN (accepted_versions v JOIN active_unreadable u ON u.parser=v.parser AND u.parser_version=v.version)
 ON p.parser=v.parser
 WHERE p.parser='html_metadata' AND u.body_sha256 IS NOT NULL
), qualified AS (
 SELECT d.doc_key,v.field,v.value,v.format,v.path,v.date,v.precision,c.context_url,c.context_position,r.base_href,
  coalesce(c.context_count*v.field_count>512 OR c.context_bytes+c.context_count*
   (octet_length(v.value)+coalesce(octet_length(r.base_href),0))>65536,false) AS contexts_omitted,
  (v.field='description' AND v.path=pd.path) OR (v.field='published_time' AND v.path=pt.published_path)
   OR (v.field='modified_time' AND v.path=pt.modified_path) OR v.field='section' AS selected,
  coalesce(f.number,99) AS rank
 FROM docs d JOIN declarations v ON v.body_sha=d.body_sha
 -- Keep one placeholder when the address count alone exceeds the detail budget.
 LEFT JOIN contexts c ON c.doc_key=d.doc_key AND v.field='declared_url'
  AND (c.context_count*v.field_count<=512 OR c.context_position=1)
 LEFT JOIN html_metadata_readings r ON r.body_sha=d.body_sha
 LEFT JOIN page_descriptions pd ON pd.doc_key=d.doc_key
 LEFT JOIN page_dates pt ON pt.body_sha=d.body_sha
 LEFT JOIN page_signals f ON f.kind='description_format' AND regexp_like(v.format,f.pattern)
), eligible AS (
 SELECT * EXCLUDE(context_url,base_href),
  CASE WHEN NOT contexts_omitted THEN context_url END AS context_url,
  CASE WHEN NOT contexts_omitted THEN base_href END AS base_href
 FROM qualified WHERE NOT contexts_omitted OR context_position=1
), entries AS (
 SELECT * EXCLUDE(base_href,context_position),
  CASE WHEN context_url IS NOT NULL THEN url_resolve(trim(value),
   coalesce(url_resolve(base_href,context_url),context_url)) END AS resolved
 FROM eligible
), sized AS (
 -- JSON supplies the escaped scalar sizes. Reserve 128 bytes per entry for keys,
 -- null address fields and punctuation. Account for the actual resolved address.
 SELECT *,
  128+octet_length(json_array(field,value,format,path,cast(date AS VARCHAR),precision,cast(selected AS VARCHAR))) AS literal_bytes,
  octet_length(json_array(context_url,resolved)) AS address_bytes,
  row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY doc_key,field,path ORDER BY context_url) AS literal_position
 FROM entries
), measured AS (
 SELECT *,
  sum(literal_bytes+address_bytes) OVER (PARTITION BY doc_key) AS expanded_bytes,
  sum(CASE WHEN literal_position=1 THEN literal_bytes ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY doc_key) AS base_bytes,
  sum(CASE WHEN literal_position=1 AND selected THEN literal_bytes ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY doc_key) AS selected_bytes
 FROM sized
), listed AS (
 SELECT doc_key,
  array_agg(named_struct('field',field,'value',value,'format',format,'path',path,'date',date,'precision',precision,
   'resolved',CASE WHEN expanded_bytes<=65536 THEN resolved END,'selected',coalesce(selected,false),
   'context_url',CASE WHEN expanded_bytes<=65536 THEN context_url END) ORDER BY field,rank,path,context_url)
   -- Keep the exact pointers for summaries before spending the budget on alternatives.
   FILTER (WHERE expanded_bytes<=65536 OR (literal_position=1 AND
    (base_bytes<=65536 OR (selected AND selected_bytes<=65536)))) AS page_metadata,
  bool_or(contexts_omitted OR expanded_bytes>65536) AS evidence_limited
 FROM measured GROUP BY doc_key
), labels AS (
 SELECT body_sha,array_agg(value ORDER BY path) AS publisher_labels
 FROM (SELECT body_sha,trim(value) AS value,min(path) AS path FROM page_metadata_values
       WHERE field='section' AND trim(value)<>'' GROUP BY body_sha,trim(value))
 GROUP BY body_sha
)
SELECT d.doc_key,
 CASE WHEN array_length(li.page_metadata)>0 THEN pd.description END AS description,
 CASE WHEN array_length(li.page_metadata)>0 THEN pt.published_on END AS published_on,
 CASE WHEN array_length(li.page_metadata)>0 THEN pt.modified_on END AS modified_on,
 coalesce(CASE WHEN array_length(li.page_metadata)>0 THEN l.publisher_labels END,
  arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')) AS publisher_labels,
 coalesce(li.page_metadata,array_slice(make_array(named_struct('field',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'value',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),
  'format',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'path',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'date',cast(NULL AS DATE),'precision',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),
  'resolved',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'selected',cast(NULL AS BOOLEAN),'context_url',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR))),1,0)) AS page_metadata,
 named_struct('outcome',CASE r.outcome WHEN 'fallback_required' THEN 'fallback' WHEN 'marked' THEN 'marked'
   WHEN 'marked_no_content' THEN 'marked_no_content' WHEN 'failed' THEN 'failed' WHEN 'none' THEN 'none'
   ELSE CASE WHEN u.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'unreadable' ELSE 'unread' END END,
  'selector',r.selector,'text_sha256',r.text_sha256,'text_bytes',r.text_bytes,
  'snippet',CASE WHEN r.outcome IN ('marked','marked_no_content') THEN r.text_head END,
  'reader_version',coalesce(r.parser_version,u.parser_version),
  'reading_status',coalesce(r.status,CASE WHEN u.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'unreadable' END),
  'reason',CASE WHEN r.body_sha IS NOT NULL THEN r.reason ELSE u.reason END,
  'facts_limited',r.detail_facts_limit IS NOT NULL,'text_available',r.selected_text IS NOT NULL,
  'decision_id',CASE WHEN r.body_sha IS NULL THEN u.id END,
  'evidence_limited',coalesce(li.evidence_limited,false)) AS main_content,
 r.selected_text
FROM docs d LEFT JOIN reading r ON r.body_sha=d.body_sha
LEFT JOIN decisions u ON u.body_sha256=d.body_hex AND u.preference=1
LEFT JOIN page_descriptions pd ON pd.doc_key=d.doc_key
LEFT JOIN page_dates pt ON pt.body_sha=d.body_sha
LEFT JOIN labels l ON l.body_sha=d.body_sha
LEFT JOIN listed li ON li.doc_key=d.doc_key

specification.sql:
-- Address metadata and publisher evidence each retain their own grain.
WITH addresses AS (
 SELECT a.component,d.document_id AS doc_key,min(a.source_id) AS source_key,a.url,a.member_path,
 bool_or(a.source_id=s.source_id) AS is_saved,
 cast(min(cast(a.first_fetched AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)) AS DATE) AS first_seen
 FROM saved_files s JOIN (
  document_identities d JOIN document_addresses a USING(component)
 ) ON a.component=s.component AND s.saved_rank=1
 GROUP BY a.component,d.document_id,a.url,a.member_path
), compatible AS (
 SELECT a.component,a.url,a.member_path,l.context_url,l.text,l.doc_type,l.add_date,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY a.component,a.url,a.member_path
 ORDER BY cast(l.first_good_at AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) NULLS LAST,
 l.context,l.page_body,l.link_index,l.split_position) AS selected
 FROM model_url_keys k RIGHT JOIN (
  document_addresses a JOIN publisher_links l ON a.source_id=l.source_id
 ) ON a.url=k.url AND k.error IS NULL
 WHERE (a.member_path IS NULL AND l.target_member_path IS NULL)
 OR (a.member_path IS NOT NULL AND l.url_key=k.url_key
 AND (l.target_member_path IS NULL OR l.target_member_path=a.member_path))
)
SELECT a.doc_key,a.source_key,a.url,a.member_path,a.is_saved,a.first_seen,
 l.context_url AS listed_on,l.text AS link_text,l.doc_type,try_cast(l.add_date AS DATE) AS posted
FROM (SELECT * FROM compatible WHERE selected=1 AND component IS NOT NULL AND url IS NOT NULL) l RIGHT JOIN addresses a
 ON (a.component IS NOT DISTINCT FROM l.component) AND (a.url IS NOT DISTINCT FROM l.url)
 AND (a.member_path IS NOT DISTINCT FROM l.member_path)

specification.name: url_state_lines
specification.sql:
WITH base_captures AS (
        SELECT * FROM captures WHERE mode='fetch' AND coalesce(fetch_outcome,outcome,'') NOT IN ('reference','saved-record') AND coalesce(outcome,'') NOT IN ('reference','saved-record') AND requested_url IS NOT NULL
    ), companion_keys AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT receipt_key,receipt_line,requested_url FROM base_captures WHERE family<>'external/provider-responses'
    ), stored_contexts AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT receipt_key,context_url FROM captures
        WHERE mode='fetch' AND complete AND outcome IN ('stored','unchanged')
          AND sha256 IS NOT NULL AND requested_url IS NULL AND context_url IS NOT NULL
    ), folded_captures AS (
        SELECT b.receipt_key,b.receipt_line,b.requested_url,b.family,b.retrieved_at,
            CASE WHEN b.fetch_outcome IS NOT NULL THEN b.fetch_http_status ELSE b.http_status END AS http_status,
            coalesce(b.fetch_outcome,b.outcome) AS outcome,
            (coalesce(b.fetch_outcome,b.outcome)='failed' AND coalesce(b.attempt,0)=0 AND b.complete AND (CASE WHEN b.fetch_outcome IS NOT NULL THEN b.fetch_http_status ELSE b.http_status END BETWEEN 200 AND 299 AND CASE WHEN b.fetch_outcome IS NOT NULL THEN b.fetch_http_status ELSE b.http_status END NOT IN (202)) AND sc.context_url IS NOT NULL) AS context_good
        FROM base_captures b

specification.name: url_state_sanitized_normalized
specification.sql:
-- Inputs: url_state_sanitized_inputs(input_id,url), url_rules, active url_variants(canonical_url,variant_url).
-- Literal values remain unchanged. Every error makes the join key unusable.
WITH literals AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT url FROM url_state_sanitized_inputs
 UNION SELECT canonical_url FROM url_variants
 UNION SELECT variant_url FROM url_variants
), first_matches AS (
 SELECT l.url,count(r.id) AS matches,
 max(CASE r.decoder WHEN 'proofpoint' THEN
   percent_decode_utf8(replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(l.url,r.pattern,r.replacement),'-([0-9A-Fa-f]{2})','%$1','g'),'_','/'))
 WHEN 'percent' THEN percent_decode_utf8(regexp_replace(l.url,r.pattern,r.replacement))
 ELSE regexp_replace(l.url,r.pattern,r.replacement) END) AS inner_url
 FROM url_rules r RIGHT JOIN literals l ON r.kind='wrapper' AND regexp_like(l.url,r.pattern)
 GROUP BY l.url
), first_pass AS (
 SELECT url,coalesce(inner_url,url) AS value,matches>1 AS conflict FROM first_matches
), second_matches AS (
 SELECT p.url,p.conflict,count(r.id) AS matches,
 max(CASE r.decoder WHEN 'proofpoint' THEN
   percent_decode_utf8(replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(p.value,r.pattern,r.replacement),'-([0-9A-Fa-f]{2})','%$1','g'),'_','/'))
 WHEN 'percent' THEN percent_decode_utf8(regexp_replace(p.value,r.pattern,r.replacement))
 ELSE regexp_replace(p.value,r.pattern,r.replacement) END) AS inner_url,max(p.value) AS prior
 FROM url_rules r RIGHT JOIN first_pass p ON r.kind='wrapper' AND regexp_like(p.value,r.pattern)
 GROUP BY p.url,p.conflict
), unwrapped AS (
 SELECT url,coalesce(inner_url,prior) AS value,conflict OR matches>1 AS conflict FROM second_matches
), serialized AS (
 SELECT u.url,u.value,u.conflict,uri_normalize_encoding(url_resolve(u.value,cast(NULL AS VARCHAR))) AS parsed,
 count(r.id)>0 AS still_wrapped FROM url_rules r
 RIGHT JOIN unwrapped u ON r.kind='wrapper' AND regexp_like(u.value,r.pattern)
 GROUP BY u.url,u.value,u.conflict
), components AS (
 SELECT *,regexp_replace((regexp_match(parsed,'^https?://([^/?#]+)'))[1],'^www\.','') AS authority,
 coalesce((regexp_match(parsed,'^https?://[^/?#]+([^?#]*)'))[1],'') AS path,
 (regexp_match(split_part(parsed,'#',1),'\?(.*)$'))[1] AS query FROM serialized
), pairs AS (
 SELECT url,authority,unnest(string_to_array(query,'&')) AS pair FROM components WHERE query<>''
), kept_pairs AS (
 SELECT p.* FROM url_rules r RIGHT ANTI JOIN pairs p ON r.kind='strip'
 AND (r.host_pattern IS NULL OR regexp_like(regexp_replace(p.authority,':[0-9]+$',''),r.host_pattern))
 AND regexp_like(split_part(p.pair,'=',1),r.pattern)
), queries AS (
 SELECT url,string_agg(pair,'&' ORDER BY pair) AS query FROM kept_pairs GROUP BY url
), base_keys AS (
 SELECT c.url,
 CASE WHEN c.conflict THEN 'wrapper_conflict'
 WHEN c.authority IS NULL THEN 'invalid_url' END AS error,c.still_wrapped,
 c.authority || regexp_replace(c.path,'/$','') ||
 coalesce('?' || q.query,'') AS base_key
 FROM queries q RIGHT JOIN components c ON c.url=q.url
 )

specification.name: recording_fetch_candidates
specification.sql:
SELECT c.receipt_key,c.receipt_line,c.capture_index,c.sha256,
                coalesce(c.stored_suffix,'.gz') AS suffix,
                coalesce(c.sniffed_format,CASE lower(split_part(c.media_type,';',1)) WHEN 'text/vtt' THEN 'vtt' WHEN 'application/vnd.apple.mpegurl' THEN 'm3u8' WHEN 'application/x-mpegurl' THEN 'm3u8' END) AS body_format,
                coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,c.context_url) AS fetch_url,
                CASE WHEN c.url<>c.requested_url THEN c.requested_url END AS redirected_from,
                (
regexp_like(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,c.context_url),'(?i)(?:youtube|youtu[.]be|senate)') AND (
 c.sniffed_format = 'm3u8'
 OR lower(split_part(coalesce(c.media_type,''),';',1)) IN ('application/vnd.apple.mpegurl','application/x-mpegurl')
 OR regexp_like(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,c.context_url),'(?i)[.]m3u8(?:[?#]|$)'))
) AS playlist_candidate,
                arrow_cast(try_cast(c.retrieved_at AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))') AS retrieved_at
                FROM captures c
                WHERE c.mode = 'fetch' AND c.complete AND c.outcome IN ('stored', 'unchanged') AND c.http_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299 AND c.sha256 IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,c.context_url) IS NOT NULL
                 AND regexp_like(coalesce(c.url,c.requested_url,c.context_url),'(?i)(?:youtube|youtu[.]be|senate)')

specification.name: recording_track_candidates
specification.sql:
WITH fetch_urls AS (
                SELECT DISTINCT fetch_url FROM recording_fetch_candidates
            ), matched_keys AS (
                SELECT u.fetch_url,
                 regexp_replace((regexp_match(u.fetch_url,vu.pattern))[1],'^(.+)$',vu.key_template) AS extracted_key,
                 vu.format AS vu_format,
                 vu.default_language AS vu_default_language,
                 vu.default_production AS vu_default_production,vu.id AS rule_id
                FROM recording_url_sources vu
                JOIN fetch_urls u ON regexp_like(u.fetch_url,vu.pattern)
            ), kept_keys AS (
                SELECT * FROM (
                    SELECT k.*,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY fetch_url,extracted_key ORDER BY
                        vu_default_production IN ('live','archive') DESC,rule_id) AS preference
                    FROM recording_segment_exclusions ex
                    RIGHT ANTI JOIN matched_keys k ON regexp_like(k.fetch_url,ex.pattern)
                ) k WHERE preference=1
            ), url_tracks AS (
                SELECT k.fetch_url,k.extracted_key,k.vu_format,tf.format AS tf_format,
                coalesce(
                 lower(nullif((regexp_match(k.fetch_url,'(?i)[?&](?:t?lang)=([a-z]{2,3}(?:-[a-z0-9]+)?)'))[1],'')),
                 lower(nullif((regexp_match(k.fetch_url,'(?i)/(?:subtitles|captions|cc)/([a-z]{2,3})(?:/|[._-])'))[1],'')),
                 k.vu_default_language,tf.default_language,'en'
                ) AS language,
                coalesce(
                 CASE WHEN regexp_like(k.fetch_url,'(?i)[?&](?:kind|caps)=asr(?:[&#]|$)') THEN 'asr' END,
                 k.vu_default_production,tf.default_production,'caption'
                ) AS production
                FROM recording_track_formats tf
                RIGHT JOIN kept_keys k ON regexp_like(k.fetch_url,tf.pattern)
            )
            SELECT cf.receipt_key,cf.receipt_line,cf.capture_index,cf.sha256,cf.suffix,cf.fetch_url,cf.retrieved_at,
                t.extracted_key,
                coalesce(
                 CASE WHEN cf.body_format IN ('vtt','srt','m3u8','ttml') THEN cf.body_format END,
                 t.tf_format,
                 t.vu_format
                ) AS format,
                t.language,t.production
            FROM recording_segment_bodies b
            RIGHT ANTI JOIN (url_tracks t JOIN recording_fetch_candidates cf ON cf.fetch_url=t.fetch_url)
              ON b.sha256=cf.sha256

specification.name: recording_tracks
specification.sql:
-- One row per video: its current tracks, ranked once. recordings_entity reads it twice (its
-- keys and its join); inlined, the two window sorts over 2.7M track candidates ran per reference.
WITH unnested_meeting_videos AS (
 SELECT event_id,unnest(videos) AS v FROM meetings_resolved WHERE videos IS NOT NULL
), flat_meeting_videos AS (
 SELECT event_id,v['url'] AS video_url,nullif(trim(v['video_key']),'') AS explicit_key
 FROM unnested_meeting_videos
), raw_meeting_videos AS (
 SELECT m.event_id,m.video_url AS url,m.explicit_key,
  min(regexp_replace((regexp_match(m.video_url,rs.pattern))[1],'^(.+)$',rs.key_template)) AS extracted_key
 FROM flat_meeting_videos m
 LEFT JOIN recording_url_sources rs ON m.video_url IS NOT NULL AND regexp_like(m.video_url,rs.pattern)
 GROUP BY m.event_id,m.video_url,m.explicit_key
), video_key_aliases AS (
 SELECT extracted_key AS alias_key,min(explicit_key) AS canonical_key
 FROM raw_meeting_videos
 WHERE extracted_key IS NOT NULL AND explicit_key IS NOT NULL AND extracted_key<>explicit_key
 GROUP BY extracted_key
), resolved_tracks AS (
 SELECT coalesce(a.canonical_key,tc.extracted_key) AS video_key,
  arrow_cast(tc.sha256,'FixedSizeBinary(32)') AS body,
  tc.suffix,tc.format,tc.language,tc.production,
  tc.retrieved_at,tc.receipt_key,tc.receipt_line,tc.capture_index
 FROM caption_playlist_bodies p RIGHT JOIN recording_track_candidates tc ON p.record_sha=tc.sha256
 LEFT JOIN video_key_aliases a ON tc.extracted_key=a.alias_key
 WHERE tc.extracted_key IS NOT NULL AND tc.format IS NOT NULL
  AND (tc.format<>'m3u8' OR p.record_sha IS NOT NULL)
), classified_tracks AS (
 -- A specific route or explicit ASR evidence beats a generic label for the same bytes.
 -- Equal evidence keeps the latest fetch. Distinct bodies can still supply different tracks.
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY video_key,body ORDER BY
    CASE production WHEN 'asr' THEN 2 WHEN 'live' THEN 1 WHEN 'archive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC,
    retrieved_at DESC NULLS LAST,receipt_key DESC,receipt_line DESC,capture_index DESC,
    format,language,production) AS body_preference FROM resolved_tracks
), ranked_tracks AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER(
  PARTITION BY video_key,format,language,production
  ORDER BY retrieved_at DESC NULLS LAST,receipt_key DESC,receipt_line DESC,capture_index DESC
 ) AS rn FROM classified_tracks WHERE body_preference=1
), ordered_tracks AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER(
  PARTITION BY video_key
  ORDER BY format ASC,language ASC,production ASC,suffix ASC
 ) AS track_seq
 FROM ranked_tracks WHERE rn=1
), tracks_agg AS (
 SELECT video_key,array_agg(named_struct(
  'body',body,'suffix',suffix,'format',format,'language',language,'production',production
 ) ORDER BY track_seq ASC) AS tracks
 FROM ordered_tracks GROUP BY video_key
)
SELECT * FROM tracks_agg

specification.name: recordings_entity
specification.sql:
WITH unnested_meeting_videos AS (
 SELECT event_id,unnest(videos) AS v FROM meetings_resolved WHERE videos IS NOT NULL
), flat_meeting_videos AS (
 SELECT event_id,v['url'] AS video_url,nullif(trim(v['video_key']),'') AS explicit_key
 FROM unnested_meeting_videos
), raw_meeting_videos AS (
 SELECT m.event_id,m.video_url AS url,m.explicit_key,
  min(regexp_replace((regexp_match(m.video_url,rs.pattern))[1],'^(.+)$',rs.key_template)) AS extracted_key
 FROM flat_meeting_videos m
 LEFT JOIN recording_url_sources rs ON m.video_url IS NOT NULL AND regexp_like(m.video_url,rs.pattern)
 GROUP BY m.event_id,m.video_url,m.explicit_key
), video_key_aliases AS (
 SELECT extracted_key AS alias_key,min(explicit_key) AS canonical_key
 FROM raw_meeting_videos
 WHERE extracted_key IS NOT NULL AND explicit_key IS NOT NULL AND extracted_key<>explicit_key
 GROUP BY extracted_key
), meeting_video_events AS (
 SELECT coalesce(a.canonical_key,rmv.explicit_key,rmv.extracted_key) AS video_key,rmv.event_id
 FROM raw_meeting_videos rmv
 LEFT JOIN video_key_aliases a ON coalesce(rmv.explicit_key,rmv.extracted_key)=a.alias_key
 WHERE coalesce(rmv.explicit_key,rmv.extracted_key) IS NOT NULL
 UNION
 SELECT coalesce(a.canonical_key,pvl.extracted_key) AS video_key,pm.event_id
 FROM recording_video_links pvl
 LEFT JOIN recording_page_meetings pm ON pvl.page_body=pm.page_body
 LEFT JOIN video_key_aliases a ON pvl.extracted_key=a.alias_key
 WHERE pvl.extracted_key IS NOT NULL
), tracks_agg AS (
 SELECT * FROM recording_tracks
), all_keys AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT video_key FROM meeting_video_events WHERE video_key IS NOT NULL
 UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT video_key FROM tracks_agg WHERE video_key IS NOT NULL
), events_agg AS (
 SELECT video_key,array_sort(array_distinct(array_agg(event_id))) AS event_ids
 FROM meeting_video_events WHERE video_key IS NOT NULL AND event_id IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY video_key
)
SELECT k.video_key,
 coalesce(e.event_ids,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS BIGINT)),1,0),'List(Int64)')) AS event_ids,
 coalesce(t.tracks,array_slice(make_array(named_struct(
  'body',arrow_cast(NULL,'FixedSizeBinary(32)'),
  'suffix',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),
  'format',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),
  'language',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),
  'production',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)
 )),1,0)) AS tracks
FROM all_keys k
LEFT JOIN events_agg e ON k.video_key=e.video_key
LEFT JOIN tracks_agg t ON k.video_key=t.video_key

specification.name: meetings_export
specification.sql:
WITH keys AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT try_cast(unnest(meeting_keys) AS BIGINT) AS event_id FROM ordered WHERE meeting_keys IS NOT NULL
 UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT event_id FROM meetings_resolved WHERE event_id IS NOT NULL
), printed AS (
 -- A print held on the meeting's date under its title (package_meeting_links) shows the meeting sat,
 -- whatever its status: Congress.gov states Canceled for 101498, 101400, 104460 and 101644, whose own
 -- prints record the hearing that day. The publisher status stays, so the conflict remains visible.
 SELECT DISTINCT event_id FROM package_meeting_links
), own_evidence AS (
 -- What the meeting's own records hold of a sitting: its print, a transcript file its record lists, or
 -- its own witness list (House XML or Congress.gov). Witnesses attached from a package are not its own:
 -- 101422 carried 87484's PPACA witnesses. 116450 (Rescheduled) lists HHRG-118-VR09-Transcript-20231108.pdf.
 SELECT event_id FROM printed
 UNION
 SELECT event_id FROM meeting_document_urls WHERE regexp_like(url,'(?i)transcript')
 UNION
 SELECT event_id FROM appearance_records_resolved
 WHERE event_id IS NOT NULL AND name IS NOT NULL AND source IN ('house_xml','congress_gov')
), reschedule_rows AS (
 -- Postponed/Canceled (not_held) says no sitting on this date. Rescheduled is ambiguous: re-dated in place
 -- (106383, own video) or re-entered (101422, raw MODS shows the twin's print), so the record's own
 -- recording, transcript or witnesses mean it sat. Jackets are not own evidence: Congress.gov lists
 -- same-day jackets of other hearings (101422 lists 87484 "PPACA...", held 2013-10-24). Parts live in
 -- title_key (ct-asdg); a hearing never moves to a markup of the same bills (116450 -> 116562).
 SELECT r.event_id,r.meeting_date,r.title_key,r.reschedule_candidate,r.committee_key,
  coalesce(array_length(r.videos),0)>0 OR e.event_id IS NOT NULL AS sat,
  coalesce(array_length(r.videos),0)>0 AS has_video,
  coalesce(r.not_held,false) AND pr.event_id IS NULL AS not_held,
  lower(coalesce(r.status,''))='rescheduled' AS rescheduled,
  CASE WHEN upper(coalesce(r.meeting_type,'')) IN ('HHRG') OR lower(coalesce(r.meeting_type,'')) LIKE '%hearing%' THEN 'hearing'
       WHEN upper(coalesce(r.meeting_type,'')) IN ('HMKP') OR lower(coalesce(r.meeting_type,'')) LIKE '%markup%' THEN 'markup' END AS kind
 FROM meetings_resolved r LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT event_id FROM own_evidence) e ON r.event_id=e.event_id
 LEFT JOIN printed pr ON r.event_id=pr.event_id
 WHERE r.title_key IS NOT NULL AND r.committee_key IS NOT NULL
), twins AS (
 SELECT old.event_id,(old.not_held OR old.rescheduled) AS stated,twin.event_id AS twin_id,twin.meeting_date
 FROM reschedule_rows old JOIN reschedule_rows twin ON old.title_key=twin.title_key AND old.committee_key=twin.committee_key
 WHERE twin.meeting_date>old.meeting_date AND twin.meeting_date<=old.meeting_date+INTERVAL '60' DAY
  AND NOT twin.not_held
  AND (old.kind IS NULL OR twin.kind IS NULL OR old.kind=twin.kind)
  AND (old.not_held OR (NOT old.sat AND (old.rescheduled OR (old.reschedule_candidate AND twin.has_video))))
), first_twin AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY event_id ORDER BY meeting_date,twin_id) AS rn FROM twins
), rescheduled AS (
 SELECT event_id,twin_id AS rescheduled_to,CASE WHEN stated THEN 'publisher_status' ELSE 'recording_on_later_twin' END AS rescheduled_basis FROM first_twin WHERE rn=1
), transcript_links AS (
 -- Use vetted print links when MODS facts are available. Congress.gov lists 52109 on 330128,
 -- another hearing's print. Without MODS facts the jacket link stands.
 SELECT package_id,event_id FROM package_meeting_links
 UNION
 SELECT l.package_id,l.event_id FROM meeting_transcript_links l
 LEFT JOIN package_mods_facts f ON f.package_id=l.package_id WHERE f.package_id IS NULL
), recording_tracks AS (
 SELECT video_key,event_ids,t['format'] AS format,t['language'] AS language,t['production'] AS production,t['body'] AS body
 FROM (SELECT video_key,event_ids,unnest(tracks) AS t FROM recordings_entity WHERE tracks IS NOT NULL)
), caption_tracks AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT video_key,unnest(event_ids) AS event_id,format,language,production FROM recording_tracks
 -- The empty body's digest is no caption file (338611's YouTube track is 0 bytes).
 WHERE format IN ('vtt','srt','ttml') AND body IS NOT NULL AND event_ids IS NOT NULL
  AND body<>arrow_cast(decode('e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855','hex'),'FixedSizeBinary(32)')
), transcript_rows AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT l.event_id,d.package_id,cast(d.list_row AS INT) AS list_row,d.format
 FROM transcript_links l
 JOIN details d ON l.package_id=d.package_id
 WHERE d.package_id IS NOT NULL
), transcript_preferred AS (
 -- One entry per (meeting, package): the package's document whose saved format ranks first.
 SELECT r.event_id,r.package_id,r.list_row,row_number() OVER (
  PARTITION BY r.event_id,r.package_id ORDER BY coalesce(p.rank,2147483647),r.list_row) AS rn
 FROM formats p RIGHT JOIN transcript_rows r ON p.kind='preference' AND p.value=r.format
), transcript_row_formats AS (
 SELECT list_row,format FROM transcript_rows
 UNION SELECT cast(a.row_id AS INT) AS list_row,a.alt['format'] AS format FROM (
  SELECT d.list_row AS row_id,unnest(d.alternates) AS alt FROM details d
  WHERE d.package_id IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(array_length(d.alternates),0)>0) a
), transcript_formats AS (
 SELECT f.event_id,f.package_id,array_agg(f.format ORDER BY coalesce(p.rank,2147483647),f.format) AS formats
 FROM formats p RIGHT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.event_id,r.package_id,x.format FROM transcript_rows r
  JOIN transcript_row_formats x ON x.list_row=r.list_row WHERE x.format IS NOT NULL
 ) f ON p.kind='preference' AND p.value=f.format
 GROUP BY f.event_id,f.package_id
), transcript_sources AS (
 SELECT t.event_id,'printed_hearing' AS source,t.package_id,t.list_row,f.formats,
  cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS video_key,cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS language,cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS production
 FROM transcript_preferred t JOIN transcript_formats f ON f.event_id=t.event_id AND f.package_id=t.package_id
 WHERE t.rn=1
 UNION ALL
 -- A committee's own transcript (ct-1i4q): a held file the meeting's current record lists (by name) whose
 -- name is the House transcript form, H{HRG,MKP,MTG}-<congress>-<committee>-Transcript-<yyyymmdd>[-<part>].pdf,
 -- dated the meeting's day (HHRG-118-VR09-Transcript-20231108.pdf). Every listed transcript file on v21 has
 -- this form; a file linked only by its folder path is not one the record lists.
 SELECT DISTINCT m.event_id,'committee_transcript' AS source,cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS package_id,cast(o.list_row AS INT) AS list_row,
  arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(o.format),1,CASE WHEN o.format IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),'List(Utf8)') AS formats,
  cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS video_key,cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS language,cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS production
 FROM (SELECT list_row,filename,format,try_cast(unnest(meeting_keys) AS BIGINT) AS event_id FROM ordered
  WHERE regexp_like(filename,'(?i)^H(?:HRG|MKP|MTG)-[0-9]{3}-[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{2}-Transcript-[0-9]{8}(?:-[A-Z0-9]+)?[.]pdf$')) o
 JOIN meetings_resolved m ON m.event_id=o.event_id
  AND (regexp_match(o.filename,'(?i)-Transcript-([0-9]{8})'))[1]=replace(cast(m.meeting_date AS VARCHAR),'-','')
 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT event_id,lower(regexp_replace(url,'^.*/','')) AS name FROM meeting_document_urls) d
  ON d.event_id=o.event_id AND d.name=lower(o.filename)
 UNION ALL
 -- Captions and subtitles (ct-1i4q): complete caption files of the meeting's recordings. A vtt beside a
 -- playlist of the same production is one segment of that stream, not a track (ct-9s7b), and a track
 -- with no body is not held.
 SELECT DISTINCT c.event_id,'captions' AS source,cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS package_id,cast(NULL AS INT) AS list_row,
  arrow_cast(make_array(c.format),'List(Utf8)') AS formats,c.video_key,c.language,c.production
 FROM caption_tracks c
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT video_key,production FROM recording_tracks WHERE format='m3u8') p
  ON p.video_key=c.video_key AND p.production IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.production
 WHERE p.video_key IS NULL
), transcript_ranked AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER (
  PARTITION BY event_id
  ORDER BY CASE source WHEN 'printed_hearing' THEN 0 WHEN 'committee_transcript' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
   list_row ASC NULLS LAST,package_id ASC NULLS LAST,video_key ASC NULLS LAST,language ASC NULLS LAST,production ASC NULLS LAST
 ) AS tr_seq
 FROM transcript_sources
), transcripts_agg AS (
 SELECT event_id,array_agg(named_struct(
  'source',source,'package_id',package_id,'list_row',list_row,'formats',formats,
  'video_key',video_key,'language',language,'production',production
 ) ORDER BY tr_seq ASC) AS transcripts
 FROM transcript_ranked GROUP BY event_id
), nomination_hearing_chunks AS (
 SELECT
  cast(congress AS VARCHAR)||'-pn-'||cast(number AS VARCHAR)||
  CASE
   WHEN part_number IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(part_number AS INT) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(part_number AS INT)<>0
    THEN '-'||regexp_replace(trim(part_number),'^0+','')
   ELSE ''
  END AS nomination_id,
  congress,
  unnest(string_to_array(hearings_json,'}')) AS chunk
 FROM spicy_nominations
 WHERE congress IS NOT NULL AND number IS NOT NULL AND hearings_json IS NOT NULL
), nomination_hearing_packages AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT nomination_id,
  coalesce(
   (regexp_match(chunk,'(?i)"package_?id"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"'))[1],
   (regexp_match(chunk,'(CHRG-[0-9]+[hsj]hrg[0-9]+)'))[1],
   CASE WHEN regexp_like(chunk,'(?i)"jacket(?:_?number)?"\s*:\s*"?([0-9]+)"?')
    THEN 'CHRG-'||cast(congress AS VARCHAR)||
     (CASE lower(coalesce((regexp_match(chunk,'(?i)"chamber"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"'))[1],'senate'))
      WHEN 'house' THEN 'h' WHEN 'joint' THEN 'j' ELSE 's' END)||'hrg'||
     (regexp_match(chunk,'(?i)"jacket(?:_?number)?"\s*:\s*"?([0-9]+)"?'))[1]
   END
  ) AS package_id
 FROM nomination_hearing_chunks
), combined_subjects AS (
 SELECT event_id,nullif(lower(trim(unnest(subject_keys))),'') AS subject_key
 FROM meetings_resolved
 WHERE subject_keys IS NOT NULL
 UNION
 SELECT try_cast(o.meeting_keys[1] AS BIGINT) AS event_id,
  nullif(lower(trim(unnest(o.measure_keys))),'') AS subject_key
 FROM ordered o
 WHERE coalesce(array_length(o.meeting_keys),0)=1
   AND o.measure_keys IS NOT NULL
 UNION
 SELECT tr.event_id,lower(trim(np.nomination_id)) AS subject_key
 FROM transcript_ranked tr
 JOIN nomination_hearing_packages np ON np.package_id=tr.package_id
 WHERE tr.package_id IS NOT NULL AND np.package_id IS NOT NULL
), subject_keys_by_event AS (
 SELECT event_id,array_agg(subject_key ORDER BY subject_key) AS subject_keys
 FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT event_id,subject_key
  FROM combined_subjects
  WHERE event_id IS NOT NULL AND subject_key IS NOT NULL AND subject_key<>''
 )
 GROUP BY event_id
)
SELECT k.event_id,
 m.chamber,
 CASE
  WHEN m.event_id IS NULL THEN 'meeting_detail_missing'
  WHEN m.chamber IS NULL THEN 'source_chamber_unknown'
  ELSE 'source'
 END AS chamber_basis,
 m.title,
 m.meeting_date,
 m.meeting_type,
 m.session,
 m.status,
 coalesce(m.sittings,array_slice(make_array(named_struct(
  'start',arrow_cast(NULL,'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))'),
  'end',arrow_cast(NULL,'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))'),
  'place',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'room',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'building',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'address',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR))),1,0)) AS sittings,
 coalesce(m.committees,array_slice(make_array(named_struct(
  'system_code',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'role',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR))),1,0)) AS committees,
 coalesce(sk.subject_keys,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')) AS subject_keys,
 coalesce(t.transcripts,array_slice(make_array(named_struct(
  'source',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'package_id',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'list_row',cast(NULL AS INT),
  'formats',arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)'),
  'video_key',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'language',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'production',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR))),1,0)) AS transcripts,
 coalesce(m.videos,array_slice(make_array(named_struct(
  'name',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'url',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'video_key',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR))),1,0)) AS videos,
 cast(m.congress AS SMALLINT) AS congress,
 m.congress_gov_updated,
 m.house_xml_updated,
 m.congress_gov_meeting_type,
 m.access,
 m.access_basis,
 m.not_held AND pr.event_id IS NULL AS not_held,
 r.rescheduled_to,
 r.rescheduled_basis,
 m.document_references
FROM keys k
LEFT JOIN meetings_resolved m ON k.event_id=m.event_id
LEFT JOIN subject_keys_by_event sk ON k.event_id=sk.event_id
LEFT JOIN transcripts_agg t ON k.event_id=t.event_id
LEFT JOIN rescheduled r ON k.event_id=r.event_id
LEFT JOIN printed pr ON k.event_id=pr.event_id
WHERE k.event_id IS NOT NULL

specification.name: committees_export
specification.sql:
WITH history_rows AS (
 SELECT system_code AS raw_system_code,unnest(history) AS h
 FROM spicy_committees WHERE system_code IS NOT NULL AND history IS NOT NULL
), history_parsed AS (
 SELECT lower(raw_system_code) AS system_code,
  nullif(trim(h['officialName']),'') AS name,
  coalesce(
   try_cast(h['startDate'] AS DATE),
   cast(arrow_cast(try_cast(h['startDate'] AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Second, Some("America/New_York"))') AS DATE)
  ) AS start_date,
  coalesce(
   try_cast(h['endDate'] AS DATE),
   cast(arrow_cast(try_cast(h['endDate'] AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) + INTERVAL '1 second','Timestamp(Second, Some("America/New_York"))') AS DATE)
  ) AS end_date
 FROM history_rows WHERE nullif(trim(h['officialName']),'') IS NOT NULL
), names_agg AS (
 SELECT system_code AS agg_system_code,array_agg(named_struct(
  'name',name,'start',start_date,'end',end_date
 ) ORDER BY start_date DESC NULLS LAST,name ASC,end_date DESC NULLS LAST) AS names
 FROM history_parsed GROUP BY system_code
), base_committees AS (
 SELECT lower(system_code) AS norm_code,name,lower(chamber) AS chamber,
  lower(nullif(trim(committee_type),'')) AS committee_type,
  lower(nullif(trim(parent_system_code),'')) AS parent_system_code,
  nullif(trim(website_url),'') AS website,
  coalesce(is_current,false) AS is_current
 FROM spicy_committees WHERE system_code IS NOT NULL
), committee_code_map AS (
 SELECT raw_key,min(system_code) AS norm_code,min(chamber) AS map_chamber
 FROM (
  SELECT upper(trim(code)) AS raw_key,lower(trim(system_code)) AS system_code,lower(trim(chamber)) AS chamber FROM committee_codes WHERE code IS NOT NULL AND system_code IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'HS'||upper(trim(code)) AS raw_key,lower(trim(system_code)) AS system_code,lower(trim(chamber)) AS chamber FROM committee_codes WHERE chamber='house' AND length(trim(code))=4 AND system_code IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT upper(trim(system_code)) AS raw_key,lower(trim(system_code)) AS system_code,lower(trim(chamber)) AS chamber FROM committee_codes WHERE system_code IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'HSJL00' AS raw_key,'jslc00' AS system_code,'joint' AS chamber
  UNION ALL SELECT 'HSIT00' AS raw_key,'jstx00' AS system_code,'joint' AS chamber
  UNION ALL SELECT 'HSEC00' AS raw_key,'jsec00' AS system_code,'joint' AS chamber
  UNION ALL SELECT 'HSJP00' AS raw_key,'jspr00' AS system_code,'joint' AS chamber
 )
 GROUP BY raw_key
), roster_normalized_committees AS (
 SELECT
  coalesce(ccm.norm_code,lower(trim(a.system_code))) AS norm_code,
  nullif(trim(a.committee_name),'') AS committee_name,
  coalesce(
   CASE lower(trim(a.chamber))
    WHEN 'h' THEN 'house'
    WHEN 's' THEN 'senate'
    WHEN 'j' THEN 'joint'
    ELSE lower(nullif(trim(a.chamber),''))
   END,
   ccm.map_chamber
  ) AS chamber,
  a.is_subcommittee,
  coalesce(pccm.norm_code,lower(nullif(trim(a.parent_system_code),''))) AS parent_system_code
 FROM spicy_committee_assignments a
 LEFT JOIN committee_code_map ccm ON ccm.raw_key=upper(trim(a.system_code))
 LEFT JOIN committee_code_map pccm ON pccm.raw_key=upper(trim(a.parent_system_code))
 WHERE a.system_code IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.system_code)<>''
), synthesized_committees AS (
 SELECT
  r.norm_code,
  coalesce(
   max(r.committee_name),
   upper(r.norm_code)
  ) AS name,
  coalesce(
   max(r.chamber),
   CASE substr(r.norm_code,1,1)
    WHEN 'h' THEN 'house'
    WHEN 's' THEN 'senate'
    WHEN 'j' THEN 'joint'
    ELSE 'house'
   END
  ) AS chamber,
  CASE
   WHEN bool_or(coalesce(r.is_subcommittee,substr(r.norm_code,5,2)<>'00')) THEN 'subcommittee'
   WHEN r.norm_code LIKE 'j%' THEN 'joint'
   ELSE 'standing'
  END AS committee_type,
  CASE
   WHEN substr(r.norm_code,5,2)<>'00' THEN coalesce(max(r.parent_system_code),substr(r.norm_code,1,4)||'00')
   ELSE cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)
  END AS parent_system_code,
  cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS website,
  false AS is_current
 FROM roster_normalized_committees r
 LEFT ANTI JOIN base_committees b ON b.norm_code=r.norm_code
 GROUP BY r.norm_code
), all_committees AS (
 SELECT * FROM base_committees
 UNION ALL
 SELECT * FROM synthesized_committees
)
SELECT c.norm_code AS system_code,
 c.name,
 c.chamber,
 c.committee_type,
 c.parent_system_code,
 coalesce(n.names,array_slice(make_array(named_struct(
  'name',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'start',cast(NULL AS DATE),'end',cast(NULL AS DATE)
 )),1,0)) AS names,
 c.website,
 c.is_current
FROM all_committees c
LEFT JOIN names_agg n ON c.norm_code=n.agg_system_code

specification.name: members_export
specification.sql:
WITH parsed_terms AS (
 SELECT bioguide_id,
  CASE lower(trim(term_type))
   WHEN 'rep' THEN 'house'
   WHEN 'sen' THEN 'senate'
   ELSE lower(nullif(trim(term_type),''))
  END AS chamber,
  nullif(trim(term_state),'') AS state,
  try_cast(term_district AS SMALLINT) AS district,
  nullif(trim(term_party),'') AS party,
  try_cast(term_start AS DATE) AS start_date,
  try_cast(term_end AS DATE) AS end_date
 FROM spicy_member_terms WHERE bioguide_id IS NOT NULL
), ranked_terms AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER (
  PARTITION BY bioguide_id
  ORDER BY start_date DESC NULLS LAST,end_date DESC NULLS LAST,chamber ASC
 ) AS term_seq
 FROM parsed_terms
), terms_agg AS (
 SELECT bioguide_id,array_agg(named_struct(
  'chamber',chamber,'state',state,'district',district,'party',party,'start',start_date,'end',end_date
 ) ORDER BY term_seq ASC) AS terms
 FROM ranked_terms GROUP BY bioguide_id
)
SELECT m.bioguide_id,
 trim(coalesce(m.name_first,'')||' '||coalesce(m.name_last,'')) AS name,
 coalesce(t.terms,array_slice(make_array(named_struct(
  'chamber',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'state',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'district',cast(NULL AS SMALLINT),
  'party',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'start',cast(NULL AS DATE),'end',cast(NULL AS DATE)
 )),1,0)) AS terms,
 named_struct(
  'lis',nullif(trim(cast(m.lis_id AS VARCHAR)),''),
  'opensecrets',nullif(trim(cast(m.opensecrets_id AS VARCHAR)),''),
  'govtrack',nullif(trim(cast(m.govtrack_id AS VARCHAR)),''),
  'icpsr',nullif(trim(cast(m.icpsr_id AS VARCHAR)),''),
  'wikidata',nullif(trim(cast(m.wikidata_id AS VARCHAR)),''),
  'fec',coalesce(m.fec_ids,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)'))
 ) AS cross_ids
FROM spicy_members m
LEFT JOIN terms_agg t ON m.bioguide_id=t.bioguide_id
WHERE m.bioguide_id IS NOT NULL

specification.name: rosters_export
specification.sql:
WITH committee_code_map AS (
 SELECT raw_key,min(system_code) AS norm_code
 FROM (
  SELECT upper(trim(code)) AS raw_key,lower(trim(system_code)) AS system_code FROM committee_codes WHERE code IS NOT NULL AND system_code IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'HS'||upper(trim(code)) AS raw_key,lower(trim(system_code)) AS system_code FROM committee_codes WHERE chamber='house' AND length(trim(code))=4 AND system_code IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT upper(trim(system_code)) AS raw_key,lower(trim(system_code)) AS system_code FROM committee_codes WHERE system_code IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'HSJL00' AS raw_key,'jslc00' AS system_code
  UNION ALL SELECT 'HSIT00' AS raw_key,'jstx00' AS system_code
  UNION ALL SELECT 'HSEC00' AS raw_key,'jsec00' AS system_code
  UNION ALL SELECT 'HSJP00' AS raw_key,'jspr00' AS system_code
 )
 GROUP BY raw_key
), normalized_assignments AS (
 SELECT
  cast(a.congress AS SMALLINT) AS congress,
  nullif(trim(a.session),'') AS session,
  coalesce(ccm.norm_code,lower(trim(a.system_code))) AS system_code,
  trim(a.bioguide_id) AS bioguide_id,
  nullif(trim(a.position),'') AS title,
  CASE WHEN nullif(trim(a.position),'') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS title_missing,
  try_cast(nullif(trim(cast(a.rank AS VARCHAR)),'') AS INT) AS parsed_rank,
  nullif(trim(a.party),'') AS raw_party,
  nullif(trim(a.name_last),'') AS name_last,
  nullif(trim(a.name_first),'') AS name_first
 FROM spicy_committee_assignments a
 LEFT JOIN committee_code_map ccm ON ccm.raw_key=upper(trim(a.system_code))
 WHERE a.congress IS NOT NULL
   AND a.system_code IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.system_code)<>''
   AND a.bioguide_id IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.bioguide_id)<>''
), dedup_assignments AS (
 SELECT *,
  row_number() OVER (
   PARTITION BY congress,system_code,bioguide_id
   ORDER BY session DESC NULLS LAST,title_missing ASC,parsed_rank ASC NULLS LAST
  ) AS rn
 FROM normalized_assignments
), distinct_roster_congresses AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT congress FROM dedup_assignments WHERE rn=1
), member_term_parsed AS (
 SELECT
  trim(bioguide_id) AS m_bioguide_id,
  nullif(trim(term_party),'') AS term_party,
  try_cast(substr(trim(term_start),1,4) AS INT) AS start_year,
  try_cast(substr(trim(term_end),1,4) AS INT) AS end_year,
  try_cast(substr(trim(term_start),1,10) AS DATE) AS start_date,
  try_cast(substr(trim(term_end),1,10) AS DATE) AS end_date
 FROM spicy_member_terms
 WHERE bioguide_id IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim(term_party),'') IS NOT NULL
), member_congress_candidates AS (
 SELECT
  c.congress AS m_congress,
  t.m_bioguide_id,
  t.term_party,
  t.start_date,
  CASE
   WHEN t.start_year < 1789 + (cast(c.congress AS INT) - 1) * 2 + 2
    AND coalesce(t.end_year,9999) >= 1789 + (cast(c.congress AS INT) - 1) * 2
    AND (t.end_date IS NULL OR t.end_date > make_date(1789 + (cast(c.congress AS INT) - 1) * 2,1,3))
   THEN 0
   WHEN t.start_year < 1789 + (cast(c.congress AS INT) - 1) * 2 + 2
    AND coalesce(t.end_year,9999) >= 1789 + (cast(c.congress AS INT) - 1) * 2
   THEN 1
   ELSE 2
  END AS overlap_rank
 FROM distinct_roster_congresses c
 CROSS JOIN member_term_parsed t
), member_parties AS (
 SELECT m_congress,m_bioguide_id,term_party
 FROM (
  SELECT m_congress,m_bioguide_id,term_party,
   row_number() OVER (
    PARTITION BY m_congress,m_bioguide_id
    ORDER BY overlap_rank ASC,start_date DESC NULLS LAST
   ) AS rn
  FROM member_congress_candidates
 )
 WHERE rn=1
), with_party AS (
 SELECT
  d.congress,
  d.system_code,
  d.bioguide_id,
  d.title,
  d.title_missing,
  d.parsed_rank,
  CASE WHEN d.parsed_rank IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rank_missing,
  d.name_last,
  d.name_first,
  coalesce(d.raw_party,mp.term_party) AS party
 FROM dedup_assignments d
 LEFT JOIN member_parties mp ON mp.m_congress=d.congress AND mp.m_bioguide_id=d.bioguide_id
 WHERE d.rn=1
), ranked_rosters AS (
 SELECT
  congress,
  system_code,
  bioguide_id,
  title,
  party,
  parsed_rank,
  coalesce(max(parsed_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY congress,system_code,party),0) AS max_explicit_rank,
  row_number() OVER (
   PARTITION BY congress,system_code,party,rank_missing
   ORDER BY title_missing ASC,name_last ASC NULLS LAST,name_first ASC NULLS LAST,bioguide_id ASC
  ) AS missing_rank_seq
 FROM with_party
)
SELECT
 congress,
 system_code,
 bioguide_id,
 title,
 cast(coalesce(parsed_rank,max_explicit_rank + missing_rank_seq) AS SMALLINT) AS rank,
 party
FROM ranked_rosters

specification.name: bills_export
specification.sql:
WITH direct_referenced_bills AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT lower(trim(unnest(measure_keys))) AS bill_id FROM ordered WHERE measure_keys IS NOT NULL
 UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT lower(trim(unnest(subject_keys))) AS bill_id FROM meetings_resolved WHERE subject_keys IS NOT NULL
 UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT lower(trim(unnest(subject_keys))) AS bill_id FROM meetings_export WHERE subject_keys IS NOT NULL
 UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT lower(trim(bill_id)) AS bill_id
 FROM spicy_bill_committee_activities
 WHERE bill_id IS NOT NULL
   AND try_cast(split_part(lower(trim(bill_id)),'-',1) AS INT)>=113
   AND activity_name IS NOT NULL
   AND NOT regexp_like(lower(trim(activity_name)),'^referred')
 UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT lower(trim(bill_id)) AS bill_id
 FROM spicy_cbo_cost_estimates
 WHERE bill_id IS NOT NULL
   AND try_cast(split_part(lower(trim(bill_id)),'-',1) AS INT)>=113
 UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT lower(trim(bill_id)) AS bill_id
 FROM spicy_roll_call_votes
 WHERE bill_id IS NOT NULL AND trim(bill_id)<>''
   AND try_cast(split_part(lower(trim(bill_id)),'-',1) AS INT)>=113
 UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT lower(trim(bill_id)) AS bill_id
 FROM spicy_bill_vote_references
 WHERE bill_id IS NOT NULL AND trim(bill_id)<>''
   AND try_cast(split_part(lower(trim(bill_id)),'-',1) AS INT)>=113
), substantive_bills AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT lower(trim(bill_id)) AS bill_id
 FROM spicy_congress_bills
 WHERE bill_id IS NOT NULL
   AND try_cast(split_part(lower(trim(bill_id)),'-',1) AS INT)>=113
   AND ((public_law_number IS NOT NULL AND trim(public_law_number)<>'') OR coalesce(try_cast(cosponsor_count AS INT),0)>=10)
), related_bill_unnested AS (
 SELECT
  lower(trim(cb.bill_id)) AS source_bill_id,
  lower(trim(r['congress']))||'-'||lower(trim(r['bill_type']))||'-'||lower(trim(r['number'])) AS target_bill_id,
  nullif(trim(r['title']),'') AS target_title,
  r['relationship_details'] AS relationship_details
 FROM (
  SELECT bill_id,unnest(related_bills) AS r
  FROM spicy_congress_bills
  WHERE bill_id IS NOT NULL AND related_bills IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(array_length(related_bills),0)>0
 ) cb
 WHERE r['congress'] IS NOT NULL AND trim(r['congress'])<>''
   AND r['bill_type'] IS NOT NULL AND trim(r['bill_type'])<>''
   AND r['number'] IS NOT NULL AND trim(r['number'])<>''
), referenced_bills AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT bill_id FROM direct_referenced_bills WHERE bill_id IS NOT NULL AND bill_id<>''
 UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT bill_id FROM substantive_bills WHERE bill_id IS NOT NULL AND bill_id<>''
 UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT e.target_bill_id AS bill_id
 FROM related_bill_unnested e
 JOIN direct_referenced_bills s ON s.bill_id=e.source_bill_id
 UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT e.source_bill_id AS bill_id
 FROM related_bill_unnested e
 JOIN direct_referenced_bills s ON s.bill_id=e.target_bill_id
), related_bills_filtered AS (
 SELECT e.source_bill_id,e.target_bill_id,e.target_title,e.relationship_details
 FROM related_bill_unnested e
 JOIN referenced_bills rb ON rb.bill_id=e.source_bill_id
), related_bill_types AS (
 SELECT
  source_bill_id,
  target_bill_id,
  nullif(trim(rd['type']),'') AS rel_type
 FROM (
  SELECT source_bill_id,target_bill_id,unnest(relationship_details) AS rd
  FROM related_bills_filtered
  WHERE relationship_details IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(array_length(relationship_details),0)>0
 )
 WHERE nullif(trim(rd['type']),'') IS NOT NULL
), related_bill_types_agg AS (
 SELECT
  source_bill_id,
  target_bill_id,
  array_sort(array_distinct(array_agg(rel_type))) AS relationship_types
 FROM related_bill_types
 GROUP BY source_bill_id,target_bill_id
), related_bills_dedup AS (
 SELECT
  f.source_bill_id,
  f.target_bill_id,
  max(f.target_title) AS title,
  coalesce(
   t.relationship_types,
   arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')
  ) AS relationship_types
 FROM related_bills_filtered f
 LEFT JOIN related_bill_types_agg t
  ON t.source_bill_id=f.source_bill_id AND t.target_bill_id=f.target_bill_id
 GROUP BY f.source_bill_id,f.target_bill_id,t.relationship_types
), related_bills_sorted AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER (
  PARTITION BY source_bill_id
  ORDER BY target_bill_id ASC
 ) AS rel_seq
 FROM related_bills_dedup
), related_bills_agg AS (
 SELECT source_bill_id AS bill_id,
  array_agg(named_struct(
   'bill_id',target_bill_id,
   'title',title,
   'relationship_types',relationship_types
  ) ORDER BY rel_seq ASC) AS related_bills
 FROM related_bills_sorted
 GROUP BY source_bill_id
), bill_committees_agg AS (
 SELECT lower(trim(c.bill_id)) AS bill_id,
  array_sort(array_distinct(array_agg(lower(trim(c.system_code))))) AS committees
 FROM spicy_bill_committees c
 JOIN referenced_bills rb ON lower(trim(c.bill_id))=rb.bill_id
 WHERE c.bill_id IS NOT NULL AND c.system_code IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY lower(trim(c.bill_id))
), cbo_parsed AS (
 SELECT lower(trim(c.bill_id)) AS bill_id,
  c.publication_id,
  coalesce(try_cast(c.pub_date AS DATE),cast(arrow_cast(try_cast(c.pub_date AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Second, Some("America/New_York"))') AS DATE)) AS pub_date,
  c.description
 FROM spicy_cbo_cost_estimates c
 JOIN referenced_bills rb ON lower(trim(c.bill_id))=rb.bill_id
 WHERE c.bill_id IS NOT NULL
), cbo_sorted AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER (
  PARTITION BY bill_id
  ORDER BY pub_date ASC NULLS LAST,publication_id ASC
 ) AS cbo_seq
 FROM cbo_parsed
), cbo_agg AS (
 SELECT bill_id,
  array_agg(named_struct(
   'publication_id',publication_id,
   'date',pub_date,
   'description',description
  ) ORDER BY cbo_seq ASC) AS cbo_estimates
 FROM cbo_sorted
 GROUP BY bill_id
), raw_votes AS (
 SELECT lower(trim(v.bill_id)) AS bill_id,
  v.vote_id,'vote_record' AS basis,
  CASE lower(trim(v.chamber)) WHEN 'h' THEN 'house' WHEN 's' THEN 'senate' ELSE lower(trim(v.chamber)) END AS chamber,
  coalesce(try_cast(v.vote_day AS DATE),cast(arrow_cast(try_cast(v.vote_day AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Second, Some("America/New_York"))') AS DATE)) AS vote_date,
  v.question,v.result,try_cast(v.yea AS SMALLINT) AS yea,try_cast(v.nay AS SMALLINT) AS nay,
  1 AS basis_rank
 FROM spicy_roll_call_votes v
 JOIN referenced_bills rb ON lower(trim(v.bill_id))=rb.bill_id
 WHERE v.bill_id IS NOT NULL AND trim(v.bill_id)<>''
 UNION ALL
 SELECT lower(trim(r.bill_id)) AS bill_id,
  v.vote_id,'bill_action' AS basis,
  CASE lower(trim(v.chamber)) WHEN 'h' THEN 'house' WHEN 's' THEN 'senate' ELSE lower(trim(v.chamber)) END AS chamber,
  coalesce(try_cast(v.vote_day AS DATE),cast(arrow_cast(try_cast(v.vote_day AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Second, Some("America/New_York"))') AS DATE)) AS vote_date,
  v.question,v.result,try_cast(v.yea AS SMALLINT) AS yea,try_cast(v.nay AS SMALLINT) AS nay,
  2 AS basis_rank
 FROM spicy_bill_vote_references r
 JOIN referenced_bills rb ON lower(trim(r.bill_id))=rb.bill_id
 JOIN spicy_roll_call_votes v
  ON cast(v.congress AS VARCHAR)=cast(r.congress AS VARCHAR)
  AND (CASE lower(trim(v.chamber)) WHEN 'h' THEN 'house' WHEN 's' THEN 'senate' ELSE lower(trim(v.chamber)) END)
    = (CASE lower(trim(r.chamber)) WHEN 'h' THEN 'house' WHEN 's' THEN 'senate' ELSE lower(trim(r.chamber)) END)
  AND cast(v.session AS VARCHAR)=cast(r.session AS VARCHAR)
  AND cast(v.roll_number AS VARCHAR)=cast(r.roll_number AS VARCHAR)
 WHERE r.bill_id IS NOT NULL
), dedup_votes AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY bill_id,vote_id ORDER BY basis_rank ASC) AS rn
 FROM raw_votes WHERE vote_id IS NOT NULL
), votes_sorted AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER (
  PARTITION BY bill_id
  ORDER BY vote_date ASC NULLS LAST,vote_id ASC
 ) AS vote_seq
 FROM dedup_votes WHERE rn=1
), votes_agg AS (
 SELECT bill_id,array_agg(named_struct(
  'vote_id',vote_id,'basis',basis,'chamber',chamber,'date',vote_date,
  'question',question,'result',result,'yea',yea,'nay',nay
 ) ORDER BY vote_seq ASC) AS floor_votes
 FROM votes_sorted GROUP BY bill_id
), amdt_base AS (
 SELECT lower(trim(amendment_id)) AS amendment_id,purpose,sponsor_bioguide_id,
  coalesce(try_cast(latest_action_date AS DATE),cast(arrow_cast(try_cast(latest_action_date AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Second, Some("America/New_York"))') AS DATE)) AS latest_action_date,
  latest_action_text,
  lower(nullif(trim(amended_bill_id),'')) AS amended_bill_id,
  lower(nullif(trim(amended_amendment_id),'')) AS amended_amendment_id
 FROM spicy_amendments WHERE amendment_id IS NOT NULL
), amdt_resolved AS (
 SELECT coalesce(a0.amended_bill_id,a1.amended_bill_id,a2.amended_bill_id,a3.amended_bill_id) AS bill_id,
  a0.amendment_id,a0.purpose,a0.sponsor_bioguide_id,a0.latest_action_date,a0.latest_action_text
 FROM amdt_base a0
 LEFT JOIN amdt_base a1 ON a0.amended_bill_id IS NULL AND a0.amended_amendment_id=a1.amendment_id
 LEFT JOIN amdt_base a2 ON a0.amended_bill_id IS NULL AND a1.amended_bill_id IS NULL AND a1.amended_amendment_id=a2.amendment_id
 LEFT JOIN amdt_base a3 ON a0.amended_bill_id IS NULL AND a1.amended_bill_id IS NULL AND a2.amended_bill_id IS NULL AND a2.amended_amendment_id=a3.amendment_id
), amdt_dedup AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT ar.*
 FROM amdt_resolved ar
 JOIN referenced_bills rb ON ar.bill_id=rb.bill_id
 WHERE ar.bill_id IS NOT NULL
), amdt_sorted AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER (
  PARTITION BY bill_id
  ORDER BY latest_action_date ASC NULLS LAST,amendment_id ASC
 ) AS amdt_seq
 FROM amdt_dedup
), amendments_agg AS (
 SELECT bill_id,array_agg(named_struct(
  'amendment_id',amendment_id,'purpose',purpose,'sponsor_bioguide_id',sponsor_bioguide_id,
  'latest_action_date',latest_action_date,'latest_action_text',latest_action_text
 ) ORDER BY amdt_seq ASC) AS amendments
 FROM amdt_sorted GROUP BY bill_id
), activities_parsed AS (
 SELECT lower(trim(a.bill_id)) AS bill_id,
  lower(trim(a.system_code)) AS system_code,
  a.activity_name AS activity,
  coalesce(try_cast(a.activity_date AS DATE),cast(arrow_cast(try_cast(a.activity_date AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Second, Some("America/New_York"))') AS DATE)) AS act_date,
  coalesce(a.occurrence,0) AS occurrence
 FROM spicy_bill_committee_activities a
 JOIN referenced_bills rb ON lower(trim(a.bill_id))=rb.bill_id
 WHERE a.bill_id IS NOT NULL AND a.system_code IS NOT NULL AND a.activity_name IS NOT NULL
), activities_sorted AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER (
  PARTITION BY bill_id
  ORDER BY act_date ASC NULLS LAST,occurrence ASC,system_code ASC,activity ASC
 ) AS act_seq
 FROM activities_parsed
), activities_agg AS (
 SELECT bill_id,array_agg(named_struct(
  'system_code',system_code,'activity',activity,'date',act_date
 ) ORDER BY act_seq ASC) AS committee_activities
 FROM activities_sorted GROUP BY bill_id
), base_bills AS (
 SELECT lower(trim(bill_id)) AS norm_bill_id,
  title,short_title,
  nullif(trim(sponsor_bioguide_id),'') AS sponsor_bioguide_id,
  coalesce(try_cast(introduced_date AS DATE),cast(arrow_cast(try_cast(introduced_date AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Second, Some("America/New_York"))') AS DATE)) AS introduced,
  coalesce(try_cast(latest_action_date AS DATE),cast(arrow_cast(try_cast(latest_action_date AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Second, Some("America/New_York"))') AS DATE)) AS latest_action_date,
  latest_action_text,
  nullif(trim(stage),'') AS stage,
  nullif(trim(policy_area),'') AS policy_area,
  nullif(trim(public_law_number),'') AS public_law_number,
  try_cast(cosponsor_count AS INT) AS cosponsor_count
 FROM spicy_congress_bills WHERE bill_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT b.norm_bill_id AS bill_id,
 b.title,b.short_title,
 b.sponsor_bioguide_id,
 b.introduced,
 b.latest_action_date,
 b.latest_action_text,
 b.stage,
 b.policy_area,
 b.public_law_number,
 b.cosponsor_count,
 coalesce(rel.related_bills,array_slice(make_array(named_struct(
  'bill_id',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),
  'title',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),
  'relationship_types',arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')
 )),1,0)) AS related_bills,
 coalesce(c.committees,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')) AS committees,
 coalesce(cbo.cbo_estimates,array_slice(make_array(named_struct(
  'publication_id',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'date',cast(NULL AS DATE),'description',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)
 )),1,0)) AS cbo_estimates,
 coalesce(v.floor_votes,array_slice(make_array(named_struct(
  'vote_id',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'basis',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'chamber',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),
  'date',cast(NULL AS DATE),'question',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'result',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),
  'yea',cast(NULL AS SMALLINT),'nay',cast(NULL AS SMALLINT)
 )),1,0)) AS floor_votes,
 coalesce(a.amendments,array_slice(make_array(named_struct(
  'amendment_id',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'purpose',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'sponsor_bioguide_id',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),
  'latest_action_date',cast(NULL AS DATE),'latest_action_text',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)
 )),1,0)) AS amendments,
 coalesce(act.committee_activities,array_slice(make_array(named_struct(
  'system_code',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'activity',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'date',cast(NULL AS DATE)
 )),1,0)) AS committee_activities
FROM base_bills b
JOIN referenced_bills rb ON b.norm_bill_id=rb.bill_id
LEFT JOIN related_bills_agg rel ON b.norm_bill_id=rel.bill_id
LEFT JOIN bill_committees_agg c ON b.norm_bill_id=c.bill_id
LEFT JOIN cbo_agg cbo ON b.norm_bill_id=cbo.bill_id
LEFT JOIN votes_agg v ON b.norm_bill_id=v.bill_id
LEFT JOIN amendments_agg a ON b.norm_bill_id=a.bill_id
LEFT JOIN activities_agg act ON b.norm_bill_id=act.bill_id

specification.name: nominations_export
specification.sql:
WITH referenced_nominations AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT lower(trim(unnest(subject_keys))) AS nomination_id FROM meetings_export WHERE subject_keys IS NOT NULL
 UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT lower(trim(unnest(measure_keys))) AS nomination_id FROM ordered WHERE measure_keys IS NOT NULL
), keyed_nominations AS (
 SELECT
  cast(congress AS VARCHAR)||'-pn-'||cast(number AS VARCHAR)||
  CASE WHEN part_number IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(part_number AS INT) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(part_number AS INT)<>0
       THEN '-'||regexp_replace(trim(part_number),'^0+','') ELSE '' END AS nomination_id,
  congress,number,part_number,description,organization,received_date,
  latest_action_date,latest_action_text,committee_activities,hearings_json
 FROM spicy_nominations WHERE congress IS NOT NULL AND number IS NOT NULL
), matched_nominations AS (
 SELECT k.* FROM keyed_nominations k
 JOIN referenced_nominations r ON k.nomination_id=r.nomination_id
), committee_groups AS (
 SELECT nomination_id,unnest(committee_activities) AS committee FROM matched_nominations
), committee_extracted AS (
 SELECT nomination_id,lower(trim(committee['system_code'])) AS system_code FROM committee_groups
), committees_agg AS (
 SELECT nomination_id,array_sort(array_distinct(array_agg(system_code))) AS committees
 FROM committee_extracted WHERE system_code IS NOT NULL AND system_code<>''
 GROUP BY nomination_id
), hearing_chunks AS (
 SELECT nomination_id,congress,unnest(string_to_array(hearings_json,'}')) AS chunk
 FROM matched_nominations WHERE hearings_json IS NOT NULL
), hearing_extracted AS (
 SELECT nomination_id,
  coalesce(
   (regexp_match(chunk,'(?i)"package_?id"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"'))[1],
   (regexp_match(chunk,'(CHRG-[0-9]+[hsj]hrg[0-9]+)'))[1],
   CASE WHEN regexp_like(chunk,'(?i)"jacket(?:_?number)?"\s*:\s*"?([0-9]+)"?')
    THEN 'CHRG-'||cast(congress AS VARCHAR)||
     (CASE lower(coalesce((regexp_match(chunk,'(?i)"chamber"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"'))[1],'senate'))
      WHEN 'house' THEN 'h' WHEN 'joint' THEN 'j' ELSE 's' END)||'hrg'||
     (regexp_match(chunk,'(?i)"jacket(?:_?number)?"\s*:\s*"?([0-9]+)"?'))[1]
   END
  ) AS package_id
 FROM hearing_chunks
), transcripts_agg AS (
 SELECT nomination_id,array_sort(array_distinct(array_agg(package_id))) AS transcripts
 FROM hearing_extracted WHERE package_id IS NOT NULL AND package_id<>''
 GROUP BY nomination_id
), vote_docs AS (
 SELECT v.vote_id,v.congress AS vote_congress,v.chamber,v.vote_day,v.question,v.result,v.yea,v.nay,
  unnest(v.documents) AS doc
 FROM spicy_roll_call_votes v
 WHERE v.documents IS NOT NULL AND lower(trim(v.chamber)) IN ('s','senate')
), pn_votes AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT
  coalesce(cast(doc['congress'] AS VARCHAR),cast(vote_congress AS VARCHAR))||'-pn-'||
  regexp_replace(
   regexp_replace(
    regexp_replace(lower(trim(doc['number'])),'^(?:pn\s*)?0*([0-9]+)', '$1'),
    '-0+([1-9][0-9]*)$','-$1'
   ),
   '-0+$',''
  ) AS nomination_id,
  vote_id,
  coalesce(try_cast(vote_day AS DATE),cast(arrow_cast(try_cast(vote_day AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Second, Some("America/New_York"))') AS DATE)) AS vote_date,
  question,result,try_cast(yea AS SMALLINT) AS yea,try_cast(nay AS SMALLINT) AS nay
 FROM vote_docs
 WHERE upper(trim(doc['type']))='PN' AND doc['number'] IS NOT NULL
), pn_votes_matched AS (
 SELECT pv.*
 FROM pn_votes pv
 JOIN matched_nominations mn ON pv.nomination_id=mn.nomination_id
), pn_votes_sorted AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER (
  PARTITION BY nomination_id
  ORDER BY vote_date ASC NULLS LAST,vote_id ASC
 ) AS vote_seq
 FROM pn_votes_matched
), votes_agg AS (
 SELECT nomination_id,array_agg(named_struct(
  'vote_id',vote_id,'date',vote_date,'question',question,'result',result,'yea',yea,'nay',nay
 ) ORDER BY vote_seq ASC) AS floor_votes
 FROM pn_votes_sorted GROUP BY nomination_id
)
SELECT m.nomination_id,
 m.description,m.organization,
 coalesce(try_cast(m.received_date AS DATE),cast(arrow_cast(try_cast(m.received_date AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Second, Some("America/New_York"))') AS DATE)) AS received,
 coalesce(try_cast(m.latest_action_date AS DATE),cast(arrow_cast(try_cast(m.latest_action_date AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Second, Some("America/New_York"))') AS DATE)) AS latest_action_date,
 m.latest_action_text,m.committee_activities,
 coalesce(c.committees,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')) AS committees,
 coalesce(t.transcripts,arrow_cast(array_slice(make_array(cast(NULL AS VARCHAR)),1,0),'List(Utf8)')) AS transcripts,
 coalesce(v.floor_votes,array_slice(make_array(named_struct(
  'vote_id',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'date',cast(NULL AS DATE),'question',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),
  'result',cast(NULL AS VARCHAR),'yea',cast(NULL AS SMALLINT),'nay',cast(NULL AS SMALLINT)
 )),1,0)) AS floor_votes
FROM matched_nominations m
LEFT JOIN committees_agg c ON m.nomination_id=c.nomination_id
LEFT JOIN transcripts_agg t ON m.nomination_id=t.nomination_id
LEFT JOIN votes_agg v ON m.nomination_id=v.nomination_id

specification.name: videos_export
specification.sql:
WITH selected AS (
 SELECT v.record_sha,v.videos,0 AS precedence
 FROM selected_video_records v
 JOIN youtube_cache_bodies b ON encode(v.record_sha,'hex')=b.record_sha
 WHERE v.status='completed' AND v.source='youtube_cache'
 UNION ALL
 -- API videos fill only video IDs no cache lists (unlisted uploads, unprocessed live archives).
 SELECT v.record_sha,v.videos,1 AS precedence
 FROM selected_video_records v
 JOIN youtube_api_bodies b ON encode(v.record_sha,'hex')=b.record_sha
 WHERE v.status='completed' AND v.source='youtube_api'
), channel_handles AS (
 SELECT channel_id,min(handle) AS handle FROM channel_directory WHERE channel_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY channel_id
), expanded AS (
 SELECT s.record_sha,s.precedence,s.v,CASE WHEN s.precedence=0 THEN s.v['handle'] ELSE h.handle END AS handle
 FROM (SELECT record_sha,precedence,unnest(videos) AS v FROM selected) s
 LEFT JOIN channel_handles h ON s.precedence=1 AND h.channel_id=s.v['channel_id']
), ranked AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY v['video_id'] ORDER BY precedence,handle,encode(record_sha,'hex')) AS rn
 FROM expanded WHERE handle IS NOT NULL AND handle<>''
)
SELECT concat('youtube:',r.v['video_id']) AS video_key,
 r.handle AS handle,
 r.v['channel_id'] AS channel_id,
 d.system_code,
 r.v['title'] AS title,
 r.v['description'] AS source_description,
 arrow_cast(try_cast(r.v['published_at'] AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))') AS published_at,
 arrow_cast(try_cast(r.v['video_published_at'] AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))') AS video_published_at,
 r.v['duration_seconds'] AS duration_seconds,
 r.v['available'] AS available,
 r.v['has_caption'] AS has_caption,
 arrow_cast(try_cast(r.v['details_checked_at'] AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE),'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))') AS details_checked_at,
 r.v['stated_event_ids'] AS stated_event_ids,
 r.record_sha
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN channel_directory d ON d.handle=r.handle
WHERE r.rn=1

specification.name: recording_matches_export
specification.sql:
WITH publisher AS (
 SELECT event_id,unnest(videos) AS v FROM meetings_resolved
), publisher_rows AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT cast('event' AS VARCHAR) AS subject_kind,cast(event_id AS VARCHAR) AS subject_id,
  event_id,cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS package_id,v['video_key'] AS video_key,v['url'] AS url,
  cast('publisher_link' AS VARCHAR) AS basis,cast('linked' AS VARCHAR) AS decision,cast(100 AS SMALLINT) AS score,
  cast('unknown' AS VARCHAR) AS recording_scope,cast('asserted' AS VARCHAR) AS status,
  cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS note,cast('meetings.videos' AS VARCHAR) AS source_ref
 FROM publisher
), stated AS (
 SELECT video_key,encode(record_sha,'hex') AS record_hex,unnest(stated_event_ids) AS stated_id FROM videos_export
), stated_rows AS (
 -- A video's own text is a claim: committees mistag. A number no meeting has stays visible.
 SELECT cast('event' AS VARCHAR) AS subject_kind,cast(s.stated_id AS VARCHAR) AS subject_id,
  m.event_id,cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS package_id,s.video_key,cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS url,
  cast('video_states_event_id' AS VARCHAR) AS basis,cast('linked' AS VARCHAR) AS decision,
  CASE WHEN m.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN cast(95 AS SMALLINT) END AS score,
  cast('unknown' AS VARCHAR) AS recording_scope,cast('claimed' AS VARCHAR) AS status,
  CASE WHEN m.event_id IS NULL THEN concat('stated event id ',cast(s.stated_id AS VARCHAR),' has no meeting') END AS note,
  concat('video_records:',s.record_hex) AS source_ref
 FROM stated s LEFT JOIN meetings_export m ON m.event_id=s.stated_id
), linked_packages AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT l.package_id FROM meeting_transcript_links l JOIN publisher_rows p ON p.event_id=l.event_id
), refs AS (
 SELECT id,subject_kind,subject_id,verdict,note,disputed_by,unnest(video_refs) AS ref
 FROM active_recording_decisions WHERE array_length(video_refs)>0
 UNION ALL
 SELECT id,subject_kind,subject_id,verdict,note,disputed_by,cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS ref
 FROM active_recording_decisions WHERE coalesce(array_length(video_refs),0)=0
), curated_rows AS (
 SELECT r.subject_kind,r.subject_id,
  CASE WHEN r.subject_kind='event' THEN try_cast(r.subject_id AS BIGINT) END AS event_id,
  CASE WHEN r.subject_kind='package' THEN r.subject_id END AS package_id,
  CASE WHEN r.ref IS NOT NULL AND NOT regexp_like(r.ref,'^https?://') THEN concat('youtube:',r.ref) END AS video_key,
  CASE WHEN regexp_like(r.ref,'^https?://') THEN r.ref END AS url,
  cast('curated' AS VARCHAR) AS basis,r.verdict AS decision,cast(NULL AS SMALLINT) AS score,
  CASE WHEN r.verdict='partial_only' THEN 'excerpt' WHEN r.verdict LIKE 'found%' THEN 'full' ELSE 'unknown' END AS recording_scope,
  -- A negative verdict against a publisher's link is a conflict to show, not to settle.
  -- Old evidence against a negative verdict leaves it open until the native matcher decides.
  CASE WHEN r.verdict IN ('no_video_found','not_public') AND p.package_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'conflicting'
       WHEN r.disputed_by IS NOT NULL THEN 'unresolved' ELSE 'decided' END AS status,
  CASE WHEN r.disputed_by IS NOT NULL THEN concat_ws(' | ',r.note,concat('disputed by ',r.disputed_by)) ELSE r.note END AS note,concat('recording_decisions:',r.id) AS source_ref
 FROM refs r LEFT JOIN linked_packages p ON r.subject_kind='package' AND r.subject_id=p.package_id
), all_rows AS (
 SELECT * FROM publisher_rows UNION ALL SELECT * FROM stated_rows UNION ALL SELECT * FROM curated_rows
), keyed AS (
 SELECT *,encode(sha256(json_array(subject_kind,subject_id,coalesce(video_key,url,''),basis)),'hex') AS match_id FROM all_rows
), ranked AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY source_ref,url) AS rn FROM keyed
), package_links AS (
 -- The printed hearing can cover several sittings. Its agreement with a meeting
 -- establishes related package evidence, independent of which sitting a locator covers.
 SELECT package_id,array_agg(named_struct(
  'event_id',event_id,
  'basis',arrow_cast('print_agreement','Dictionary(Int32, Utf8)'),
  'scope',arrow_cast('package_context','Dictionary(Int32, Utf8)')
 ) ORDER BY event_id) AS meeting_links
 FROM package_meeting_links GROUP BY package_id
)
SELECT r.match_id,r.subject_kind,r.subject_id,r.event_id,r.package_id,r.video_key,r.url,r.basis,
 r.decision,r.score,r.recording_scope,r.status,r.note,r.source_ref,
 CASE WHEN e.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN make_array(named_struct(
  'event_id',e.event_id,
  'basis',arrow_cast('direct_event','Dictionary(Int32, Utf8)'),
  'scope',arrow_cast('event','Dictionary(Int32, Utf8)')
 ))
 ELSE coalesce(p.meeting_links,array_slice(make_array(named_struct(
  'event_id',cast(NULL AS BIGINT),
  'basis',arrow_cast(NULL,'Dictionary(Int32, Utf8)'),
  'scope',arrow_cast(NULL,'Dictionary(Int32, Utf8)')
 )),1,0)) END AS meeting_links
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN meetings_export e ON r.event_id=e.event_id
LEFT JOIN package_links p ON r.package_id=p.package_id
WHERE r.rn=1
