specification.name: meeting_coverage_export
specification.sql:
-- States rank present > unresolved > empty > unknown > not_stated. unknown, never not_stated, where held
-- evidence is not yet linked. A Senate meeting is unknown for documents and witnesses until the Senate
-- committee-page links land (ct-gi01 R2): those pages are held but not linked to meetings. Remove the
-- senate_page_links_pending arms then; old page decisions came from the distrusted old matcher.
WITH observations AS (
 SELECT unnest(meeting_links) AS link,basis,status,decision,recording_scope,video_key,coalesce(video_key,url) AS ref
 FROM recording_matches_export
), recording_links AS (
 SELECT link['event_id'] AS event_id,link['scope'] AS scope,basis,status,decision,recording_scope,video_key,ref
 FROM observations
), recording_refs AS (
 -- Each locator counts once, even if independent observations cite it.
 SELECT m.event_id,m.ref,
  bool_or(m.scope='event' AND (m.status='asserted' OR (m.status='decided' AND m.recording_scope='full'))) AS full_recording,
  bool_or(m.scope='event' AND m.status='decided' AND m.recording_scope='excerpt') AS excerpt,
  bool_or(m.scope='event' AND m.status='claimed') AS claimed,
  bool_or(m.scope='event' AND m.basis='curated' AND m.status='decided' AND m.decision='not_public') AS not_public,
  bool_or(m.scope='event' AND m.basis='curated' AND m.status='decided' AND m.decision='no_video_found') AS confirmed_absent,
  bool_or(m.status IN ('unresolved','conflicting')) AS disputed,
  bool_or(m.scope='package_context') AS package_context,
  bool_or(m.scope='event' AND m.video_key IS NOT NULL) AS has_video_record,
  bool_or(m.scope='event' AND (v.has_caption OR coalesce(array_length(r.tracks),0)>0)) AS has_captions
 FROM recording_links m
 LEFT JOIN videos_export v ON m.video_key=v.video_key
 LEFT JOIN recordings_export r ON m.video_key=r.video_key
 GROUP BY m.event_id,m.ref
), recording_levels AS (
 SELECT event_id,count(CASE WHEN full_recording THEN ref END) AS full_n,
  count(CASE WHEN excerpt THEN ref END) AS excerpt_n,
  count(CASE WHEN claimed THEN ref END) AS claimed_n,
  bool_or(not_public) AS not_public,bool_or(confirmed_absent) AS confirmed_absent,
  bool_or(disputed) AS disputed,bool_or(package_context) AS package_context,
  bool_or(has_video_record) AS has_video_record,
  count(CASE WHEN has_captions THEN ref END) AS caption_n
 FROM recording_refs GROUP BY event_id
), recording_rows AS (
 SELECT e.event_id,'recording' AS aspect,
  CASE WHEN l.full_n>0 THEN 'present' WHEN l.excerpt_n>0 THEN 'partial' WHEN l.claimed_n>0 THEN 'claimed'
       WHEN l.disputed THEN 'unresolved' WHEN l.not_public THEN 'not_public'
       WHEN l.confirmed_absent THEN 'confirmed_absent' WHEN l.package_context THEN 'unresolved' ELSE 'unknown' END AS state,
  CASE WHEN l.full_n>0 OR l.excerpt_n>0 OR l.claimed_n>0 THEN 'recording_matches'
       WHEN l.disputed OR l.not_public OR l.confirmed_absent THEN 'recording_decisions'
       WHEN l.package_context THEN 'recording_matches' ELSE 'none' END AS basis,
  cast(coalesce(nullif(l.full_n,0),nullif(l.excerpt_n,0),nullif(l.claimed_n,0),0) AS INT) AS count,
  l.has_video_record,l.caption_n,
  CASE WHEN l.full_n>0 THEN NULL WHEN l.excerpt_n>0 THEN 'excerpts_only' WHEN l.claimed_n>0 THEN 'video_text_only'
       WHEN l.disputed THEN 'recording_decision_unresolved_or_conflicting'
       WHEN l.not_public OR l.confirmed_absent THEN NULL
       WHEN l.package_context THEN 'package_context_only' END AS reason
 FROM meetings_export e LEFT JOIN recording_levels l ON e.event_id=l.event_id
), mods_named AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT event_id FROM (SELECT unnest(named_meetings) AS event_id FROM package_mods_facts) WHERE event_id IS NOT NULL
), transcript_sources AS (
 SELECT event_id,array_to_string(array_sort(array_agg(DISTINCT source)),',') AS sources
 FROM (SELECT event_id,unnest(transcripts)['source'] AS source FROM meetings_export) GROUP BY event_id
), transcript_rows AS (
 SELECT e.event_id,'transcript' AS aspect,
  CASE WHEN coalesce(array_length(e.transcripts),0)>0 THEN 'present'
       WHEN coalesce(array_length(r.transcript_jackets),0)>0 THEN 'unresolved'
       WHEN n.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'not_stated' END AS state,
  'meetings.transcripts' AS basis,cast(coalesce(array_length(e.transcripts),0) AS INT) AS count,
  -- Present names its sources (ct-1i4q): printed_hearing, committee_transcript and captions, sorted.
  CASE WHEN coalesce(array_length(e.transcripts),0)>0 THEN ts.sources
   WHEN coalesce(array_length(r.transcript_jackets),0)=0 AND n.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'package_names_meeting_unlinked' END AS reason
 FROM meetings_export e LEFT JOIN meetings_resolved r ON e.event_id=r.event_id LEFT JOIN mods_named n ON e.event_id=n.event_id
 LEFT JOIN transcript_sources ts ON e.event_id=ts.event_id
), document_counts AS (
 SELECT event_id,count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT try_cast(unnest(meeting_keys) AS BIGINT) AS event_id FROM ordered WHERE meeting_keys IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY event_id
), stated_documents AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT event_id FROM meeting_document_urls
), witness_counts AS (
 -- Each person once (superseded rows point at the row shown); statements are not witnesses.
 SELECT event_id,count(*) AS n FROM witnesses_export WHERE event_id IS NOT NULL AND name IS NOT NULL AND superseded_by IS NULL
  AND coalesce(witness_type,'') NOT IN ('statement_for_record','member_statement') GROUP BY event_id
), witness_states AS (
 SELECT event_id,max(CASE WHEN collection_state='unresolved' THEN 2 WHEN collection_state='empty' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rank
 FROM (
  SELECT event_id,CASE WHEN status<>'completed' OR collection_state IN ('failed','unrecognized') THEN 'unresolved'
    ELSE coalesce(nullif(trim(collection_state),''),CASE WHEN coalesce(array_length(appearances),0)>0 THEN 'present' ELSE 'empty' END) END AS collection_state
  FROM selected_appearance_records r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT event_id,'present' AS collection_state FROM witnesses_export WHERE event_id IS NOT NULL
 ) WHERE event_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_id
), document_rows AS (
 SELECT e.event_id,'documents' AS aspect,
  CASE WHEN d.n IS NOT NULL THEN 'present' WHEN s.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'unresolved'
       WHEN e.chamber='senate' AND ws.event_id IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'not_stated' END AS state,
  'list.meeting_keys' AS basis,cast(coalesce(d.n,0) AS INT) AS count,
  CASE WHEN d.n IS NOT NULL THEN NULL WHEN s.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'stated_documents_not_held'
       WHEN e.chamber='senate' AND ws.event_id IS NULL THEN 'senate_page_links_pending' END AS reason
 FROM meetings_export e LEFT JOIN document_counts d ON e.event_id=d.event_id LEFT JOIN stated_documents s ON e.event_id=s.event_id
  LEFT JOIN witness_states ws ON e.event_id=ws.event_id
), unattached_package_witnesses AS (
 -- A linked package holds witnesses that no raw record ties to this meeting alone (ct-dx22).
 SELECT DISTINCT l.event_id FROM meeting_transcript_links l
 JOIN witnesses_export w ON w.package_id=l.package_id AND w.event_id IS NULL AND w.name IS NOT NULL
  AND coalesce(w.witness_type,'') NOT IN ('statement_for_record','member_statement')
), witness_rows AS (
 SELECT e.event_id,'witnesses' AS aspect,
  CASE WHEN c.n IS NOT NULL THEN 'present' WHEN s.rank=2 THEN 'unresolved' WHEN s.rank=1 THEN 'empty'
       WHEN u.event_id IS NOT NULL OR (e.chamber='senate' AND s.event_id IS NULL) THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'not_stated' END AS state,
  'appearance_records' AS basis,cast(coalesce(c.n,0) AS INT) AS count,
  CASE WHEN c.n IS NOT NULL OR s.rank IN (1,2) THEN NULL WHEN u.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'package_witnesses_unattached'
       WHEN e.chamber='senate' AND s.event_id IS NULL THEN 'senate_page_links_pending' END AS reason
 FROM meetings_export e LEFT JOIN witness_counts c ON e.event_id=c.event_id LEFT JOIN witness_states s ON e.event_id=s.event_id
  LEFT JOIN unattached_package_witnesses u ON e.event_id=u.event_id
), recording_and_caption_rows AS (
 SELECT event_id,unnest(make_array(
  named_struct('aspect',aspect,'state',state,'basis',basis,'count',count,'reason',reason),
  named_struct('aspect','captions',
   'state',CASE WHEN caption_n>0 THEN 'present' WHEN has_video_record THEN 'unknown'
        WHEN state IN ('confirmed_absent','not_public') THEN 'not_stated' ELSE 'unknown' END,
   'basis','videos.has_caption,recordings.tracks','count',cast(coalesce(caption_n,0) AS INT),
   'reason',CASE WHEN caption_n>0 OR has_video_record OR state IN ('confirmed_absent','not_public') THEN NULL
        WHEN state IN ('present','partial','claimed') THEN 'recording_without_video_record'
        ELSE 'recording_link_pending' END)
 )) AS item FROM recording_rows
)
SELECT event_id,item['aspect'] AS aspect,item['state'] AS state,item['basis'] AS basis,item['count'] AS count,item['reason'] AS reason
FROM recording_and_caption_rows
UNION ALL SELECT event_id,aspect,state,basis,count,reason FROM transcript_rows
UNION ALL SELECT event_id,aspect,state,basis,count,reason FROM document_rows
UNION ALL SELECT event_id,aspect,state,basis,count,reason FROM witness_rows

specification.name: retired_links_export
specification.sql:
-- Data model §8.2, Retired keys. Release-sized inputs only (links, details, source_rows,
-- body_fingerprints, prior_links, prior_sources, base_retired); captures and readings are
-- never read here.
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT link_key,release_rank,release_id,list_row,primary_key,filename FROM (
    SELECT p.*,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY p.link_key ORDER BY p.release_rank) AS rn FROM prior_links p) ranked
  WHERE rn=1
), gone AS (
  SELECT g.* FROM latest g WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM links c WHERE c.link_key=g.link_key)
), row_of AS (
  SELECT c.link_key,d.link_key AS primary_key FROM links c JOIN details d ON d.list_row=c.list_row
), by_primary AS (
  SELECT g.link_key,r.primary_key AS successor_key FROM gone g JOIN row_of r ON r.link_key=g.primary_key
), sibling_rows AS (
  SELECT g.link_key,r.primary_key AS successor_key FROM gone g
  JOIN prior_links s ON s.release_rank=g.release_rank AND s.list_row=g.list_row
  JOIN row_of r ON r.link_key=s.link_key
), by_sibling AS (
  SELECT link_key,min(successor_key) AS successor_key FROM sibling_rows
  GROUP BY link_key HAVING min(successor_key)=max(successor_key)
), address_rows AS (
  -- Third rule: a candidate document at one of the prior row's exact addresses (url, member_path).
  SELECT g.link_key,d.link_key AS successor_key FROM gone g
  JOIN prior_sources ps ON ps.release_rank=g.release_rank AND ps.list_row=g.list_row
  JOIN source_rows sr ON sr.url=ps.url AND sr.member_path IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ps.member_path
  JOIN details d ON d.list_row=sr.list_row
), old_prints AS (
  -- An address holds editions (§7.5: an edition never joins another), so the address rule
  -- redirects only to a document holding the same text fingerprint as the retired body.
  SELECT g.link_key,f.fingerprint FROM gone g
  JOIN body_fingerprints f ON substr(f.body_sha,1,16)=lower(encode(g.link_key,'hex'))
), document_prints AS (
  SELECT r.primary_key,f.fingerprint FROM row_of r
  JOIN body_fingerprints f ON substr(f.body_sha,1,16)=lower(encode(r.link_key,'hex'))
), by_address AS (
  SELECT a.link_key,min(a.successor_key) AS successor_key FROM address_rows a
  JOIN old_prints o ON o.link_key=a.link_key
  JOIN document_prints d ON d.primary_key=a.successor_key AND d.fingerprint=o.fingerprint
  GROUP BY a.link_key HAVING min(a.successor_key)=max(a.successor_key)
), address_versions AS (
  SELECT link_key,array_sort(array_agg(DISTINCT successor_key)) AS versions FROM address_rows GROUP BY link_key
), fresh AS (
  SELECT g.link_key,coalesce(p.successor_key,s.successor_key,a.successor_key) AS successor_key,
    g.release_id AS last_release_id,g.filename AS last_filename,
    CASE WHEN coalesce(p.successor_key,s.successor_key,a.successor_key) IS NULL THEN v.versions END AS address_versions
  FROM gone g LEFT JOIN by_primary p ON p.link_key=g.link_key LEFT JOIN by_sibling s ON s.link_key=g.link_key
  LEFT JOIN by_address a ON a.link_key=g.link_key LEFT JOIN address_versions v ON v.link_key=g.link_key
), carried AS (
  -- One hop: a successor still published resolves to its row's primary key; a successor
  -- retired in this release takes that row's successor; otherwise a removal notice.
  SELECT b.link_key,coalesce(r.primary_key,f.successor_key) AS successor_key,b.last_release_id,b.last_filename,
    CASE WHEN coalesce(r.primary_key,f.successor_key) IS NULL THEN b.address_versions END AS address_versions
  FROM base_retired b
  LEFT JOIN row_of r ON r.link_key=b.successor_key
  LEFT JOIN fresh f ON f.link_key=b.successor_key
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM links c WHERE c.link_key=b.link_key)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fresh x WHERE x.link_key=b.link_key)
)
SELECT link_key,successor_key,last_release_id,last_filename,address_versions FROM fresh
UNION ALL
SELECT link_key,successor_key,last_release_id,last_filename,address_versions FROM carried

queries.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'format' AS facet,cast(format AS VARCHAR) AS value,count(*) AS count FROM ordered WHERE NOT hidden GROUP BY format UNION ALL SELECT 'congress' AS facet,cast(congress AS VARCHAR) AS value,count(*) AS count FROM ordered WHERE NOT hidden GROUP BY congress UNION ALL SELECT 'saved_kind' AS facet,cast(saved_kind AS VARCHAR) AS value,count(*) AS count FROM ordered WHERE NOT hidden GROUP BY saved_kind UNION ALL SELECT 'document_kind' AS facet,value,count(*) AS count FROM (SELECT unnest(document_kind) AS value FROM ordered WHERE NOT hidden) GROUP BY value UNION ALL SELECT 'document_family' AS facet,value,count(*) AS count FROM (SELECT unnest(document_family) AS value FROM ordered WHERE NOT hidden) GROUP BY value UNION ALL SELECT 'committee_keys' AS facet,value,count(*) AS count FROM (SELECT unnest(committee_keys) AS value FROM ordered WHERE NOT hidden) GROUP BY value UNION ALL SELECT 'chambers' AS facet,value,count(*) AS count FROM (SELECT unnest(chambers) AS value FROM ordered WHERE NOT hidden) GROUP BY value UNION ALL SELECT 'meeting_keys' AS facet,value,count(*) AS count FROM (SELECT unnest(meeting_keys) AS value FROM ordered WHERE NOT hidden) GROUP BY value) WHERE value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY facet,value
queries.selection_role: metadata_or_report; specific publisher obligations remain application-owned

queries.sql:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT doc_key FROM ordered GROUP BY doc_key HAVING count(*)>1)) AS duplicate_documents,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM ordered WHERE body_expected AND (body_hex IS NULL OR length(body_hex)<>64)) AS missing_saved_bodies,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM ordered WHERE body_hex IS NOT NULL AND (bytes IS NULL OR bytes<0)) AS missing_saved_sizes,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT link_key FROM all_links GROUP BY link_key HAVING min(origin)<>max(origin))) AS link_collisions,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT lookup_key FROM lookup_keys_full GROUP BY lookup_key HAVING min(lookup_url)<>max(lookup_url))) AS lookup_collisions
queries.selection_role: required_model_invariant

queries.sql:
SELECT (SELECT n FROM non_document_good_fetches) AS non_document_good_fetches,(SELECT n FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM body_admissions a
        JOIN sniff_facts s ON a.body_sha=s.body_sha WHERE a.format IS DISTINCT FROM s.format) writer_conflicts) AS conflicting_writer_formats,(SELECT count(*) FROM sniff_conflicts) AS conflicting_sniffs,(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT sha256 FROM captures WHERE sha256 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sha256 HAVING count(DISTINCT bytes)>1)) AS conflicting_original_sizes,(SELECT count(*) FROM verification_conflicts) AS conflicting_verifications,(SELECT count(*) FROM recovery_diagnostics WHERE is_fatal) AS invalid_recoveries,(SELECT count(*) FROM (
            SELECT category AS selector FROM recovery_kinds WHERE category IS NOT NULL AND match_basis IS NULL
            GROUP BY category HAVING count(*)>1 UNION ALL
            SELECT match_basis AS selector FROM recovery_kinds WHERE match_basis IS NOT NULL AND category IS NULL
            GROUP BY match_basis HAVING count(*)>1) duplicate_selectors) AS duplicate_recovery_kind_selectors,(SELECT count(*) FROM recovery_kinds
            WHERE (category IS NULL)=(match_basis IS NULL)
            OR (category IS NOT NULL AND trim(category)='')
            OR (match_basis IS NOT NULL AND trim(match_basis)='')
            OR kind IS NULL OR trim(kind)='') AS invalid_recovery_kind_selectors,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM model_url_keys WHERE error IS NOT NULL) AS invalid_url_keys,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM recovery_attachment_diagnostics) AS invalid_recovery_attachments,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM body_review_key_conflicts) AS body_key_collisions,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM document_link_key_conflicts) AS review_key_collisions,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM review_value_diagnostics) AS invalid_review_values,
            (SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM ordered) AS empty_document_list,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT o.doc_key,o.title FROM ordered o
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT pattern FROM page_signals WHERE kind='link_word') g
  ON length(o.title)<=64 AND regexp_like(regexp_replace(trim(o.title),'\s+',' ','g'),g.pattern)
 WHERE g.pattern IS NOT NULL OR (o.title IS NOT NULL AND regexp_like(o.title,'[A-Za-z]') AND regexp_replace(lower(o.title),
 '(download|view|click|here|link|pdf|zip|xml|html?|docx?|txt|json|csv|xlsx?|pptx?|kb|mb|gb|bytes?)|[^a-z]','','g')='')) generic) AS generic_titles,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM (WITH blank AS (
 SELECT doc_key,body_hex,source_url FROM ordered WHERE filename=''
), seen AS (
 SELECT b.doc_key,bool_or(coalesce(c.filename,'')<>'') AS named,
  min(coalesce(c.context_url,c.url)) AS address,
  bool_and(strpos(coalesce(c.context_url,c.url,''),'?')>0) AS all_queries
 FROM blank b JOIN capture_sources c ON c.body_sha=b.body_hex GROUP BY b.doc_key
)
SELECT b.doc_key,CASE WHEN coalesce(s.named,false) THEN NULL
 WHEN coalesce(s.address,b.source_url) IS NULL OR trim(coalesce(s.address,b.source_url))='' THEN 'no_address'
 WHEN coalesce(s.all_queries,strpos(b.source_url,'?')>0) THEN 'query_names_no_file'
 WHEN regexp_like(coalesce(s.address,b.source_url),'^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*://[^/?#]*/*(#.*)?$') THEN 'host_only' END AS reason
FROM blank b LEFT JOIN seen s ON s.doc_key=b.doc_key) r WHERE r.reason IS NULL) AS unexplained_blank_filenames,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM (WITH merged AS (
 SELECT m.source_id,dm.source_url,nullif(dm.filename,'') AS filename,a.title,a.congress,a.filename_date,a.package_id,
  a.document_kind,a.document_family,a.committee_keys,a.chambers,a.meeting_keys,a.measure_keys,a.bioguide_ids,a.facts,
  o.list_row,o.filename AS o_filename,o.title AS o_title,o.congress AS o_congress,o.document_date AS o_date,o.package_id AS o_package,
  o.document_kind AS o_kind,o.document_family AS o_family,o.committee_keys AS o_committees,o.chambers AS o_chambers,
  o.meeting_keys AS o_meetings,o.measure_keys AS o_measures,o.bioguide_ids AS o_bioguides,o.facts AS o_facts,
  nullif(s.filename,'') AS c_filename,coalesce(sa.reading_title,sa.listing_title) AS c_title,sa.congress AS c_congress,
  coalesce(sa.filename_date,sa.content_date) AS c_date,sa.package_id AS c_package,sa.document_kind AS c_kind,
  sa.document_family AS c_family,sa.facts AS c_facts
 FROM recovered_copy_members m JOIN document_members dm ON dm.source_id=m.source_id
 JOIN source_annotations a ON a.source_id=m.source_id
 JOIN document_identities d ON d.component=dm.component JOIN ordered o ON o.doc_key=d.document_id
 JOIN saved_files s ON s.component=dm.component AND s.saved_rank=1 JOIN source_annotations sa ON sa.source_id=s.source_id
), addressed AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT g.source_id FROM merged g JOIN source_rows r ON r.list_row=g.list_row AND r.url=g.source_url
), keyed AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT g.source_id FROM merged g JOIN links k ON k.list_row=g.list_row
  AND encode(k.link_key,'hex')=substr(encode(sha256('url:'||g.source_url),'hex'),1,16)
), looked_up AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT g.source_id FROM merged g JOIN lookup_sources u ON u.list_row=g.list_row AND u.url=g.source_url
), recovered AS (
 SELECT source_id,count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT moved) AS unmoved FROM (
  SELECT g.source_id,c.original_url,c.body_sha,bool_or(r.list_row IS NOT NULL) AS moved
  FROM merged g JOIN current_recoveries c ON c.original_url=g.source_url
  LEFT JOIN recovery_rows r ON r.list_row=g.list_row AND r.original_url=c.original_url AND encode(r.body,'hex')=c.body_sha
  GROUP BY g.source_id,c.original_url,c.body_sha) GROUP BY source_id
)
SELECT g.*,a.source_id IS NULL AS lost_address,k.source_id IS NULL AS lost_link,u.source_id IS NULL AS lost_lookup,
 coalesce(r.unmoved,1)>0 AS lost_recovery,
 g.filename IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(g.o_filename,'')='' AS lost_filename,
 g.title IS NOT NULL AND g.o_title IS NULL AS lost_title,
 g.congress IS NOT NULL AND g.o_congress IS NULL AS lost_congress,
 g.filename_date IS NOT NULL AND g.o_date IS NULL AS lost_date,
 g.package_id IS NOT NULL AND g.o_package IS NULL AS lost_package,
 coalesce(array_length(g.document_kind),0)>0 AND coalesce(array_length(g.o_kind),0)=0 AS lost_kind,
 coalesce(array_length(g.document_family),0)>0 AND coalesce(array_length(g.o_family),0)=0 AS lost_family,
 coalesce(array_length(g.facts),0)>0 AND coalesce(array_length(g.o_facts),0)=0 AS lost_facts,
 coalesce(array_length(g.committee_keys),0)>0 AND NOT coalesce(array_has_all(g.o_committees,g.committee_keys),false) AS lost_committees,
 coalesce(array_length(g.chambers),0)>0 AND NOT coalesce(array_has_all(g.o_chambers,g.chambers),false) AS lost_chambers,
 coalesce(array_length(g.meeting_keys),0)>0 AND NOT coalesce(array_has_all(g.o_meetings,g.meeting_keys),false) AS lost_meetings,
 coalesce(array_length(g.measure_keys),0)>0 AND NOT coalesce(array_has_all(g.o_measures,g.measure_keys),false) AS lost_measures,
 coalesce(array_length(g.bioguide_ids),0)>0 AND NOT coalesce(array_has_all(g.o_bioguides,g.bioguide_ids),false) AS lost_bioguides
FROM recovered r RIGHT JOIN (looked_up u RIGHT JOIN (keyed k RIGHT JOIN (addressed a RIGHT JOIN merged g
 ON a.source_id=g.source_id) ON k.source_id=g.source_id) ON u.source_id=g.source_id) ON r.source_id=g.source_id) g WHERE lost_address OR lost_link OR lost_lookup OR lost_recovery OR lost_filename OR lost_title OR lost_congress OR lost_date OR lost_package OR lost_kind OR lost_family OR lost_facts OR lost_committees OR lost_chambers OR lost_meetings OR lost_measures OR lost_bioguides) AS unaccounted_merged_signal,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM saved_files s JOIN saved_files n ON n.component=s.component AND n.body_sha=s.body_sha
                AND coalesce(n.filename,'')<>'' WHERE s.saved_rank=1 AND coalesce(s.filename,'')='') AS saved_unnamed_with_named_sibling,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT unnest(alternates) AS alt FROM document_alternates) WHERE alt['size'] IS NULL) AS missing_alternate_sizes,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM (
                SELECT cast(m['event_id'] AS BIGINT) AS event_id
                FROM (
                    SELECT unnest(r.meetings) AS m
                    FROM selected_meeting_records r
                    WHERE r.status='completed' AND r.meetings IS NOT NULL
                )
                WHERE m['event_id'] IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim(m['chamber']),'') IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY cast(m['event_id'] AS BIGINT)
                HAVING count(DISTINCT CASE
                    WHEN lower(trim(m['chamber'])) IN ('house','h','house of representatives') THEN 'house'
                    WHEN lower(trim(m['chamber'])) IN ('senate','s') THEN 'senate'
                    WHEN lower(trim(m['chamber'])) IN ('joint','j') THEN 'joint'
                    ELSE lower(trim(m['chamber']))
                END)>1
            )) AS multi_chamber_events,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT try_cast(unnest(meeting_keys) AS BIGINT) AS event_id FROM ordered WHERE meeting_keys IS NOT NULL
            ) k WHERE k.event_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM meetings_export m WHERE m.event_id=k.event_id)) AS missing_meeting_keys,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM (
                SELECT unnest(transcripts) AS tr FROM meetings_export WHERE transcripts IS NOT NULL
            ) WHERE CASE WHEN tr['source']='captions'
                -- A caption track is a recording's file, named by video_key, never a listed document.
                THEN tr['video_key'] IS NULL OR tr['list_row'] IS NOT NULL
                ELSE tr['list_row'] IS NULL OR tr['list_row']<0 OR tr['list_row']>=(SELECT count(*) FROM ordered) END) AS invalid_transcript_rows,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM url_keys WHERE list_row IS NULL OR list_row<0 OR list_row>=(SELECT count(*) FROM ordered)) AS invalid_url_rows,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM (
                SELECT vk,min(doc_key) AS doc_key
                FROM (SELECT doc_key,unnest(version_keys) AS vk FROM ordered WHERE version_keys IS NOT NULL)
                GROUP BY vk HAVING count(*)<2
            ) single_vk
            LEFT ANTI JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT o.doc_key
                FROM (SELECT doc_key,unnest(link_bodies) AS bh FROM ordered WHERE link_bodies IS NOT NULL) o
                JOIN (
                    SELECT target AS prefix FROM current_reviews WHERE verdict='duplicate_of' AND target IS NOT NULL
                    UNION SELECT value_text AS prefix FROM current_reviews WHERE verdict='duplicate_of' AND value_text IS NOT NULL
                    UNION SELECT substr(left_node,3,16) AS prefix FROM body_review_edges WHERE left_node IS NOT NULL
                    UNION SELECT substr(right_node,3,16) AS prefix FROM body_review_edges WHERE right_node IS NOT NULL
                ) rev ON substr(o.bh,1,16)=rev.prefix
            ) merged_docs ON single_vk.doc_key=merged_docs.doc_key) AS single_doc_version_keys,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT unnest(witness_keys) AS witness_key FROM ordered WHERE witness_keys IS NOT NULL
            ) k WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM witnesses_export w WHERE w.witness_key=k.witness_key)) AS missing_witness_keys,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM (

                UNION

            ) k WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM committees_export c WHERE c.system_code=k.system_code)) AS missing_committee_keys,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM (

            ) k WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM members_export m WHERE m.bioguide_id=k.bioguide_id)) AS missing_member_keys,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM (

            (SELECT count(*) FROM recording_track_candidates

            (SELECT count(*) FROM
            (SELECT unnest(tracks) AS t FROM recording_tracks) r
            WHERE r.t['body'] IN (SELECT sha256 FROM recording_segment_bodies)) AS segment_tracks,
            (SELECT count(DISTINCT f.sha256) FROM recording_fetch_candidates f
            WHERE f.playlist_candidate
            AND lower(encode(f.sha256,'hex')) NOT IN (SELECT lower(encode(record_sha,'hex')) AS sha FROM selected_playlist_records WHERE status IN ('completed','error','size_limit')

            (SELECT count(*) FROM (
            SELECT video_key,t['body'] FROM (SELECT video_key,unnest(tracks) AS t FROM recording_tracks)
            GROUP BY video_key,t['body'] HAVING count(*)>1)) AS duplicate_track_bodies

-- Lake PKs and the actual producer work lists, never old derived decisions.
WITH expected_parsers AS (
 SELECT unnest(make_array('sniff','html','xml','json')) AS parser
), valid_admissions AS (
 SELECT body_sha FROM body_admissions
 WHERE format IN ('empty','vtt','m3u8') AND basis IS NOT NULL AND basis<>''
), sniff_readings AS (
 SELECT r.body_sha FROM selected_readings r
 WHERE r.parser='sniff' AND r.status IN ('completed','error','size_limit')
), unreadable_sniff AS (
 SELECT body_sha256 FROM active_unreadable u JOIN accepted_versions v ON u.parser=v.parser AND u.parser_version=v.version
 WHERE u.parser IN ('sniff','readings')
), missing_sniff AS (
 SELECT b.body_sha FROM profile_bodies b
 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sniff_facts f WHERE f.body_sha=b.body_sha)
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM valid_admissions a WHERE a.body_sha=b.body_sha)
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sniff_readings r WHERE r.body_sha=b.body_sha)
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unreadable_sniff u WHERE u.body_sha256=encode(b.body_sha,'hex'))
), page_readings AS (
 SELECT r.body_sha,r.parser FROM selected_readings r
 WHERE r.parser IN ('html','xml','json') AND r.status IN ('completed','error','size_limit')
), unreadable_pages AS (
 -- A bundle decision settles every page parser for its body.
 SELECT u.body_sha256,CASE WHEN u.parser='readings' THEN p.parser ELSE u.parser END AS parser
 FROM active_unreadable u JOIN accepted_versions v ON u.parser=v.parser AND u.parser_version=v.version
 CROSS JOIN (SELECT unnest(make_array('html','xml','json')) AS parser) p
 WHERE u.parser IN ('html','xml','json','readings') AND (u.parser='readings' OR u.parser=p.parser)
), missing_pages AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT b.body_sha,s.format FROM profile_bodies b JOIN sniff_facts s ON b.body_sha=s.body_sha
 WHERE s.format IN ('html','xml','json')
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM page_readings r WHERE r.body_sha=b.body_sha AND r.parser=s.format)
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unreadable_pages u WHERE u.body_sha256=encode(b.body_sha,'hex')
   AND u.parser=s.format)
), valid_filename_readings AS (
 SELECT filename,source_url FROM filename_readings
 WHERE catalog_version='c65e505ef8eb085e38072297aad395ca532fdc76a348a72b86f88c7734a83b09' AND status IN ('completed','error','size_limit')
), unreadable_filenames AS (
 SELECT record_sha FROM active_unreadable
 WHERE parser='filename' AND parser_version='c65e505ef8eb085e38072297aad395ca532fdc76a348a72b86f88c7734a83b09'
), missing_filenames AS (
 SELECT p.* FROM profile_filename_pairs p
 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM valid_filename_readings f
   WHERE f.filename=p.filename AND f.source_url=p.source_url)
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unreadable_filenames u
   WHERE u.record_sha=encode(sha256(json_array(p.filename,p.source_url)),'hex'))
)
-- The three whole-table key counts are completeness steps, run one at a time: aggregated
-- together in this query they compete for the pool and a spill can fail to reserve its sort.
SELECT
 (SELECT cnt FROM profile_capture_duplicates) AS duplicate_captures,
 (SELECT cnt FROM profile_reading_duplicates) AS duplicate_readings,
 (SELECT cnt FROM profile_filename_duplicates) AS duplicate_filename_readings,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT parser FROM parser_versions GROUP BY parser HAVING count(*)>1)) AS duplicate_parser_versions,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM captures WHERE receipt_key IS NULL OR receipt_line IS NULL OR capture_index IS NULL) AS invalid_capture_keys,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM readings WHERE body_sha IS NULL OR parser IS NULL OR parser_version IS NULL
   OR status IS NULL OR (status NOT IN ('completed','error','size_limit')
     AND NOT (parser='html_metadata' AND status='partial'))) AS invalid_readings,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM filename_readings WHERE filename IS NULL OR source_url IS NULL OR catalog_version IS NULL
   OR status IS NULL OR status NOT IN ('completed','error','size_limit')) AS invalid_filename_readings,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM parser_versions WHERE parser IS NULL OR version IS NULL OR version='') AS invalid_parser_versions,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM expected_parsers p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM parser_versions v WHERE p.parser=v.parser)) AS missing_parser_versions,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM body_admissions WHERE body_sha IS NULL OR format IS NULL OR format NOT IN ('empty','vtt','m3u8')
   OR basis IS NULL OR basis='') AS invalid_body_admissions,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM missing_sniff) AS missing_sniff,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM missing_pages) AS missing_pages,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM missing_filenames) AS missing_filenames
queries.selection_role: required_model_invariant

WITH selected_mr_versions AS (
            SELECT o.source,
            CASE
                WHEN pv_scoped.parser IS NULL AND pv_table.parser IS NULL THEN o.version
                WHEN coalesce(pv_scoped.version,pv_table.version)=o.version THEN o.version
                ELSE NULL
            END AS version
            FROM (SELECT column1 AS source,column2 AS version FROM (VALUES ('congress_gov','325702c1794f246323ed30d7430650355121dd4891a7cea62b44a34a8ae5084d'),('house_xml','684f3663274217a2c24a19a5a71887aa0f5f9f8c61dc5a590959e48ab84dd24b'))) o
            LEFT JOIN parser_versions pv_scoped ON pv_scoped.parser='meeting_records.'||o.source
            LEFT JOIN parser_versions pv_table ON pv_table.parser='meeting_records'
        ), selected_ar_versions AS (
            SELECT o.source,
            CASE
                WHEN pv_scoped.parser IS NULL AND pv_table.parser IS NULL THEN o.version
                WHEN coalesce(pv_scoped.version,pv_table.version)=o.version THEN o.version
                ELSE NULL
            END AS version
            FROM (SELECT column1 AS source,column2 AS version FROM (VALUES ('congress_gov','6d9460f5ec203c24c508846092505a875710f565e1ff026479b542c7555e7d48'),('house_xml','7ecb6f0a62538695c0b5b2b93654cc148e0fb11fcb72c7e189cc8ce328a86abd'),('mods','1775aa40163a47b0c6d07fd5b7d950f8a0580c11ac8d76e4c20c2696107cbcb8'),('senate_page','a8b682c51963a8951253ffcfa39833577ce163f8807f9c3b526c32f7c05cdba2'))) o
            LEFT JOIN parser_versions pv_scoped ON pv_scoped.parser='appearance_records.'||o.source
            LEFT JOIN parser_versions pv_table ON pv_table.parser='appearance_records'
        ), mr_dup AS (
            SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM (
                SELECT record_sha_hex,source,parser_version FROM meeting_records_input
                GROUP BY record_sha_hex,source,parser_version HAVING count(*)>1
            )
        ), ar_dup AS (
            SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM (
                SELECT record_sha_hex,source,parser_version FROM appearance_records_input
                GROUP BY record_sha_hex,source,parser_version HAVING count(*)>1
            )
        ), mr_invalid AS (
            SELECT (
                SELECT count(*) FROM meeting_records_input
                WHERE record_sha_hex IS NULL OR trim(record_sha_hex)=''
                   OR parser_version IS NULL OR trim(parser_version)=''
                   OR status IS NULL OR status NOT IN ('completed','error','size_limit')
                   OR source IS NULL OR source NOT IN ('congress_gov','house_xml')
            ) + (
                SELECT count(*) FROM selected_mr_versions WHERE version IS NULL OR trim(version)=''
            ) AS cnt
        ), ar_invalid AS (
            SELECT (
                SELECT count(*) FROM appearance_records_input
                WHERE record_sha_hex IS NULL OR trim(record_sha_hex)=''
                   OR parser_version IS NULL OR trim(parser_version)=''
                   OR status IS NULL OR status NOT IN ('completed','error','size_limit')
                   OR source IS NULL OR source NOT IN ('house_xml','congress_gov','senate_page','mods')
            ) + (
                SELECT count(*) FROM selected_ar_versions WHERE version IS NULL OR trim(version)=''
            ) AS cnt
        ), current_page_readings AS (
            SELECT r.body_sha, r.parser, r.status, r.xml_root FROM selected_readings r WHERE r.status IN ('completed', 'error', 'size_limit')
        ), expected_mr AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT lower(encode(c.sha256, 'hex')) AS record_sha_hex, 'congress_gov' AS source FROM captures c WHERE c.mode = 'fetch' AND c.complete AND c.outcome IN ('stored', 'unchanged') AND c.http_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299 AND c.sha256 IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(c.sniffed_format, '') NOT IN ('html', 'pdf', 'zip', 'vtt', 'm3u8') AND lower(coalesce(c.media_type, '')) NOT LIKE '%html%' AND lower(coalesce(c.url, c.requested_url, '')) NOT LIKE '%.html%' AND (c.family = 'congress/meetings' OR lower(coalesce(c.url, c.requested_url, '')) LIKE '%api.congress.gov%/committee-meeting%' OR lower(coalesce(c.url, c.requested_url, '')) LIKE '%congress.gov/committee-meeting%')
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT lower(encode(c.sha256, 'hex')) AS record_sha_hex, 'house_xml' AS source FROM captures c LEFT JOIN current_page_readings r ON c.sha256 = r.body_sha AND r.parser = 'xml' WHERE c.mode = 'fetch' AND c.complete AND c.outcome IN ('stored', 'unchanged') AND c.http_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299 AND c.sha256 IS NOT NULL AND (c.family IN ('house/meeting-xml', 'house/witness-xml', 'house/Committees') OR (lower(coalesce(c.url, c.requested_url, c.context_url, '')) LIKE '%docs.house.gov%' AND (lower(coalesce(c.url, c.requested_url, c.context_url, '')) LIKE '%.xml%' OR c.sniffed_format = 'xml'))) AND ((r.status = 'completed' AND r.xml_root = 'committee-meeting') OR (coalesce(r.status, '') <> 'completed' AND coalesce(c.family, '') <> 'house/witness-xml' AND lower(coalesce(c.url, c.requested_url, c.context_url, '')) NOT LIKE '%wlist%'))
        ), expected_ar AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT lower(encode(c.sha256, 'hex')) AS record_sha_hex, 'congress_gov' AS source FROM captures c WHERE c.mode = 'fetch' AND c.complete AND c.outcome IN ('stored', 'unchanged') AND c.http_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299 AND c.sha256 IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(c.sniffed_format, '') NOT IN ('html', 'pdf', 'zip', 'vtt', 'm3u8') AND lower(coalesce(c.media_type, '')) NOT LIKE '%html%' AND lower(coalesce(c.url, c.requested_url, '')) NOT LIKE '%.html%' AND (c.family = 'congress/meetings' OR lower(coalesce(c.url, c.requested_url, '')) LIKE '%api.congress.gov%/committee-meeting%' OR lower(coalesce(c.url, c.requested_url, '')) LIKE '%congress.gov/committee-meeting%')
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT lower(encode(c.sha256, 'hex')) AS record_sha_hex, 'house_xml' AS source FROM captures c LEFT JOIN current_page_readings r ON c.sha256 = r.body_sha AND r.parser = 'xml' WHERE c.mode = 'fetch' AND c.complete AND c.outcome IN ('stored', 'unchanged') AND c.http_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299 AND c.sha256 IS NOT NULL AND (c.family IN ('house/meeting-xml', 'house/witness-xml', 'house/Committees') OR (lower(coalesce(c.url, c.requested_url, c.context_url, '')) LIKE '%docs.house.gov%' AND (lower(coalesce(c.url, c.requested_url, c.context_url, '')) LIKE '%.xml%' OR c.sniffed_format = 'xml'))) AND ((r.status = 'completed' AND r.xml_root = 'witness-list') OR (coalesce(r.status, '') <> 'completed' AND (c.family = 'house/witness-xml' OR lower(coalesce(c.url, c.requested_url, c.context_url, '')) LIKE '%wlist%')))
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT lower(encode(c.sha256, 'hex')) AS record_sha_hex, 'mods' AS source FROM captures c LEFT JOIN current_page_readings r ON c.sha256 = r.body_sha AND r.parser = 'xml' WHERE c.mode = 'fetch' AND c.complete AND c.outcome IN ('stored', 'unchanged') AND c.http_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299 AND c.sha256 IS NOT NULL AND (upper(coalesce(c.url, '')) LIKE '%CHRG%' OR upper(coalesce(c.requested_url, '')) LIKE '%CHRG%' OR upper(coalesce(c.context_url, '')) LIKE '%CHRG%' OR upper(coalesce(c.member_path, '')) LIKE '%CHRG%') AND (c.family = 'govinfo/mods' OR ((lower(coalesce(c.url, '')) LIKE '%mods%' OR lower(coalesce(c.requested_url, '')) LIKE '%mods%' OR lower(coalesce(c.context_url, '')) LIKE '%mods%' OR lower(coalesce(c.member_path, '')) LIKE '%mods%') AND (coalesce(c.sniffed_format, '') = 'xml' OR lower(coalesce(c.media_type, '')) LIKE '%xml%' OR lower(coalesce(c.url, c.requested_url, '')) LIKE '%.xml%' OR lower(coalesce(c.context_url, '')) LIKE '%/mods%' OR lower(coalesce(c.member_path, '')) LIKE '%.xml%'))) AND (coalesce(r.status, '') <> 'completed' OR r.xml_root IS NULL OR r.xml_root = 'mods')
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT lower(encode(c.sha256, 'hex')) AS record_sha_hex, 'senate_page' AS source FROM captures c WHERE c.mode = 'fetch' AND c.complete AND c.outcome IN ('stored', 'unchanged') AND c.http_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299 AND c.sha256 IS NOT NULL AND c.member_path IS NULL AND coalesce(c.family, '') <> 'documents' AND coalesce(c.sniffed_format, '') NOT IN ('pdf', 'xml', 'json', 'zip', 'vtt', 'm3u8') AND lower(coalesce(c.media_type, '')) NOT LIKE '%pdf%' AND lower(coalesce(c.url, c.requested_url, '')) NOT LIKE '%.pdf%' AND (c.family IN ('senate/hearings', 'senate/pages', 'senate/hearing-page') OR (lower(coalesce(c.url, c.requested_url, '')) LIKE '%.senate.gov%' AND coalesce(c.sniffed_format, '') = 'html' AND (lower(coalesce(c.url, c.requested_url, '')) LIKE '%hearing%' OR lower(coalesce(c.url, c.requested_url, '')) LIKE '%meeting%' OR lower(coalesce(c.url, c.requested_url, '')) LIKE '%business%')))
        ), inline_cg_expected AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN source_url<>'' THEN source_url
                ELSE receipt_key||':'||cast(receipt_line AS VARCHAR)
            END AS inline_key
            FROM (SELECT DISTINCT receipt_key, receipt_line,
    coalesce(url, requested_url, context_url, '') AS source_url
    FROM captures
    WHERE sha256 IS NULL AND outcome = 'saved-record'
      AND receipt_key IS NOT NULL AND receipt_line IS NOT NULL
      AND (family = 'congress/meetings'
           OR coalesce(url, requested_url, '') ILIKE '%api.congress.gov%/committee-meeting%'
           OR coalesce(url, requested_url, '') ILIKE '%congress.gov/committee-meeting%')
    ORDER BY receipt_key, receipt_line)
        ), mr_settled AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT m.record_sha_hex,m.source
            FROM meeting_records_input m
            JOIN selected_mr_versions v ON m.source=v.source AND m.parser_version=v.version
            WHERE m.status IN ('completed','error','size_limit')
        ), mr_unreadable AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT lower(coalesce(u.record_sha,u.body_sha256)) AS record_sha_hex,v.source
            FROM active_unreadable u
            JOIN selected_mr_versions v ON u.parser_version=v.version
            WHERE u.parser IN ('meeting_records','meetings','meeting_records.'||v.source)
              AND coalesce(u.record_sha,u.body_sha256) IS NOT NULL
        ), mr_inline_unsettled AS (
            SELECT greatest(
                (SELECT count(*) FROM inline_cg_expected) - (
                    SELECT count(DISTINCT record_sha_hex) FROM (
                        SELECT record_sha_hex FROM mr_settled WHERE source='congress_gov'
                        UNION
                        SELECT record_sha_hex FROM mr_unreadable WHERE source='congress_gov'
                    ) s WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM expected_mr e WHERE e.source='congress_gov' AND e.record_sha_hex=s.record_sha_hex
                    )
                ),
                0
            ) AS cnt
        ), mr_unsettled AS (
            SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (
                SELECT e.record_sha_hex,e.source
                FROM expected_mr e
                WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM mr_settled s WHERE s.record_sha_hex=e.record_sha_hex AND s.source=e.source
                ) AND NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM mr_unreadable u WHERE u.record_sha_hex=e.record_sha_hex AND u.source=e.source
                )
                UNION
                SELECT m.record_sha_hex,m.source
                FROM meeting_records_input m
                JOIN selected_mr_versions v ON m.source=v.source AND m.parser_version=v.version
                WHERE m.status NOT IN ('completed','error','size_limit')
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM mr_unreadable u WHERE u.record_sha_hex=m.record_sha_hex AND u.source=m.source
                  )
            )) + (SELECT cnt FROM mr_inline_unsettled) AS cnt
        ), ar_settled AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT a.record_sha_hex,a.source
            FROM appearance_records_input a
            JOIN selected_ar_versions v ON a.source=v.source AND a.parser_version=v.version
            WHERE a.status IN ('completed','error','size_limit')
        ), ar_unreadable AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT lower(coalesce(u.record_sha,u.body_sha256)) AS record_sha_hex,v.source
            FROM active_unreadable u
            JOIN selected_ar_versions v ON u.parser_version=v.version
            WHERE u.parser IN ('appearance_records','appearances','appearance_records.'||v.source)
              AND coalesce(u.record_sha,u.body_sha256) IS NOT NULL
        ), ar_inline_unsettled AS (
            SELECT greatest(
                (SELECT count(*) FROM inline_cg_expected) - (
                    SELECT count(DISTINCT record_sha_hex) FROM (
                        SELECT record_sha_hex FROM ar_settled WHERE source='congress_gov'
                        UNION
                        SELECT record_sha_hex FROM ar_unreadable WHERE source='congress_gov'
                    ) s WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM expected_ar e WHERE e.source='congress_gov' AND e.record_sha_hex=s.record_sha_hex
                    )
                ),
                0
            ) AS cnt
        ), ar_unsettled AS (
            SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (
                SELECT e.record_sha_hex,e.source
                FROM expected_ar e
                WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM ar_settled s WHERE s.record_sha_hex=e.record_sha_hex AND s.source=e.source
                ) AND NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM ar_unreadable u WHERE u.record_sha_hex=e.record_sha_hex AND u.source=e.source
                )
                UNION
                SELECT a.record_sha_hex,a.source
                FROM appearance_records_input a
                JOIN selected_ar_versions v ON a.source=v.source AND a.parser_version=v.version
                WHERE a.status NOT IN ('completed','error','size_limit')
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM ar_unreadable u WHERE u.record_sha_hex=a.record_sha_hex AND u.source=a.source
                  )
            )) + (SELECT cnt FROM ar_inline_unsettled) AS cnt
        )
        SELECT
            (SELECT cnt FROM mr_dup) AS duplicate_meeting_records,
            (SELECT cnt FROM ar_dup) AS duplicate_appearance_records,
            (SELECT cnt FROM mr_invalid) AS invalid_meeting_records,
            (SELECT cnt FROM ar_invalid) AS invalid_appearance_records,
            (SELECT cnt FROM mr_unsettled) AS unsettled_meeting_records,
            (SELECT cnt FROM ar_unsettled) AS unsettled_appearance_records

queries.sql:
SELECT reason,count(*) AS documents FROM (WITH blank AS (
 SELECT doc_key,body_hex,source_url FROM ordered WHERE filename=''
), seen AS (
 SELECT b.doc_key,bool_or(coalesce(c.filename,'')<>'') AS named,
  min(coalesce(c.context_url,c.url)) AS address,
  bool_and(strpos(coalesce(c.context_url,c.url,''),'?')>0) AS all_queries
 FROM blank b JOIN capture_sources c ON c.body_sha=b.body_hex GROUP BY b.doc_key
)
SELECT b.doc_key,CASE WHEN coalesce(s.named,false) THEN NULL
 WHEN coalesce(s.address,b.source_url) IS NULL OR trim(coalesce(s.address,b.source_url))='' THEN 'no_address'
 WHEN coalesce(s.all_queries,strpos(b.source_url,'?')>0) THEN 'query_names_no_file'
 WHEN regexp_like(coalesce(s.address,b.source_url),'^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*://[^/?#]*/*(#.*)?$') THEN 'host_only' END AS reason
FROM blank b LEFT JOIN seen s ON s.doc_key=b.doc_key) r GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

queries.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS merged_links,count(DISTINCT list_row) AS merged_documents,count(*) FILTER (WHERE c_filename IS NULL AND filename IS NOT NULL AND o_filename=filename) AS filename_filled,count(*) FILTER (WHERE o_filename IS NOT NULL AND filename IS NOT NULL AND o_filename<>filename) AS filename_conflicting,count(*) FILTER (WHERE c_title IS NULL AND title IS NOT NULL AND o_title=title) AS title_filled,count(*) FILTER (WHERE o_title IS NOT NULL AND title IS NOT NULL AND o_title<>title) AS title_conflicting,count(*) FILTER (WHERE c_congress IS NULL AND congress IS NOT NULL AND o_congress=congress) AS congress_filled,count(*) FILTER (WHERE o_congress IS NOT NULL AND congress IS NOT NULL AND o_congress<>congress) AS congress_conflicting,count(*) FILTER (WHERE c_date IS NULL AND filename_date IS NOT NULL AND o_date=filename_date) AS document_date_filled,count(*) FILTER (WHERE o_date IS NOT NULL AND filename_date IS NOT NULL AND o_date<>filename_date) AS document_date_conflicting,count(*) FILTER (WHERE c_package IS NULL AND package_id IS NOT NULL AND o_package=package_id) AS package_id_filled,count(*) FILTER (WHERE o_package IS NOT NULL AND package_id IS NOT NULL AND o_package<>package_id) AS package_id_conflicting,count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(array_length(c_kind),0)=0 AND coalesce(array_length(document_kind),0)>0) AS document_kind_filled,count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(array_length(o_kind),0)>0 AND coalesce(array_length(document_kind),0)>0 AND o_kind<>document_kind) AS document_kind_conflicting,count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(array_length(c_family),0)=0 AND coalesce(array_length(document_family),0)>0) AS document_family_filled,count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(array_length(o_family),0)>0 AND coalesce(array_length(document_family),0)>0 AND o_family<>document_family) AS document_family_conflicting,count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(array_length(c_facts),0)=0 AND coalesce(array_length(facts),0)>0) AS facts_filled,count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(array_length(o_facts),0)>0 AND coalesce(array_length(facts),0)>0 AND o_facts<>facts) AS facts_conflicting FROM (WITH merged AS (
 SELECT m.source_id,dm.source_url,nullif(dm.filename,'') AS filename,a.title,a.congress,a.filename_date,a.package_id,
  a.document_kind,a.document_family,a.committee_keys,a.chambers,a.meeting_keys,a.measure_keys,a.bioguide_ids,a.facts,
  o.list_row,o.filename AS o_filename,o.title AS o_title,o.congress AS o_congress,o.document_date AS o_date,o.package_id AS o_package,
  o.document_kind AS o_kind,o.document_family AS o_family,o.committee_keys AS o_committees,o.chambers AS o_chambers,
  o.meeting_keys AS o_meetings,o.measure_keys AS o_measures,o.bioguide_ids AS o_bioguides,o.facts AS o_facts,
  nullif(s.filename,'') AS c_filename,coalesce(sa.reading_title,sa.listing_title) AS c_title,sa.congress AS c_congress,
  coalesce(sa.filename_date,sa.content_date) AS c_date,sa.package_id AS c_package,sa.document_kind AS c_kind,
  sa.document_family AS c_family,sa.facts AS c_facts
 FROM recovered_copy_members m JOIN document_members dm ON dm.source_id=m.source_id
 JOIN source_annotations a ON a.source_id=m.source_id
 JOIN document_identities d ON d.component=dm.component JOIN ordered o ON o.doc_key=d.document_id
 JOIN saved_files s ON s.component=dm.component AND s.saved_rank=1 JOIN source_annotations sa ON sa.source_id=s.source_id
), addressed AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT g.source_id FROM merged g JOIN source_rows r ON r.list_row=g.list_row AND r.url=g.source_url
), keyed AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT g.source_id FROM merged g JOIN links k ON k.list_row=g.list_row
  AND encode(k.link_key,'hex')=substr(encode(sha256('url:'||g.source_url),'hex'),1,16)
), looked_up AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT g.source_id FROM merged g JOIN lookup_sources u ON u.list_row=g.list_row AND u.url=g.source_url
), recovered AS (
 SELECT source_id,count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT moved) AS unmoved FROM (
  SELECT g.source_id,c.original_url,c.body_sha,bool_or(r.list_row IS NOT NULL) AS moved
  FROM merged g JOIN current_recoveries c ON c.original_url=g.source_url
  LEFT JOIN recovery_rows r ON r.list_row=g.list_row AND r.original_url=c.original_url AND encode(r.body,'hex')=c.body_sha
  GROUP BY g.source_id,c.original_url,c.body_sha) GROUP BY source_id
)
SELECT g.*,a.source_id IS NULL AS lost_address,k.source_id IS NULL AS lost_link,u.source_id IS NULL AS lost_lookup,
 coalesce(r.unmoved,1)>0 AS lost_recovery,
 g.filename IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(g.o_filename,'')='' AS lost_filename,
 g.title IS NOT NULL AND g.o_title IS NULL AS lost_title,
 g.congress IS NOT NULL AND g.o_congress IS NULL AS lost_congress,
 g.filename_date IS NOT NULL AND g.o_date IS NULL AS lost_date,
 g.package_id IS NOT NULL AND g.o_package IS NULL AS lost_package,
 coalesce(array_length(g.document_kind),0)>0 AND coalesce(array_length(g.o_kind),0)=0 AS lost_kind,
 coalesce(array_length(g.document_family),0)>0 AND coalesce(array_length(g.o_family),0)=0 AS lost_family,
 coalesce(array_length(g.facts),0)>0 AND coalesce(array_length(g.o_facts),0)=0 AS lost_facts,
 coalesce(array_length(g.committee_keys),0)>0 AND NOT coalesce(array_has_all(g.o_committees,g.committee_keys),false) AS lost_committees,
 coalesce(array_length(g.chambers),0)>0 AND NOT coalesce(array_has_all(g.o_chambers,g.chambers),false) AS lost_chambers,
 coalesce(array_length(g.meeting_keys),0)>0 AND NOT coalesce(array_has_all(g.o_meetings,g.meeting_keys),false) AS lost_meetings,
 coalesce(array_length(g.measure_keys),0)>0 AND NOT coalesce(array_has_all(g.o_measures,g.measure_keys),false) AS lost_measures,
 coalesce(array_length(g.bioguide_ids),0)>0 AND NOT coalesce(array_has_all(g.o_bioguides,g.bioguide_ids),false) AS lost_bioguides
FROM recovered r RIGHT JOIN (looked_up u RIGHT JOIN (keyed k RIGHT JOIN (addressed a RIGHT JOIN merged g
 ON a.source_id=g.source_id) ON k.source_id=g.source_id) ON u.source_id=g.source_id) ON r.source_id=g.source_id) g

queries.sql:
WITH stripped AS (
                SELECT occasion,name_key,
                    trim(regexp_replace(
                        regexp_replace(
                            ' '||name_key||' ',
                            '(?i)\s+(?:(?:dr|mr|ms|mrs|miss|hon|the honorable|rep|sen|prof|gen|lt gen|maj gen|brig gen|adm|rear adm|vice adm|col|lt col|maj|capt|lt|cmdr|sgt|rev|fr|rabbi|amb|sec|gov|mayor|judge|justice|esq|phd|md|jd|jr|sr|ii|iii|iv|v|usa|usn|usaf|usmc|uscg|ret)\s+)+',
                            ' ','g'
                        ),
                        '\s+(?:[a-z]\s+)+',' ','g'
                    )) AS base_key
                FROM appearance_records_resolved
                WHERE name_key IS NOT NULL
            )
            SELECT occasion,base_key,min(name_key) AS first_name_key,max(name_key) AS second_name_key,count(DISTINCT name_key) AS variant_count
            FROM stripped
            WHERE base_key<>''
            GROUP BY occasion,base_key
            HAVING count(DISTINCT name_key)>1
            ORDER BY occasion,base_key

queries.sql:
WITH linked AS (
                SELECT DISTINCT tr['package_id'] AS package_id FROM (
                    SELECT unnest(transcripts) AS tr FROM meetings_export WHERE transcripts IS NOT NULL)
            ), listed AS (
                SELECT d.package_id,o.list_row,o.version_keys FROM linked l JOIN details d ON d.package_id=l.package_id
                JOIN ordered o ON o.list_row=d.list_row
            ), split AS (
                SELECT package_id,count(*) AS documents,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(array_length(version_keys),0)>0) AS versioned
                FROM listed GROUP BY package_id HAVING count(*)>1
            )
            SELECT package_id,documents,CASE WHEN versioned=documents THEN 'editions' ELSE 'unexplained' END AS basis
            FROM split ORDER BY basis,package_id

queries.sql:
SELECT 'list.parquet' AS file,
            min(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'suspect' THEN o.congress END) AS congress_start,
            max(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'suspect' THEN o.congress END) AS congress_end,
            min(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status='accepted' THEN o.document_date END) AS date_start,
            max(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status='accepted' THEN o.document_date END) AS date_end FROM ordered o UNION ALL SELECT 'detail.parquet' AS file,
            min(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'suspect' THEN o.congress END) AS congress_start,
            max(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'suspect' THEN o.congress END) AS congress_end,
            min(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status='accepted' THEN o.document_date END) AS date_start,
            max(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status='accepted' THEN o.document_date END) AS date_end FROM ordered o UNION ALL SELECT 'links.parquet' AS file,
            min(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'suspect' THEN o.congress END) AS congress_start,
            max(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'suspect' THEN o.congress END) AS congress_end,
            min(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status='accepted' THEN o.document_date END) AS date_start,
            max(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status='accepted' THEN o.document_date END) AS date_end FROM ordered o JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT list_row FROM links) r ON o.list_row=r.list_row UNION ALL SELECT 'urls.parquet' AS file,
            min(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'suspect' THEN o.congress END) AS congress_start,
            max(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'suspect' THEN o.congress END) AS congress_end,
            min(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status='accepted' THEN o.document_date END) AS date_start,
            max(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status='accepted' THEN o.document_date END) AS date_end FROM ordered o JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT list_row FROM url_keys) r ON o.list_row=r.list_row UNION ALL SELECT 'sources.parquet' AS file,
            min(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'suspect' THEN o.congress END) AS congress_start,
            max(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'suspect' THEN o.congress END) AS congress_end,
            min(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status='accepted' THEN o.document_date END) AS date_start,
            max(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status='accepted' THEN o.document_date END) AS date_end FROM ordered o JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT list_row FROM source_rows) r ON o.list_row=r.list_row UNION ALL SELECT 'recoveries.parquet' AS file,
            min(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'suspect' THEN o.congress END) AS congress_start,
            max(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'suspect' THEN o.congress END) AS congress_end,
            min(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status='accepted' THEN o.document_date END) AS date_start,
            max(CASE WHEN o.document_date_status='accepted' THEN o.document_date END) AS date_end FROM ordered o JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT list_row FROM recovery_rows) r ON o.list_row=r.list_row UNION ALL SELECT 'meetings.parquet' AS file,
            min(coalesce(cast(r.congress AS SMALLINT),o.congress_min)) AS congress_start,
            max(coalesce(cast(r.congress AS SMALLINT),o.congress_max)) AS congress_end,
            min(m.meeting_date) AS date_start,
            max(m.meeting_date) AS date_end
            FROM meetings_export m
            LEFT JOIN meetings_resolved r ON m.event_id=r.event_id
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT try_cast(unnest(meeting_keys) AS BIGINT) AS event_id,min(congress) AS congress_min,max(congress) AS congress_max
                FROM ordered WHERE meeting_keys IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
            ) o ON m.event_id=o.event_id UNION ALL SELECT 'witnesses.parquet' AS file,
            min(coalesce(cast(m.congress AS SMALLINT),o.congress_min,p.congress_min,try_cast((regexp_match(w.package_id,'(?i)^CHRG-([0-9]+)'))[1] AS SMALLINT))) AS congress_start,
            max(coalesce(cast(m.congress AS SMALLINT),o.congress_max,p.congress_max,try_cast((regexp_match(w.package_id,'(?i)^CHRG-([0-9]+)'))[1] AS SMALLINT))) AS congress_end,
            min(coalesce(m.meeting_date,o.date_min,p.date_min)) AS date_start,
            max(coalesce(m.meeting_date,o.date_max,p.date_max)) AS date_end
            FROM witnesses_export w
            LEFT JOIN meetings_resolved m ON w.event_id=m.event_id
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT unnest(witness_keys) AS witness_key,min(congress) AS congress_min,max(congress) AS congress_max,
                    min(CASE WHEN document_date_status='accepted' THEN document_date END) AS date_min,max(CASE WHEN document_date_status='accepted' THEN document_date END) AS date_max
                FROM ordered WHERE witness_keys IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
            ) o ON w.witness_key=o.witness_key
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT package_id,min(congress) AS congress_min,max(congress) AS congress_max,
                    min(CASE WHEN document_date_status='accepted' THEN document_date END) AS date_min,max(CASE WHEN document_date_status='accepted' THEN document_date END) AS date_max
                FROM ordered WHERE package_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
            ) p ON w.package_id=p.package_id UNION ALL SELECT 'committees.parquet' AS file,cast(NULL AS SMALLINT) AS congress_start,cast(NULL AS SMALLINT) AS congress_end,min(n['start']) AS date_start,max(n['end']) AS date_end FROM (SELECT unnest(names) AS n FROM committees_export WHERE names IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL SELECT 'members.parquet' AS file,cast(NULL AS SMALLINT) AS congress_start,cast(NULL AS SMALLINT) AS congress_end,min(t['start']) AS date_start,max(t['end']) AS date_end FROM (SELECT unnest(terms) AS t FROM members_export WHERE terms IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL SELECT 'rosters.parquet' AS file,min(congress) AS congress_start,max(congress) AS congress_end,cast(NULL AS DATE) AS date_start,cast(NULL AS DATE) AS date_end FROM rosters_export UNION ALL SELECT 'bills.parquet' AS file,min(try_cast(split_part(bill_id,'-',1) AS SMALLINT)) AS congress_start,max(try_cast(split_part(bill_id,'-',1) AS SMALLINT)) AS congress_end,min(introduced) AS date_start,max(introduced) AS date_end FROM bills_export UNION ALL SELECT 'nominations.parquet' AS file,min(try_cast(split_part(nomination_id,'-',1) AS SMALLINT)) AS congress_start,max(try_cast(split_part(nomination_id,'-',1) AS SMALLINT)) AS congress_end,min(received) AS date_start,max(received) AS date_end FROM nominations_export
